izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthyb.name: Healthy Battery Charging
izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthyb.summary: Prolong the life of your battery by keeping it charged between 40% and 80%
izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthyb.description:
Make your smartphone or tablet battery last longer!
 Good range to aim for when charging a Li-ion battery is from about 40 to 80 percent in one go. A bunch of tiny charges throughout the day is your second best bet, and going from zero to 100 and then 100 to zero on a regular basis will put the most strain on your lithium-ion battery.
 Healthy Battery Charging notifies you when to plug or unplug your phone from the charger in order to improve the battery life. The app itself is optimized for low battery consumption, running in the background and checking the battery level every 15 minutes (configurable). The exact timing of these checks depends on the Android OS, which might schedule them alongside other tasks or delay them when in sleep mode. As a result, the battery level may slightly exceed the high threshold while charging or drop slightly below the low threshold while discharging before you receive a notification.
 For those who want to know more technical details about Li-ion batteries: https://batteryuniversity.com/learn/article/how_to_prolong_lithium_based_batteries

izzyondroid:com.castlewrath.hexpress.name: Hexpress
izzyondroid:com.castlewrath.hexpress.description:
Hexpress is a collection of musical instruments for your phone. You can use it for learning, playing and composing music whenever you have the time - on train, while waiting in line and during boring meetings. Using headphones is strongly recommended for louder and better sound quality, and to not disturb others around you. The application has simple, colorful and clean interface designed to be accessible to young children.
 While each instrument behaves differently in some way, in general notes are played by touching shapes on the screen, and sound is shaped by tilting the phone left-right and up-down. Different instruments have different effect controls - fade in, reverb, wah, tremolo…
 Most of Hexpress instruments have unusual honeycomb note arrangement that’s sometimes called "harmonic table note layout". It has many interesting properties compared to standard piano layout:
 effective utilization of device screen (3+ octaves range)
 note relations (intervals) are uniform across whole range; to transpose song to different key just play same patterns on different part of instrument
 most chord shapes are grouped tightly and they can be executed with single finger swipe
 in typical scale and melody runs, notes are alternated between fingers of two hands, so they can be played with speed and precision
 large intervals are as accessible as smaller intervals
 Besides honeycomb layout there are also instruments with conventional fretboard, and instrument for finger-drumming.

izzyondroid:eu.basicairdata.graziano.gps.name: GPS Logger
izzyondroid:eu.basicairdata.graziano.gps.summary: A simple and lightweight app for recording your position and your path
izzyondroid:eu.basicairdata.graziano.gps.description:
BasicAirData GPS Logger is a simple App for recording your position and your path.
It's a basic and lightweight GPS tracker focused on accuracy, with an eye to power saving.
It works offline (without internet connection), it has NO integrated maps.
This app is very accurate in determining the orthometric height (the altitude above sea level), if you enable EGM96 altitude correction on settings.
You can record all your trips, view them with any installed external viewer, directly from the in-app tracklist, and share them in KML, GPX, and TXT format in many ways.
The app is 100% Free and Open Source.
GETTING STARTED GUIDE:
https://www.basicairdata.eu/projects/android/android-gps-logger/getting-started-guide-for-gps-logger/
IT FEATURES:
- A modern UI, with a low consumption dark theme and a tabbed interface
- Offline recording (the app has no integrated maps)
- Foreground & Background Recording (On Android 6+ please turn off all battery monitoring and optimizations for this app)
- Creation of annotations also meanwhile recording
- Visualization of GPS information
- Manual Altitude Correction (adding an overall offset)
- Automatic Altitude Correction, based on NGA EGM96 Earth Geoid Model (you can enable it on Settings). If your device doesn't have Internet access, you can enable this feature manually by following this simple tutorial: https://www.basicairdata.eu/projects/android/android-gps-logger/application-note-gpslogger/manual-setup-of-the-egm-altitude-correction-for-basic-air-data-gps-logger/
- Real time track statistics
- In-app tracklist showing the list of recorded tracks
- Visualization of your tracks using any installed KML/GPX viewer, directly from the Tracklist
- Track exportation in KML, GPX, and TXT
- Track sharing, in KML, GPX, and TXT format, via E-mail, Dropbox, Google Drive, FTP, ...
- Uses Metric, Imperial, or Nautical units
USE IT TO:
☆ Keep track of your trips
☆ Make accurate static and dynamic measurements
☆ Add your placemarks
☆ Remember the best places you've seen
☆ GeoTag your photos
☆ Share your tracks with your friends
☆ Collaborate to OpenStreetMap map editing
LANGUAGES:
The translation of this app is based on users contribution. Everyone can freely help in translations using Crowdin (https://crowdin.com/project/gpslogger).
F.A.Q:
In case of any issue, you may find it helpful to read the frequently asked questions (https://github.com/BasicAirData/GPSLogger/blob/master/readme.md#frequently-asked-questions).
IMPORTANT NOTES:
In GPS Logger the Location is always accessed (started) when the App is in Foreground, and then is kept active also in background. On Android 10+ the app needs the Location permission "only while using the app". It doesn't need the "all the time" permission.
Depending on your Android Version, if you want to run GPS Logger reliably in background, you have to disable ALL the battery optimisations. For example you could verify in Android Settings, Apps, GPS Logger, Battery that the Background Activity is allowed and the Battery Usage is Not Optimised.

See the GNU General Public License for more details: https://www.gnu.org/licenses.

izzyondroid:v4lpt.vpt.f006.yxn.name: Yes XOR No?

If you want to minimize the time you would normally lose in option paralysis, just press the big red button. The answer is a decisive and strict YES XOR NO. And there is also a delay to hinder you from fooling yourself and coming back to biased circles of fruitless thinking. But this is just what I think. Let me know what you think in the comments. ;)
 Everything is calculated locally, nothing is saved. Your data are yours. Nobody will ever learn about your specific love for wearing mismatched socks. 
 How does it work 
 Ask yourself a Yes/No question in your head
 You click the big red button
 Your answer will appear on the screen
 To prevent cheating, you can't go back for 5s.
 Created with ❤️ by Valentin

fdroid:de.jepfa.yapm.name: ANOTHERpass
fdroid:de.jepfa.yapm.summary:
Another way to manage passwords
(password manager and 2FA authenticator)
fdroid:de.jepfa.yapm.description:
With ANOTHERpass you don't need to create and remember a long and complex master password! 
ANOTHERpass comes with a clever two factor authentication to unlock the vault. These factors are knowledge (a PIN chosen by you) and ownership (the generated master password as a physical token). Instead of remembering a long and complicated master password (or a too weak one!) you just remember the PIN and have your master password or token with you (as QR code or NFC tag). Additionally, for more convenience, you can safely store it on your device using biometrics (e.g. fingerprint).
ANOTHERpass generates easy but strong passwords for you. It uses so called Pseudo Phrases by default which look like real words but are still very random and unpredictable. Password strength comes with its length (16 - 32 characters)!
You can also access your credentials in the app from your laptop at home or work, if you use the ANOTHERpass Browser Extension .
Besides other features, like a powerful credential-search, grouping, import/export from and to several formats like Keepass and CSV, the app also works as a secure authenticator (2FA).
 Core features of the app 
- easy two factor authentication (PIN and master password as physical token or PIN and biometric for convenient Quick Access)
- no weak or complicated master password to memorize, you only need to export it (on QR code or NFC tag)
- easy to read but strong password generator ( Pseudo Phrases with flexible length)
- strong modern encryption, all fully configurable (AES 128/256, Blowfish 128/256, Chacha20, Argon2, PBKDF)
- uses an integrated security chip or TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) if present
- Autofill support
- works with the ANOTHERpass Browser Extension to share credentials within a local network (e.g. from the app to the desktop PC)
- fully offline, internet permission is only needed to provide Browser Extension support
- 2FA support for one-time-passwords (HOTP and TOTP)
- notification for expired credentials
- no insecure clipboard function by default
- option to display passwords over other apps to type them easily
- (automatic) export and import the credential vault
- export vault and master key separately (latter analogue if wished)
- share and outsource credentials
- obfuscate important passwords as additional security layer
- optional self destruction after too many failed login attempts
- supported languages: english, german, dutch, chinese
- Dark theme support ;-)
For detailed information see anotherpass.jepfa.de 
If you like the app please star it on Github !

fdroid:io.github.jherforth.plungetracker.name: Plunge Tracker
fdroid:io.github.jherforth.plungetracker.summary: Offline cold plunge timer and log. No accounts, no network, no tracking.
fdroid:io.github.jherforth.plungetracker.description:
Plunge Tracker is a small, deliberately simple timer and logbook for cold water immersion. Set a target, start the timer, get an audible cue when you reach it, and the session is logged with its duration and water temperature.
Everything happens on your device. There is no account to create, no sync service, no analytics, and no advertising. The app never contacts a server.
 Features 
* Countdown timer with a target you adjust in 15 second steps
* An optional 10 second run-up that counts you in, so you are not already losing time while you climb into the water
* Audible chimes, synthesised on the fly rather than shipped as recordings
* Optional ambient soundscapes to hold your attention during a plunge
* An option to hold the screen on, so the countdown is still there when you look up
* Session history showing duration and water temperature
* Export your whole history to CSV, so your data is never locked in
* Celsius or Fahrenheit, switchable at any time
* Light and dark themes, following your system setting by default
* Built-in cold plunge safety guidance
 Privacy 
Sessions are stored in the app's own private storage and never leave the device. The app asks for no permissions at all - not even internet access. It cannot reach the network, because it was never granted the ability to. The interface is read directly out of the app package, so there is nothing to fetch.
You may still see one entry listed, DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION. That one is generated automatically by the AndroidX libraries, is scoped to this app's own package, and can only ever be held by code signed with the same key. It grants no access to your device or your data.
 Safety 
Cold water immersion carries real risks, including cold shock response, impaired swimming ability and hypothermia. This app is a timer and a notebook. It is not medical advice and it cannot supervise you. Never plunge alone, ease into the practice gradually, and talk to a doctor first if you have a heart condition, high blood pressure, or are pregnant.

apple-macos:951362406.name: Radio FM: Music, News & Sports
apple-macos:951362406.description:
Radio FM – Live Radio, FM Stations & Podcasts
Listen to your favourite radio stations, discover new music and stay up to date with news, sports and podcasts—all in one simple app. Explore more than 55,000 stations and 4.2M podcasts from Germany and around the world, with an easy to use radio player designed for everyday listening.

NEWS & TALK RADIO
Stay informed with live news radio, breaking news, talk radio, interviews and current affairs programs. Listen to news and discussion programs from local and international stations while commuting, working or relaxing.
SPORTS RADIO
Follow your favorite sports with live sports radio, sports news, football radio, baseball, basketball, hockey, tennis and more.
Listen to sports commentary, match updates, expert analysis, interviews and sports talk from radio stations around the world.
Over 4.2M PODCASTS
Explore more than 4M podcasts covering news, business, technology, sports, comedy, education, entertainment, history, culture, motivation and personal development.
Discover new shows and listen to podcasts that match your interests, alongside your favorite radio stations.
POWERFUL RADIO PLAYER
Radio FM is designed to make listening simple:
• Play live radio with one tap
• Search for radio stations and podcasts
• Save stations to Favorites
• Quickly access recently played stations
• Browse stations by country, genre and language
• Find stations with the radio tuner
• Equalizer to customize your listening experience
• Car Mode for safer, easier listening while driving
• Caste Screen & Widget Feature
• Continue listening with background playback
• View currently playing information
• Control playback from your device
• Share what you are listening to
SLEEP TIMER & ALARM
Fall asleep while listening to your favorite music radio, talk radio or podcast with the Sleep Timer. Set the timer and playback automatically stops at the time you choose.
Use the Alarm Clock to wake up with your favorite radio station and start your morning with music, news or talk radio.
LISTEN WHILE YOU DRIVE
Enjoy radio and podcasts while driving with supported in-car features, including Apple CarPlay. Quickly access your favorite stations and keep listening while on the road.
WHY CHOOSE RADIO FM?
 Live FM and AM radio
 Internet and online radio
 Local radio station discovery
 Music, news, sports and talk radio
 Radio tuner and powerful search
 Favorites and recently played stations
 Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock
 Background playback

apple-macos:6761143528.name: PhotoFlight: Travel Photo Map
apple-macos:6761143528.description:
Your camera roll already knows where you've been. PhotoFlight turns it into a travel map.
Open the app and your trips are there: a 3D globe with every place you've taken photos, a passport of the countries and cities you've visited, and an album for each trip. No check-ins, no diary to keep.
YOUR TRIPS, SORTED
PhotoFlight groups your photos into trips, including the ones with several stops. Tell it where you live now and where you used to live, and it keeps everyday photos apart from holidays. Flights and drives are worked out from your photos, so treat them as a good guess rather than a boarding pass.
A VIDEO FOR EVERY TRIP
Turn a trip into a short portrait video. The first one is free; with Pro, make as many as you like, plus videos of countries and cities. Pick up to 20 photos, give it a title, and add one of six soundtracks, your own music (if you have the rights to it) or none at all. Then share it wherever you like.
SEE WHAT'S MISSING
The free Scan Report shows what PhotoFlight found and where the gaps are. Photos without a location get suggestions when there's enough to go on. Photos with no date or location, or limited Photos access, can leave holes, and screenshots don't count as travel.
KEEP A MEMORY CLOSE
Get a gentle reminder on a trip's anniversary, if you'd like one. On iPhones with NFC, stick a tag on a fridge magnet or a souvenir and link it to a trip, a country or an online album; one tap opens it. (Tags not included.)
REDISCOVER OLD TRIPS TOGETHER
PhotoGuessr is a little family game built into PhotoFlight. It shows one of your photos, everyone secretly drops a pin where they think it was taken, then you reveal the answer together and see who remembered it right. Pass the iPhone or iPad around, or put the photo on the TV while the guesses stay private. One game a day is free; Pro has no daily limit.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Your travel history stays on your device, and your photo library isn't uploaded to our servers. Place names and maps come from Apple. Calendar access is optional, and so is the extra flight lookup, which uses an outside service with your own key.
PHOTOFLIGHT PRO
One purchase, yours for good: your full photo history, the complete trip timeline and albums, the full passport with every country, city and flight, manual edits and corrections (fix a wrong date or place), photo location tools, trip, country and city videos, souvenir tags, alternate app icons and PhotoGuessr without a daily limit. Share cards and widgets are free for everyone.
No subscription. You can restore your purchase in the app.

Since they are known to have different characteristics from the conventional rotational disks,a file system, an upper layer to the storage device, should adapt to the changes from the sketch. F2FS is a new file system carefully designed for the NAND flash memory-based storage devices. We chose a log structure file system approach, but we tried to adapt it to the new form of storage. Also we remedy some known issues of the very old log structured file system, such as snowball effect of wandering tree and high cleaning overhead. Because a NAND-based storage device shows different characteristics according to its internal geometry or flash memory management scheme aka FTL, we add various parameters not only for configuring on-disk layout, but also for selecting allocation and cleaning algorithms.

firefox-addons:686250.name: miniOrange Secure Single Sign-On
firefox-addons:686250.summary: A password manager and Single Sign-On(SSO) solution that autofills credentials, generates strong passwords, and offers secure access with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and password reset. Simplifying your login experience.
firefox-addons:686250.description:
Tired of getting locked out of accounts or remembering multiple passwords? This extension streamlines your login experience while keeping your data secure. Key features include:
 Single Sign-On (SSO) for all your daily applications, allowing you to log in once and access multiple apps.
 Autofill usernames and passwords to simplify and speed up login processes.
 Strong password generation to create secure passwords effortlessly.
 Password reset functionality for easier management of your credentials.
 Secure access with the ability to enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) or Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for added protection.
 With this extension, you’ll never have to remember another password. Store your credentials securely and log into all your applications without hassle. Keep your accounts safe and simplify your login experience with our reliable password management and SSO solution.

firefox-addons:3008664.name: Ad Blocker Shield Blocker
firefox-addons:3008664.summary: Free powerful ad blocker. Block ads, trackers, and malware. 100% free forever.
firefox-addons:3008664.description:
ShieldBlock is a free and powerful ad blocker that protects your browsing experience.
🛡️ What ShieldBlock blocks:
- Ads from Google, Amazon, Facebook, and 50+ ad networks
- Trackers and analytics (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Facebook Pixel, and more)
- Cookie consent banners and GDPR popups
- Malicious scripts and suspicious iframes
✅ Features:
- Real-time blocking using Firefox's native webRequest API
- Live counter showing items blocked per page and in total
- Enable/disable per website (whitelist)
- Toggle ads and trackers separately
- 100% free, no subscription, no premium tier
- Zero data collection — your browsing stays private
ShieldBlock is lightweight, open-source, and works out of the box with no configuration needed.

firefox-addons:2913392.name: Product Copilot
firefox-addons:2913392.summary: The Product Copilot browser extension adds AI directly to Jira and Confluence (cloud and data center). It supports software product teams with their day-to-day product work. Create better tickets, find information easier, and ship more value faster.
firefox-addons:2913392.description:
Product Copilot is an AI assistant for everyone who works in Jira and Confluence: Product Owners, Product Managers, Developers, QA, Customer Success, or Scrum Masters.
If Jira is part of your daily work, Product Copilot helps you move faster and with better quality.
It feels like ChatGPT, but directly inside Jira and Confluence – with access to all your product knowledge, if you choose to connect it.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH PRODUCT COPILOT
✓ Create tickets in seconds
Turn rough ideas or screenshots into clean Jira tickets according to your templates.
✓ Get instant quality checks
Product Copilot spots missing details, edge cases, and unclear scope.
✓ Search Jira and Confluence naturally
Ask questions instead of writing complex JQL queries.
✓ Keep control of your backlog easily
Product Copilot spots duplicates, unclear tickets, and items not ready for refinement.
✓ Create clear product docs
PRDs, release notes, and other Confluence pages. You focus on decisions. Product Copilot does the writing.
Built for developers too
Use the Product Copilot MCP server directly in your IDE.
YOU'RE IN CONTROL
You have full control over your data. Product Copilot does not automatically connect to your Jira or Confluence. You decide what projects or spaces it can access.
Your data is safely processed, strictly separated from other users' data and never used for AI model training.
We decided to build Product Copilot as a browser extension, not an Atlassian plugin. Why? It gives you full flexibility to use it alone or with your team. You installing Product Copilot has no effect on other Jira users.
You can use Product Copilot completely for free and with full access to all features for 28 days. If you like it, you can choose a license model. If not, you are downgraded to a free basic version.
HOW IT WORKS
 Install the browser extension
Add Product Copilot to Firefox. Takes about 30 seconds. No IT department needed.
 Connect Product Copilot
Connect Jira and Confluence to create and work on issues. You decide what it can read and what not.
 Open Jira or Confluence
Product Copilot adds additional buttons and actions directly inside your Jira and Confluence. Chat, create tickets, search, and write. Right where you already work.

firefox-addons:885697.name: Web Developer Sidekick
firefox-addons:885697.summary:
Please note that this extension is useful for web developers only.
It allows recognition of website environments and display useful data such as credentials, ip address, database connections...etc
firefox-addons:885697.description:
Please note that this extension is useful for web developers only.
Also available on Chrome Store
Keep Your Website Info at Your Fingertips
As a web developer, you have to work on different projects in parallel. You have to record: database credentials, admin dashboard login info and many other important information. You have to keep all this data for each environment. With this extension (let s call it the assistant) you can display all the required data with a simple click. All you have to do is installing the extension then add the appropriate settings for each your website.
How it Works
After installing and configuring the assistant, each time you visit a website, it will check if the url of to the website meets any defined rule you have set in the extension options. If it met than you will see a badge announcing which environment you are working. And when you click on the extension icon, the browser will display a popup where you can see the info you entered in the option page.
Note: Be careful when you add credentials for production environment since any one who has access to your browser can see those credentials.
Features:
Displays website environment (screenshot 1)
Shows useful details (screenshot 2)
Extends popup byy adding new tabs (screenshots 3 & 4)
Customize addon behavior (screnshot 5)
For configuration details please check the documentation by following this link 
 https://soloist.ai/webdevelopersidekick

firefox-addons:869585.name: Cookie-Editor
firefox-addons:869585.summary: Cookie-Editor lets you efficiently create, edit and delete a cookie for the current tab. Perfect for developing, quickly testing or even manually managing your cookies for your privacy.
firefox-addons:869585.description:
Cookie-Editor is designed to have a simple to use interface that let you do most standard cookie operations. It is ideal for developing and testing web pages or even manual management of cookies for your privacy.
 Be careful! Do not share your cookies with anyone you do not trust! Cookies can contain very sensitive information like your login information. If you share your cookies with someone, they could gain full access to your account and compromise it.
Feature list:
- List all cookies for the current tab.
- Search your cookies.
- Create, edit and delete your cookies.
- Import and export your cookies in many formats (JSON, Netscape, Header string)
- Quickly delete all cookies for the current tab.
- Customizable: chose what extra data to see, what theme to use (light or dark), the amount of detail to see (advanced mode).
Cookie-Editor can help you:
- Develop web pages.
- Improve your SEO work.
- Manage your cookies for privacy.
- Improve your browsing experience.
Cookie-Editor believes in privacy. Your Cookies are safe and all of your data remains offline.
For all feature requests or bug report, please visit the GitHub repository and fill an issue https://github.com/Moustachauve/cookie-editor

firefox-addons:662434.name: Mate Translate – translator, dictionary
firefox-addons:662434.summary: Your all-in-one translator for web pages, highlighted text & Netflix subtitles. Translate and learn words in 103 languages.
firefox-addons:662434.description:
Just like a real-life mate has your back, Mate Translate Extension for Firefox has you covered for all your translation needs. 
Mate helps you easily and effortlessly translate words, phrases and documents from 103 languages. 
Mate’s comprehensive dictionary and custom curated phrasebook will help you accelerate your language learning with both page translation and optional human translation. 
Mate isn’t just for reading and writing but for full language mastery and comprehension. Download your Mate Firefox translator today and never feel lost in language again.
Reading an article on the Internet and don’t know a word? Just select any text on any webpage, press a shortcut and see the translation in an unobtrusive window right on the same page. 
Need to type in some text by yourself and translate it? Just open the Mate pop-up window by clicking on the icon next to your browser address bar. It’s always by your side! 
103 languages
It understands 103 languages. Mate also teaches you how to pronounce correctly. It shows phonetic transcription, transliteration and can speak out words and texts with correct accent.
Synchronization
It synchronizes across all your devices. All your translation & dictionary data will be automatically synchronized between all your browsers, iPhones and Macs you are using Mate on.
Phrasebook
It allows you to create custom word lists with your favorite words. Just give our Mate Phrasebook a try. Easily create & curate word lists which are available even offline. Perfect for language learners or travelers who need to have their word lists always by their side. 
Download Mate today to get your ultimate translation helper for free! 550,000 users worldwide are already using Mate.

firefox-addons:2624926.name: What3words translator
firefox-addons:2624926.summary: This is an easy interface that communicates with https://what3words.com/ and allows the user to convert from the traditional latitude and longitude coordinate system to the 3 word address system.
firefox-addons:2624926.description:
Popup features: 
 Takes 3 word address input and converts to latitude, longitude
 Takes latitude and longitude input and converts to 3 word address
 Automatically opens tab showing location on maps when translating
 Configure add-on behaviour
 Additional features: 
 Automatic replacement of latitude, longitude to 3 word address in tabs - tested with google maps, and bing
 Caches translation results, making it is faster since there is no need to ask API again
 How to use the popup UI 
When converting from a 3 word address to coordinates, write the words separately in the 3 textboxes at the top, or the address (e.g "///beeline.scandalous.bruisers") in the orange textbox underneath. Tab or space bar can be used to select the next textbox. Press the enter key to translate. By default, a new tab on maps will open showing the location.
Translation from coordinates to a 3 word address is performed similarly. Write the latitude and longitude in the bottom textbox (e.g "37.743413, 15.031307") and press enter.
The add-on settings can be accessed by clicking the arrow at the very bottom of the popup. Uncheck the first two check boxes if you do not want a new tab to open with the location on a map when you use the popup to make a translation.
Leave the last checkbox checked if you would like the add-on to automatically replace most instances of latitude, longitude in your tabs with a 3 word address. For example on google maps you will see "///beeline.scandalous.bruisers" instead of "37.743413, 15.031307"

firefox-addons:3047430.name: Player for video
firefox-addons:3047430.summary: A touch-first video player for Firefox on Android. No telemetry, no network access
firefox-addons:3047430.description:
Firefox for Android's built-in video controls are a thin progress line and a play
button. Player replaces them with controls built for a thumb.
 Controls 
* Pinch — the picture fills the screen from the start, with no black bars;
pinch to go back to the full frame and it snaps cleanly between the two.
 Tap at center to pause. The picture fades to grey while paused, like Netflix.
 −5 and +10 buttons either side of play, and a double-tap on either side of
the screen does the same.
 Seek bar — thick and raised off the bottom edge. Grab it anywhere , not just
at the current position, and it moves with your finger
 Hold either side to scrub at 2x, forward or back.
 Picture 
 Night light — warms the picture to a comfortable amber for watching in the dark.
 Brightness, contrast and saturation — adjusted with + and − buttons
 Subtitles 
 Use the site's own tracks, or load an .srt / .vtt file from your phone
 Also 
 Playback speed from 0.5x to 2x.
 Quality switching where a site offers several sources.
 Settings are remembered on your device.
 Privacy 
Nocturne Player has no network access at all. 
There is no fetch, no XMLHttpRequest, no beacon and no remote URL anywhere in the source — a continuous integration check fails the build if any of them ever appear. 
It asks for two permissions: storage, to remember your settings on your device, and activeTab, so the popup can show which site you are on. Nothing is collected and nothing is sent anywhere.
 Scope 
Built for ordinary sites that play video through a plain HTML video element. It
deliberately does not touch YouTube, Vimeo or TikTok — those ship their own player
layers.
 Known limits 
* Volume is left to the phone's own buttons.
* There is no sound while holding to scrub.
Source code: https://github.com/kvachikk/nocturne-player

firefox-addons:3065790.name: DDownload
firefox-addons:3065790.summary: Detects ddownload links on any page, downloads them or imports them into your account. Full speed with Ultimate.
firefox-addons:3065790.description:
DDownload for Firefox finds ddownload links ( ddownload.com , ddl.to , ddl.ch ) on any page you visit and lists them in the popup. Multi-part archives are grouped as one package; if a part is missing or no longer available, the extension warns you before you download.
With an Ultimate account you download everything found in one click: the extension adds the files to your account and runs the downloads in order in the background, at full speed, without waiting time or captcha. You can also import the files into your account only.
Without Ultimate the extension shows the links it found and opens them on ddownload.com , where the regular free flow applies.
FEATURES
• Automatic detection on any page, with a counter on the icon and an in-page notice (both can be turned off)
• Also finds links that appear only as plain text on a page, for example in forums or comments
• Packages: parts are grouped, incomplete packages are flagged
• Queue with progress, cancel and retry, keeps running when the popup is closed
• Paste links or load a DLC file
• Right-click any link to download or import it
• Account overview: Ultimate term, traffic, storage, signed-in devices
• Six languages, light and dark theme
SIGN-IN AND PRIVACY
You sign in with a code on ddownload.com . The extension stores no password; your account key stays local in this browser and is revoked on the server when you sign out. There are no ads, no tracking and no sharing of data with third parties. Page content is scanned locally for ddownload links only; nothing leaves your browser except the detected file codes, which are sent to ddownload.com for verification.

firefox-addons:2815779.name: IG Downloader - Instagram Downloader
firefox-addons:2815779.summary: IG Downloader is a free Instagram Downloader tool that lets you download Instagram video, photos, reels, and profile pictures.
firefox-addons:2815779.description:
IG Downloader is your go-to browser plugin for hassle-free Instagram media downloads. IG Downloader is a free and user-friendly Instagram downloader tool that empowers you to effortlessly save Instagram videos, photos, reels, and profile pictures with just a few clicks. 
Once the add-on is installed a new download icon will be appear on your page when visiting Instagram.com . Click on the download icon and a new tab will open with our website igdownloader.com . Once the Instagram post is processed you can begin downloading media to your computer.

firefox-addons:2924354.name: YouTube Enhanced Media Controls (for Mobile)
firefox-addons:2924354.summary: Adds an enhanced player wrapper to the YouTube mobile site (m.youtube.com), adding greater accessibility and providing fixes.
firefox-addons:2924354.description:
A mobile browser extension that enhances the YouTube mobile experience ( m.youtube.com ) with improved media controls, custom player interface, gesture support, and accessibility features.
This extension was originally developed to provide a more user friendly interface for YouTube while driving (with music videos being the primary focus), the project has expanded from there, adding features and fixes to improve the overall user experience.
 Enhanced Media Player : A modern player with a custom interface and themes.
 Advanced Playlist Management : Better control over your playlists.
 Voice Search Integration : Quickly search for videos using your voice.
 Smart Controls : An improved seekbar and intelligent navigation buttons.
 Gesture Support : Use swipes and presses to control the player.
 Extensive Customization : Change the layout, appearance, and accessibility settings.
 Background Play Support : Keep audio playing even when the browser is in the background.
 'Continue Watching' Popup Handling : Automatically dismisses the annoying "Are you still there?" popups.
 Media Key Playlist Navigation Fix : Prevents your Bluetooth or media keys from skipping to videos outside your current playlist.
 Auto Ad Skip : Automatically skips video ads.

firefox-addons:2641524.name: The Beagle Button - sustainable shopping helper
firefox-addons:2641524.summary: The Beagle Button helps you buy more sustainably online by finding ethical and sustainable alternatives to the products you see when you shop online.
firefox-addons:2641524.description:
The Beagle Button - the magic way to shop sustainably
As seen in The Mirror, Daily Mail, You Magazine and The Vegan Review, the Beagle Button fetches you amazing planet-friendly alternatives instantly!
How it works:
🛒 You shop as normal - browse the shops you already use
✨ If there’s a better product than the one you’re looking at, Beagle shows up! MAGIC
🔭 We have done all the research so you don’t have to, finding thousands of the most ethical and sustainable products in the world
Sustainable shopping can take time, energy and research - plus it’s hard to find the latest ethical products if you don’t even know they exist!
We believe sustainable shopping should be as easy as the old way to shop and we’re making that happen. Join our mission to change the way the world shops!
TIP: Set your preferences to see products that align most closely with your values ❤️
- Organic
- Plastic-free
- Vegan
- Longer-lasting
- Ethically made
- Low-Carbon
- Women-Run
- Gives Back
- Made in the UK
- Minority owned
- Second hand
Our pledge:
🌍 Beagle is free and working for you & the planet
💾 We will not sell your personal data - privacy is sacred
🔍 Our product research is independent and based on our own strict sustainability criteria
🥇 We never accept money to show products, and only the best get listed
At Beagle, like any good doggy, we’re always striving to be better, so let us know if there’s anything we can improve 🐶
@thebeaglebutton
-------------------------------------------
By using this add-on you agree to the terms and conditions available at joinbeagle.com/terms-and-conditions 
- We send anonymized data from the retail sites you visit, such as the url, page title and price to our API in order to allow us to recommend a relevant alternative. This data does not contain any personally identifiable information such as email addresses, but may include data supplied by the browser such as useragent and IP address (but these are not shared).
- We communicate the extension's installation status when you visit our website,  joinbeagle.com , so features such as login and onboarding can work.
- We log unexpected errors to help our team continuously improve the product.
- We send action data, such as when you click on a recommendation we give, or pause the add-on, to our analytics partner Mixpanel and our API in order to understand and improve the product’s performance.
Our full privacy policy is available at: joinbeagle.com/privacy-policy 
Our sustainability criteria is are available at: joinbeagle.com/blog/guide-to-the-beagle-buttons-sustainability-values

firefox-addons:285807.summary: Quickly switch between your themes or reset the theme back to the default via a menu or the keyboard. You can also automatically rotate through all of your themes on a time interval you select. Works for Firefox and Thunderbird.
firefox-addons:285807.description:

With our application, you can utilize the pregnancy calculator to accurately determine your gestational age and learn every essential detail of your pregnancy journey.
Explore the development of your baby week by week with 'My Pregnancy and Baby Tracker', where detailed information on your baby's growth stages and gestational weeks awaits. The baby age calculator allows you to track daily progress, offering precise estimates on baby size and significant changes you might experience.
Additionally, our app features a pregnancy calendar to personalize your journey, enabling you to maintain a pregnancy diary, documenting your feelings, symptoms, and important milestones during this magical journey. Use our calculator pregnancy to plan and better prepare for key moments, including the estimated conception date.
This application is more than a conventional age calculator; it's your daily companion guiding you through each step of your gestation, providing peace of mind by knowing exactly what pregnancy stage you are in and what to expect along the way. With integrated tools like the pregnancy age calculator, gestational age calculator, and hCG levels calculator, you have access to a comprehensive tool that makes tracking your pregnancy progress easy and exciting. Discover the wonderful world of your pregnancy with our app, specially designed for you and your baby.

bluejetty:00070907:ios.description:
Welcome to fun learning with SKIDOS!
Learning through play comes naturally to kids! With our unique 40+ apps, SKIDOS ensures joyful playtime & engaging learning for 2-11-year-old kids. Our apps focus on math & logical thinking, tracing letters & numbers, developing curiosity with learning videos & other fundamental 21st-century skills in preschool & school-age kids.
To add more value for parents, we offer a single SKIDOS Pass with access to all our games. Users can create up to 6 player profiles & log in from multiple devices.
SKIDOS TRUCK is a game suitable for 2+ year olds that let kids play with an excavator, a crane, a bulldozer or a drill truck. Personalize your vehicle, turn it into a pirate, a dinosaur, a shark, a unicorn, and help with the roadworks! Smash rocks, dig tunnels, and repair pipes to help the cute little truck and his friends find their way.
Game features:
-4 vehicles with cute customizations
-Clear the road from rocks, sand and other obstacles
-Fun mini-games: wash your truck or make a pizza
-Solve educational tasks
-Safe game without ads
DEAR PARENTS & EDUCATORS,
Our mission is to help kids become confident lifelong learners. SKIDOS has carefully selected high-quality games & incorporated engaging learning content in them. We ensure kids enjoy playing while learning.
40+ APPS WITH SKIDOS PASS
A single SKIDOS Pass grants you access to 40+ apps, where every child, in a toddler, preschool, or school-age, will find games they love. Parents can track their child’s learning progress in the app or email reports. 4 million kids around the globe play & learn with SKIDOS!
PRACTISING MATHS
SKIDOS math curriculum is aligned to the Common Core State Standards for Mathematics & covers a comprehensive list of topics including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, decimals, geometry, etc. Our tasks keep evolving as a child progresses.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS
Picking the preschool level, your kid will be offered to learn & write letters & numbers. With the tracing game, it becomes super easy & fun to learn quickly: kids simply have to begin tracing from a point & a cute ladybug will help out. The visuals & audio together support the learning.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS
Videos are great to capture kids’ attention. They usually enjoy rhymes & cartoons. We created the right mix of entertainment & learning with our new educational video content.
IMPROVING 21ST CENTURY SKILLS
SKIDOS games help kids improve 21st-century skills that are essential for a successful future: problem-solving skills, logical & critical thinking, initiative, creativity, technology literacy & more.
SAFE & AD-FREE
With SKIDOS, introducing kids to mobile technology learning is meaningful & safe. No ads are displayed to kids, the apps are COPPA & GDPR compliant. SKIDOS took care of a safe online learning environment for kids.
Get your SKIDOS Pass today!
- SKIDOS offers monthly, quarterly, annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- 3 Day Free Trial! Payment will be charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The SKIDOS Pass may be managed by the user & auto-renewal for subscriptions may be turned off in the user’s device Account Settings
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a Pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00123902:ios.description:
The ultimate multiplayer mini golf battle!
Challenge real players from around the world and putt your way to the top!
Get your friends, beat them in 1v1 or play with up to 6 Facebook friends at the same time.
Fun & intuitive gameplay, super easy controls
Blast your rivals off the course! Beat your friends in a Mini Golf Battle!
Play with your friends on more than 120+ mini golf courses in this super exciting multiplayer PvP golf game. 
- Play together with up to 6 friends or players from all over the world!
- Beat your friends in a multiplayer mini golf battle & win bragging rights!
- Play golf on the same course as your friends and watch them in real time
- Show off impressive golf clubs & customized balls to your friends!
The perfect Golf Game for Casual Players
Enjoy a friendly round of mini golf while you wait, on a rainy day or whenever you need to kill some time. Visit beautiful courses around the world & play against golfers in real-time online multiplayer matches!
- Collect and upgrade awesome golf clubs and cool customized balls
- Show off your amazing trick shots in the Lucky Shot Challenge & win great prizes
- Huge slides, big jumps or wild rivers: Experience obstacles you’ve never seen on a real minigolf course.
- Play & level up to unlock cool new content!
Come on in & join the minigolf party!
KEY FEATURES:
- Innovative multiplayer gameplay. Exciting games with up to 6 players.
- Challenge real players from across the world and clash on the mini golf course in real-time
- Play with your friends. Just with 1, or up to 6 all together!
- Relax, take aim and putt in classic mode!
- Simple, intuitive controls. Fun, lasting gameplay. Entertainment for all ages.
- Awesome 3d graphics.
- Win prizes & powerful golf gear.
- Unlock & upgrade your clubs.
- Level up and progress through 120+ holes, mini golf courses and levels.
Multiplayer Golf battle
Pine Forest
Extreme Mini Golf action from start to end. A clean green awaits you in the Pine Forest. Expect straight Mini Golf action from start to end.
Rocky Mountains
Like Golf in the desert, but it's actually golfing in the Rocky Mountains! Dangerous sand pits and moving objects stand between you and victory, be aware!
Snow Valley
Are you the next King of Mini Golf? Put on the ice crown and enjoy some cold levels featuring water, ice and other crazy stuff that guarantees your hands will not be freezing while holding the club!
Mayan Jungle
Water, trees and a lot of green - Take a swing at the Mayan Jungle and explore countless options to master the levels in this minigolf jungle. 
Windy Cliffs
Gushing springs, a lot of wind and beautiful levels await you in Windy Cliffs. Just when you think you’ve seen it all, Windy Cliffs will test your golf swing. Mother Nature wants to join the mini golf party, better be prepared.
Invite your friends to short and exciting multiplayer golf rounds and determine who is the golf king!
Download this awesome pvp mini golf battle on mobile – get Golf Battle NOW!
With Golf Battle, you experience a never seen before multiplayer extravaganza on a miniature golf course against real opponents or friends!

This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).

bluejetty:00092265:ios.description: Trap Vegan was born after we became vegan and realized that there weren’t any feel-good vegan options available while on the go. When we went vegan, we always felt like we would have to give up the feel-good foods that we loved so much, such as cheeseburgers, fries, and mac and cheese. Living in Detroit, we soon learned that it was not any places for us to go to enjoy these things while on the go. We are vegans but we do not believe taste has to be a second place or compromised. Here at Trap Vegan, we have provided a solution to that. Trap Vegan features a 100% plant-based menu and is also home to the best smoothies and raw juices in Detroit. Trap Vegan is a family-owned and operated brand, you can taste the difference. We assure you that our cleaning measures are unmatched, we cook with soul and you will be able to taste the sauce on our amazing burgers. Stop in and give us a try we can guarantee you be will be “Trapped” and it will always be “Dope, Healthy, Good AF”!

bluejetty:00184946:ios.description:
Princess Games - Are you ready for a magical adventure into a world like no other? The creators of popular titles such as Frozen Pop - Frozen Games, Gummy Pop, Space Cats Pop and Bubble Farmer are proud to bring you the latest fruit pop adventure – Bubble Shooter - Princess Pop! part of Princess Games.
All is peaceful in the land of Fruitopia, yet one day our Princess - Triss is called by magic to the small village of fruitshire where a magical portal opens up and from it appears an innocent frooty who is scared for his life. The frooty has asked for your help in defeating the tyrannical and evil Prince Doofus and rescue more of his innocent frooty buddies. To reach him, you must also defeat his evil assemblage of characters - the Old Crone, the Town Crier and his loyal guard - Knightly! Are you up for the quest at hand?
Connect to Facebook and discover thrilling destinations with your friends like the Barrensted Town, Easter Valley, Cupid's Square, Witch's Hamlet and many more. With more than 2100 (and more added every month) fruit popping levels in the game, this adventure is sure to keep you hooked!
Game Features:
- Burst colorful fruits by simply matching any 3 of them.
- Rescue cute little frooties from the tyrannical Duke Doofus and his evil army.
- Journey through the towns and cities all over Fruitopia, celebrating various festivals and seasons of the land, all the while enjoying fruit popping extravaganza.
- Compare your progress with your Facebook friends.
- Use amazing powerups like the bomb, lightning ball, & more to clear those challenging levels.
- Lots of free rewards to be won daily.
- Over 2100 free levels with more added every month.
Available in English, français, Deutsche, italiano, Español, Português, русский, Tiếng Việt, bahasa Indonesia, عربى, ไทย, čeština, 简体中文, 中國傳統的, 한국어, 日本語, Türk, Nederlands, dansk, svenska, norsk, Suomalainen

Dive into music theory for beginners or take specialized lessons in Indian classical music like Carnatic vocal music and Hindustani classical music.

Looking to improve your knowledge? Learn how to read music sheets, enhance your ear for music with music ear training, and explore the fundamentals of music theory.

Whether you want to learn music online as a hobby or work toward professional mastery, we have courses that will help you reach your goals.

Our app is one of the best apps for learning guitar, piano, and singing, making it easy to learn music wherever you are.
Start your journey with the best music learning app today. Whether you want to master how to play guitar for beginners, refine your vocals, or explore Carnatic classical music, Artium Academy has everything you need. Learn at your own pace with flexible schedules and expert mentors guiding you every step of the way.
Download Artium Academy now and bring the joy of music into your life!

bluejetty:00160525:ios.name: Unwind: Breathing Exercises
bluejetty:00160525:ios.summary: Unwind is a refreshing, delightful, and distraction-free mindful breathing companion to help you with meditation and get you through the day. Unwind combines beautiful illustrations with background ambiances to create an atmosphere that is
bluejetty:00160525:ios.description:
Unwind is a refreshing, delightful, and distraction-free mindful breathing companion to help you with meditation and get you through the day. Unwind combines beautiful illustrations with background ambiances to create an atmosphere that is perfect for mindful breathing.
HOW DOES UNWIND WORK?
We’ve forgotten the true significance of mindful breathing. We are so busy that we have even forgotten how to breathe correctly—which drastically affects our overall health and happiness.
Unwind fixes that. Unwind comes with a number of guided breathing exercises including the following exercises:
- Start your day fresh
This breathing exercise gets you ready for the day feeling refreshed, relaxed, and also shaking off any lingering remnants of sleep
- Relax & unwind
This breathing exercise relieves your mind of any stress or anxiety. By the end of this exercise, you’ll feel relaxed and more focused.
- Sleep better & faster
When you are ready for bed, this deep relaxing breathing exercise helps you get calm, and fall asleep in minutes.
------
And it doesn’t end there!
UNWIND COMES WITH THE FOLLOWING EXTRA FEATURES
- Mindfulness History
Unwind securely backs up all your session details with any notes or mood you’ve logged. Reflect on your past and get better with just a tap.
- Stats and Insights
Find it hard to stay motivated? Track your mindfulness journey and set daily targets and build streaks to make sure you stay motivated and spend some time daily to be mindful.
- Widgets
With support for iOS 17 Lock Screen and Home Screen Widgets out of the box, you’ll be able to track your daily mindfulness progress right from your home screen.
- Background Ambiances
Unwind comes with over 30 background ambiances each with a unique sound and illustrations so that you can craft the perfect atmosphere for your mindful breathing session. The ambiances help reduce distractions and improve focus on the breathing.
- Breathing Companion
After you begin a session, Unwind breathes with you by animating the background scenes to help you stay mindful and in sync.
- Voice Prompts
Unwind also supports voice prompts to guide you through the breathing exercises if you prefer to do them with your eyes closed.
- Haptics
Unwind comes with the best haptic feedback during exercises. 
- Daily Reminders
Enable daily reminders and Unwind will gently remind you when it's time to do your breathing exercise. You can also set custom reminders.
- Daily Mindfulness Quotes
After each session, Unwind displays a fresh mindfulness quote for you to absorb in the perfect state of mind.
- Sync to Apple Health
You can choose to track your Mindful Minutes in Apple Health by enabling the “Sync to Apple Health” option.
- iCloud Sync
Your stats and mindfulness history is backed up privately in your private iCloud account and can only be seen you. So if you decide to switch your phone and use multiple devices, your data will never be lost.
---
You can subscribe and pay on the App Store, using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the ‘Manage Subscription’ page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/mysticalbits/unwind-tos/blob/main/privacy-policy.md
Terms of Use: https://github.com/mysticalbits/unwind-tos/blob/main/terms-of-use.md

Take the wheel of 10 Realistic crafted American and European trucks, including legendary brands like Volvo, Western Star, Scania, DAF, Peterbilt, and Mercedes-Benz. Customize your trucks with a plethora of options, and haul various types of cargo across a diverse landscape filled with mountains, challenging roads, and breathtaking scenery.

Experience the thrill of the open road as you traverse a vast variety of landscapes, from rugged mountains to scenic highways. Each journey is a test of your truck driving skills, offering exciting challenges at every turn.
 - Customize Your Dream Truck
Make your mark on the trucking world with extensive customization options. Personalize your trucks with unique paint jobs, accessories, and upgrades to stand out on the road.
 - Haul Diverse Cargo
From heavy machinery to delicate cargo, take on a wide range of transport missions. Master the art of handling different trailers and become the ultimate trucking tycoon.
 - Compete to Be the Best
Show off your truck driving prowess in competitive events and time-based challenges. Compete with friends and truckers worldwide for the top spot on the leaderboards.
 Key Features:
- Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning trucking world.
- Diverse Truck Fleet: Choose from 9 unique trucks from both American and - - Varied Cargo: Transport 8 different types of trailers and loads.
- Realistic Soundscapes: Enjoy the roar of powerful engines.

- Smart AI: Navigate alongside intelligent traffic for a true-to-life experience.
- Immersive landscapes and challenging roads.

bluejetty:00168042:ios.name: Penguin Simulator: My Pets
bluejetty:00168042:ios.summary: Welcome to the amazing world of our new simulator, where an incredible adventure awaits you at the North Pole! Get ready to dive into the life of penguins, these cute and funny creatures that need your care and attention. You will become th
bluejetty:00168042:ios.description:
Welcome to the amazing world of our new simulator, where an incredible adventure awaits you at the North Pole! Get ready to dive into the life of penguins, these cute and funny creatures that need your care and attention. You will become the protector of their island and turn it into a true paradise for penguins.
In this unique simulator, you will take on the role of caretaker of the island where your new friends - the penguins - live. Your duties will include a wide range of activities, from the simplest, like feeding and playing, to more complex tasks, such as giving massages and helping them thaw from the harsh northern cold. Your care and attention will help the penguins feel happy and healthy.
The first step in your adventure will be to provide the penguins with everything they need. Make sure they always have fresh fish and other treats so they don't go hungry. Also, don't forget to play with them, as active games help the penguins maintain good spirits and health. Your pets will be delighted if you show them funny cartoons that will brighten their long winter evenings on the island.
One of the interesting features of the game is the ability to give penguins massages. This will help them relax and rest after a long day. In addition, massages improve blood circulation and warm them up, which is especially important in the harsh northern climate. Thus, your care will become not only pleasant but also beneficial for the penguins.
In addition to everyday tasks, you will have to solve various interesting challenges. For example, rescuing penguin spies who are on important missions. These brave friends are always ready to do anything for their island, but sometimes they need your help to return home. By rescuing them, you will receive not only their gratitude but also additional bonuses.
On the island, you will find other amazing surprises. For example, you can go on a trip to Madagascar with your penguins. There you will discover a new world full of adventures and new friends. This journey will be a great opportunity for your pets to relax and gain new experiences.
The game offers rich and varied gameplay that will keep you entertained. You can not only take care of the penguins but also build and upgrade various structures on the island to make it even more comfortable for your charges. You will have the opportunity to arrange housing, build playgrounds, and even create your unique relaxation spots.
Your penguin friends will appreciate every action you take, and their gratitude will not be long in coming. Each penguin has its unique character and preferences, making the game even more exciting. Learn their features to better understand what they need for happiness and comfort.
Don't forget that you are not alone on this island. Your friends and competitors are also trying to do everything possible to make their penguins happy. Compete with them in various tasks and events to prove that your penguins are the best. Joint games and competitions will add extra excitement and interest to the gameplay.
Our simulator offers you a unique opportunity to feel like a real hero for these cute creatures. Take care of your pets, help them cope with difficulties, and enjoy every day. Discover the amazing world of penguins and become part of their family on the island. 
Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://taketopgames.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00023946:ios.description:
OiNk! Build makeshift contraptions from a huge collection of parts and make it to the goal without blowing your vehicle to pieces!
 IGN's "Best Mobile Game of 2012" Winner!
 "Extremely fun and very challenging" -- Kotaku
 “The best title Rovio has released yet” - IGN
 “4/4 - Must Have” -- Slide to Play
 "If you can’t enjoy watching a pig drive a badly constructed car off a cliff and onto a pile of dynamite, you probably don’t have a soul." - Yahoo/BGR
 Create the ultimate flying/crawling/rolling/spinning/crashing device and pilot the pigs safely to the eggs!
 The Bad Piggies are after the eggs again -- but as usual, nothing is going according to plan! Can you create the ultimate flying machine and steer them safely to their destination? Those tricky pigs have a few objects they can use, but they need your help to turn these into the perfect transportation!
 With more than 200 levels, and free updates coming up, you have hours and hours of pig-crashing, exploding, and flying fun! Get three stars to unlock over 40 more levels! HINT: Sometimes you need to play the level several times to achieve all the objectives -- try building a new device or steering in a different way to earn all the stars!
 Features:
 ● Over 200 levels crammed with flying/driving/crashing fun!
 ● 40+ special levels unlocked by getting three stars! 
 ● Free updates! 
 ● 9+ sandbox levels to stretch your creativity!
 ● Ultra-special, ultra-secret, ultra-difficult sandbox level to unlock by collecting ten skulls! Oh – guess it’s not a secret anymore...
 ● 42 objects to create the ultimate machine: motors, wings, fans, bottle rockets, umbrellas, balloons, and much more!
 Mechanic Pig
 ● Need help? This little piggy will build it for you!
 ● Mechanic pig pre-assembles transport for you!
 ● All you have to do is pilot it!
 ● Tweak his design to get all three stars!
 New Episode: The Road to El Porkado
 Embark on an archaeological adventure in an all new episode full of treacherously icy environments and spooky dark caves. Be sure to equip the trusty lamp to find your way in the darkness – or put the new Night Vision Goggles power-up to use! 
 Get ready to see pigs fly!
 Become a fan of Bad Piggies on Facebook:
 http://facebook.com/badpiggies
 Follow us on Twitter:
 http://twitter.com/badpiggies

bluejetty:00044097:ios.description:
Stop guessing when the bite is on. Stack the odds in your favor.
For over 8 years, Solunar Time: Hunt & Fish has been the most trusted solunar calendar for anglers and hunters who take their time outdoors seriously. Whether you're chasing bass on a weekend morning or sitting a stand at first light, the app pins the exact peak feeding times: major and minor windows, tide movement, and barometric pressure swings, so you know when the magic hour lands before you leave the house.
Don't waste your valuable free days getting "skunked." Be on the water or in the stand during the magic hour, when fish and game are naturally most active. Real-time fishing times, a full hunting forecast, and 5-day weather give you the edge instead of a guess.
WHY VETERAN OUTDOORSMEN TRUST SOLUNAR TIME
* The Cleanest Solunar Calendar: No clutter, no distracting social feeds, and no bloated menus. Get the raw, reliable astronomical data you need in less than 5 seconds.
* Accurate Peak Feeding Times: Plan around major and minor feeding periods calculated for your exact GPS coordinates.
* Comprehensive Hunting Forecast: Combine solunar theory with a detailed 5-day weather forecast to predict when game will move.
* Precise Fishing Times: Track when freshwater and saltwater species are active based on the moon underfoot or overhead alignment.
* Live Moon Phase & Sun Data: Full tracker for moon rise, moon set, moon illumination, sunrise, sunset, and solar transit.
ALL-IN-ONE PLANNING DASHBOARD
We believe you shouldn't have to check three different apps to plan a trip. Unlike basic weather trackers, our solunar calendar integrates:
1. Solunar Activity Index: Know the overall day rating (1 to 5 stars) and hourly activity percentages.
2. Tide Times & Height: High and low tide times with a live rising and falling curve and a countdown to the next turn, so you can see when the tide change lines up with a feeding window.
3. Real-time Weather: Wind speed/direction, temperature, and crucial barometric pressure changes.
4. Location Management: Save and pin your secret hunting spots, tree stands, and fishing hot spots.
5. Offline Access: Crucial data works even in remote areas without cellular service.
MAXIMIZE YOUR SUCCESS IN THE FIELD
* Hunting Forecast: Target deer, elk, turkey, and small game. Plan your sits when they are most likely to feed.
* Fishing Times: Target bass, trout, crappie, walleye, and saltwater game. Know if the bite is on before you launch.
* Advanced Moon Phase Tracker: Use lunar illumination and position to understand nocturnal animal movements.
Go Pro for Advanced Planning
Today's solunar forecast and weather data are always free. Upgrade to Pro to unlock future planning (up to a year in advance), detailed barometric pressure trends, and unlimited location saving.
Stop leaving your success to blind luck. Download Solunar Time: Hunt & Fish today and start hunting and fishing smarter.

bluejetty:00036413:ios.description:
Welcome to the Weekday Merge Game, where you join Wendy on an exciting adventure through the supernatural world! Explore mysterious school stories and solve enchanting puzzles. Weekday Merge is a puzzle merge game with a mystery story that you can play at home on Wednesday, Saturday, or any time you want. Combine magical items, match new enchanting combinations, and renovate the design of the magical School Mansion.
Weekday Merge presents a world brimming with boundless potential and countless combinations! Engage in puzzle quests, unravel new locations, and uncover mergeable items while encountering characters and creatures from the realm of fantasy.
Indulge in the delightful fusion of strategy and entertainment required to progress in this immersive merging game.
UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY: Take control of the puzzle pieces and arrange, merge, and match them on the board according to your own unique strategy.
MASTER THE ART OF MERGING: A myriad of new items continually materialize, eagerly awaiting your expert merging skills.
CURATE YOUR COLLECTION: Explore the art of merging as you stumble upon and merge magical objects, unlocking a charming assortment of characters and wondrous creatures.
AWAITS MAGICAL TREASURES: Amass gems, valuable coins, experience stars, and enchanting chests to advance further into the game and uncover hidden wonders.
A WORLD OF DISCOVERY: Engage in daily matching quests to acquire coins and gems, or endeavor to complete delightful puzzle recipes for the characters, earning rewards in return.
RENOVATE YOUR MANSION: Immerse yourself in the world of mansion renovation. Transform every room of your magnificent mansion through renovation and repairs. Upgrade and restore each area to its former glory, bringing new life to your estate. Unveil hidden secrets and stories as you breathe new life into your grand mansion.
PARTICIPATE IN SPECIAL EVENTS: Tackle unique match puzzles to earn captivatingly themed treats and delightful surprises.
Match countless items and reap the rewards of treasure chests as you traverse this extraordinary adventure.
Prepare for unexpected elements that burst onto your game board, and bring harmony to the chaos by skillfully matching puzzle pieces, crafting a game world that truly reflects your desires.
What are you waiting for? Dive into this extraordinary merging game and unleash your imagination!

bluejetty:00183889:ios.name: MaxRewards Credit Card Rewards
bluejetty:00183889:ios.summary:
MaxRewards connects to your credit card accounts and automatically activates merchant offers, benefits, and bonus categories. Join over 900,000 members earning more rewards from every purchase.
— The Wall Street Journal: Featured as a top
bluejetty:00183889:ios.description:
MaxRewards connects to your credit card accounts and automatically activates merchant offers, benefits, and bonus categories. Join over 900,000 members earning more rewards from every purchase.
— The Wall Street Journal: Featured as a top app for managing credit card perks and benefits.
— Forbes: "For your credit card rewards, they have built an impressively useful app that is hard to beat."
EARN $650+/YEAR FROM AUTO-ACTIVATED OFFERS
MaxRewards automatically activates merchant offers from Amex, Chase, Capital One, Bank of America, Citi, Wells Fargo, USAA, and US Bank. No more logging into multiple portals and manually clicking through offers. MaxRewards Gold members earn $662 from merchant offers, on average, in their first year.
ACTUALLY USE THE BENEFITS YOU'RE ALREADY PAYING FOR
Premium cards come with hundreds to thousands in monthly, quarterly, and annual credits for Uber, dining, streaming, and travel. MaxRewards activates your benefits, sends timely reminders to use them, and automatically tracks your usage.
EARN MORE FROM EVERY PURCHASE
MaxRewards automatically activates bonus categories, shows you the best card for every purchase, and even considers your point valuations in Best Card recommendations. Ditch manual tracking and earn more rewards effortlessly.
KNOW IF EVERY CARD IS PULLING ITS WEIGHT
MaxRewards shows you the net value of every card: rewards earned, offers redeemed, and benefits used, minus annual fees and interest. Don't just guess if your annual fee card is worth it — know for sure.
TRACK WELCOME AND RETENTION BONUSES
MaxRewards tracks every welcome and retention bonus across all your cards. Don't lose a $1,000+ bonus because you forgot the spend deadline.
DISCOVER NEW CARDS FOR YOUR SPEND
MaxRewards analyzes how you actually spend and recommends the cards that would maximize your rewards. Match your wallet to your real spending patterns instead of guessing.
TRACK REWARDS, BALANCES, AND BILLS
MaxRewards shows your actual points and miles balance, card balance, credit limit, and utilization across all of your credit card accounts. Stay on top of your cards with bill and autopay tracking.
GET SPEND & REWARDS INSIGHTS FOR EVERY CATEGORY
MaxRewards categorizes every transaction across every card and shows exactly where your money goes — and how much you earn in rewards from each category.
AUTOMATE BUSINESS EXPENSE REPORTING
Separate work and personal spending, scan receipts with OCR, and export categorized expenses for tax season.
SECURE & PRIVATE
Bank-level encryption protects your information. Decryption tokens are split across two cloud providers. We never access credit card numbers or Social Security numbers. We never sell your data.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is MaxRewards free?
Yes. MaxRewards is free to download and use. MaxRewards Gold is an optional subscription that unlocks our most powerful automation features. MaxRewards Platinum unlocks additional features for expense management, business spend insights, and receipt capture and matching.
Which credit card issuers does MaxRewards support?
Amex, Chase, Capital One, Citi, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Discover, Barclays, US Bank, Synchrony, and 20+ other issuers.
How does auto-activation work?
MaxRewards securely connects to your card account and activates targeted offers every time you sync. No manual clicking or browser extensions required.
Download MaxRewards now and start maximizing rewards on every credit card.

bluejetty:00141046:ios.description:
Welcome to Spirit & Truth, an educational app that will help you immerse the writings of the Church Fathers, and into the prayers of the Coptic Orthodox Church! Inside, you'll have access to Liturgical, Biblical, and Patristic texts in 3 languages. You can also use the study mode to learn about the origins of words, and read commentary on scripture and Liturgical readings from over 20 Church Fathers. You can also customize your in-app experience by adjusting font sizes, languages, word highlighting, and dark mode. Spirit & Truth also has a presentation mode that allows you to easily share content to a projector or external display.
We are adding new content and features all the time, so stay tuned!

bluejetty:00018117:ios.description:
Wherever you go, take Midcoast FCU with you!
Managing your money has never been easier than with Midcoast Mobile! Quickly sign-in using biometrics or check balances with Quick Balance. Stay informed of recent transactions and make loan payments, transfers, and check deposits in just seconds. Pay bills on the go with our free and unlimited Bill Pay* service. Apply for a loan or find our closest branch or ATM near you. Now, you can even monitor your credit score with SavvyMoney, which is now integrated with Midcoast Mobile!
Additional features include:
• 24/7 safe and secure access to your accounts
• View account information, including transaction details, cleared check images and available balances
• Apply for auto loans, home equity lines of credit, credit cards and more!
• Manage your Bill Pay payees (add/edit/delete)
• Deposit checks using your device’s camera with Remote Deposit Capture
• Turn on/off lost or stolen debit cards and order replacement debit cards
• Set travel notifications for uninterrupted debit card usage
• View rates and information on our loans and savings products
• Send secure messages to the Credit Union
Midcoast Mobile is free for our members. To sign in, use your Midcoast FCU online banking username and password. 
*Must have Bill Pay set up previously on online banking. Your mobile carrier’s text messaging and web access charges may apply.
As always, if you have any issues using Midcoast Mobile, please contact us for support at 877.964.3262.
What’s New
We have recently updated Midcoast Mobile! Enhancements include:
• Add/Edit/Delete Bill Pay payees
• Debit card controls
• Access to SavvyMoney
• General bug fixes

bluejetty:00041025:ios.description:
＊＊＊Featured on App Store＊＊＊
Features:
＊ Daily Caps: One day one cap, different colors for your different moods.
＊ Today Card: Today's cap, On This Day, Old Time and fortune in one place.
＊ Flow & Grid: Display journals in a timeline or a calendar. Fill your lovely life with colorful daily caps.
＊ Years: Revisit each year from the sidebar, with all its caps and moods.
＊ Time Fortunes: Collect fortunes by writing daily caps. Share in your mood color.
＊ Future Caps: Write to your next birthday, to next Christmas, to the time after the exam/enrollment/entry, to the dear future you.
＊ Echo Caps: Send yourself a piece of voice from the present.
＊ Old Time: Shake your phone like a jar full of caps and meet your old days by serendipity.
＊ Workshop: Regain cap pieces every day to craft more future caps.
＊ Widgets: Meet your lovely widgets, glanceable anytime on your device.
＊ Siri & Shortcuts: Write and open caps with Siri, Spotlight and Shortcuts.
＊ iPad: Better on big screens, with multiple windows.
＊ Account System: No more worry about accidentally removing the app or switching to a new phone.
＊ Privacy Protection: Secure your journals with passcode lock or Touch ID/Face ID.
＊ Daily Reminder: One day one cap!
＊ Offline Use: Everything works well under no network connection.
＊ Export & Share: Export your favorite caps to your albums or share them with your friends.
＊ Time Traveler Pro: Subscribe to unlock exclusive features, enhance Daily Caps, double regaining Pieces, and enjoy premium sync.
Your lovely designer and developer (same person :D) is working hard to explore and create more cool and useful features. Thanks for your liking and support!
If you like it, don’t forget to come back for rating, encouraging your developer and helping Time Caps become better.
Ideas or feedback are always welcome. Please email us at: hi.pol.chen@gmail.com.
Crafted with love by Pol

MAPPA - LIVE EARTH MAP & SATELLITE VIEW
Explore Earth in high-resolution satellite view. Explore anywhere. Know everything around you.
From real-time satellite views to live street cameras - Mappa puts the entire planet in your pocket.
Open the app. Look down at Earth. Feel the world come alive. 
WHAT'S NEW?
- Flight Tracker
Follow live flights across the globe - view flight routes, altitude, speed, and real-time position of any aircraft directly on the map.
- Earthquake & Disaster Alerts
Stay informed with real-time earthquake activity, tsunami warnings, wildfire zones, and severe weather events worldwide, based on publicly available data. Know what's happening anywhere on Earth, instantly.
- Strategic Locations: 
Discover key global sites using publicly available geographic data.
KEY FEATURES
- Live Satellite & Earth View
Frequently updated satellite imagery of any location on Earth. Zoom in, pan around, and explore terrain, coastlines, and cities with stunning high-resolution detail. Live Earth Map updates continuously so you always see the world as it is right now - not hours ago.
- 3D Views of Famous Places
Step inside iconic landmarks and famous locations with immersive 3D imagery. Explore architectural wonders, natural landmarks, and world-famous destinations from every angle - without leaving your couch.
- Photo Location Finder
Drop any photo into Mappa and instantly identify exactly where it was taken. GPS metadata analysis pinpoints the precise coordinates, street, and location details behind every image - perfect for travelers and photographers.
- Live Traffic Map
See real-time traffic flow, road congestion, and incident alerts on your map. Plan smarter routes and avoid delays before you even leave the house. Always know what's happening on the road ahead.
- Speed Tracker
Monitor your real-time speed while driving, cycling, or walking. Track your pace accurately and stay aware of your movement - right on the map as you go.
- Compass & Navigation Tools
Built-in compass with precise directional tracking, altitude readings, and coordinate display. Always know exactly where you are and which way you're heading - even offline.
- Explore Any Place Instantly
Search any city, landmark, or address and jump directly to its live satellite or street view. Discover hidden gems, plan upcoming trips, or simply satisfy your curiosity about anywhere on Earth.
WHO IS MAPPA FOR?
Whether you're a traveler scouting destinations, a driver navigating daily routes, a photographer tracking shot locations, or simply someone who loves exploring Earth from above - Mappa was built for you.
