bluejetty:00069432:ios.description:
*Giới thiệu*
Cuộc sống mỗi người sẽ có những bộn bề, lo lắng. Mỗi ngày trôi qua cũng giống như một trang sách được mở ra. Có những lúc đọc sách để giảm căng thẳng và mệt mỏi. Có rất nhiều các Top sách hay nên đọc được các tờ báo, trang web nổi tiếng trên thế giới giới thiệu. Tuy nhiên, đây là top cuốn sách hay nên đọc ít nhất một lần trong đời do Business Insider giới thiệu lại từ Reddit. Đây là những cuốn sách mà bút lực của người viết đã vượt qua được giới hạn thể loại và đối tượng độc giả ban đầu họ muốn nhắm đến, chính vì vậy Top sách hay này xứng đáng để mọi người tìm đọc.
*Chức năng chính*
- Hỗ trợ đọc sách định dạng EPUB chất lượng cao.
- Nâng cao trải nghiệm đọc sách với các chức năng : Thay đổi font chữ, hỗ trợ chế độ đọc ban ngày và đêm, bookmark, phụ lục…
- Ghi nhớ cuốn sách cuối cùng cũng như vị trí của trang sách mà bạn đã đọc.
*Sách Hay Tiêu Biểu*
- Đắc nhân tâm
- Hạt giống tâm hồn
- Nhà giả kim
- Muôn kiếp nhân sinh
- Bạn đắt giá bao nhiêu
- Cha giàu, cha nghèo
- Quẳng gánh lo đi mà sống
- Lời từ chối hoàn hảo
- ….
* Tuyểu Thuyết Văn Học Nổi Tiếng*
- Sherlock Homes 
- Mật mã Tây Tạng
- Không gia đình
- Ông trăm tuổi trèo qua cửa sổ và biến mất
- Harry Potter
- Kẻ trộm sách
- ….
* Ngôn Tình Đặc Sắc*
- Anh có thích nước Mỹ không?
- Bên nhau trọn đời
- Sẽ có thiên thần thay anh yêu em
- Bộ Bộ Kinh Tâm
- Tam Sinh Tam Thế Thập Lý Đào Hoa
- …..
*Chú ý*
- Chúng tôi hoạt động và muốn lan tỏa tình yêu với sách, dù vậy chúng tôi luôn khuyến khích độc giả mua sách giấy và chỉ tải ebook khi không tìm thấy ở nơi nào khác.
- Bản quyền thuộc về tác giả và đơn vị phát hành.
- Nội dung trong những ebook này hoàn toàn lấy từ nguồn dữ liệu của bên thứ ba. Vì vậy, nếu phát sinh tranh chấp, làm ơn cố gắng liên lạc với họ, đồng thời gửi kèm email cho chúng tôi, chúng tôi sẽ có gỡ bỏ đường dẫn tải sách ngay khi được yêu cầu.

bluejetty:00015114:ios.description:
Ever wonder why so many astronomy apps are so hard to use? We do. So we made Classic Sky Map simple and intuitive enough for anyone to enjoy. The user interface is beautiful and straightforward, the controls are easy to use and most settings are just a tap or two away. Classic Sky Map shows you thousands of the brightest stars, the Moon, planets, constellations, meteor showers and more. And it's painless. 
Free Features:
- Live Tracking. Simply point your device toward the stars and the sky map aligns itself automatically, showing you the portion of the sky at which you are looking. If your device has a compass, Classic Sky Map uses it automatically. If not, you can tell Classic Sky Map where the North is, and it aligns the sky map accordingly.
- Live Earth Map. Quickly jump from one city to another by tapping on a map that shows the Earth's day and night boundary in real-time. If you allow it, Classic Sky Map can detect your current location automatically. You can also create custom viewing locations in seconds.
- Fast Forward and Rewind. Accelerate or reverse time to understand how stars and planets appear to move in the sky over a longer period of time.
- Beautiful Constellation Images. We put a tremendous amount of work into creating beautiful constellation images inspired by antique engravings and aligning them precisely with the stars.
- Sharing. Share snapshots of the sky map with your friends at the tap of a button.
- Quick Help. Should you have any questions while using Classic Sky Map, a concise, illustrated user guide will help answer them quickly.
Full Version Features (In-App Purchase):
- Interactive Search. Simply type in a search field, pick an object from a list of matches, then point your device toward the sky. An arrow appears and guides you until you are pointing your device toward the object you selected. If the object is not yet visible in the sky, its next rise time is displayed.
- Sky Events. Classic Sky Map shows a list of current sky events such as meteor showers, eclipses and more and helps you quickly locate them in the sky.
- Night Vision. Classic Sky Map's night vision mode helps minimize loss of dark adaptation. And we went the extra mile to make it look great in cyan, orange or red.
- Extra Information. Tooltips and an information panel show details about stars, planets, the Moon, meteor showers and more.
- Personalization Options. Personalize your sky map by turning various guides and display options on or off.
Have fun!

Vehicle Transportation Games" is a diverse and exciting genre of games that focuses on the simulation or g
bluejetty:00140956:ios.description:
Rev up the excitement! Experience the thrill of vehicle transport in the most exciting games. Drive, deliver, and dominate the road!
Vehicle Transportation Games" is a diverse and exciting genre of games that focuses on the simulation or gameplay involving the transportation of various vehicles. These games offer players the opportunity to experience the thrill and challenge of managing different types of vehicles in various virtual environments. The genre encompasses a wide range of gameplay styles and objectives, providing entertainment for players with different preferences.
Key Features:
Vehicle Variety: Players can transport a wide array of vehicles, including cars, trucks, motorcycles, boats, airplanes, and more. The diversity of vehicles adds complexity and excitement to the gameplay.
Realistic Simulations: Many games in this genre strive for realism, offering players the chance to experience authentic physics, vehicle handling, and environmental conditions. This can include realistic damage models, weather effects, and day-night cycles.
Mission and Challenge-Based Gameplay: Players often engage in various missions and challenges, such as delivering goods, completing time-sensitive tasks, or navigating challenging terrains. These objectives test the player's skills in driving, navigation, and strategic planning.
Open-World Exploration: Some games feature expansive open-world environments where players can freely explore and take on different transportation-related activities. This adds a sense of immersion and freedom to the gaming experience.
Customization: Players may have the option to customize and upgrade their vehicles, adding a layer of personalization and strategic decision-making to the gameplay.
Multiplayer Options: Many vehicle transportation games offer multiplayer modes, allowing players to collaborate or compete with others in transporting goods, racing, or other challenges.
Career Progression: Players often progress through the game by completing missions, earning virtual currency, and unlocking new vehicles or upgrades. This provides a sense of accomplishment and encourages continued gameplay.
Examples of Vehicle Transportation Games:
Euro Truck Simulator the experience of driving a truck across Europe, transporting goods, and building a virtual trucking empire.
Microsoft Flight Simulator: Offers a highly realistic simulation of flying various aircraft, allowing players to explore the world from the skies.
Combines realistic driving physics with an open-world environment, featuring a variety of vehicles from cars to off-road vehicles.
Elite Dangerous: A space simulation game that includes trading, exploration, and combat as players navigate the vastness of space in their spacecraft.
SnowRunner: Focuses on off-road vehicle simulation, challenging players to transport cargo through challenging terrain and extreme weather conditions.
Whether you're a fan of realistic simulations or more casual gameplay, vehicle transportation games offer a diverse and engaging gaming experience for players of all tastes.

bluejetty:00180642:ios.name: AlKetab – Modern Quran App
bluejetty:00180642:ios.summary:
Al-Kitab is an advanced Quran experience combining ease of use with rich content in a modern, distraction-free design — your daily companion for reading, memorizing, and reviewing.
# Recitation Correction — On Device, Offline, Free
* Reci
bluejetty:00180642:ios.description:
Al-Kitab is an advanced Quran experience combining ease of use with rich content in a modern, distraction-free design — your daily companion for reading, memorizing, and reviewing.
# Recitation Correction — On Device, Offline, Free
* Recite aloud and the app follows you word by word and turns the page with you — no internet needed, and your voice never leaves your phone.
* Choose how strictly you are corrected: Off, Easy, Normal (checks vowel marks), or Strict (adds shadda and madd lengths).
* Quran Teacher mode stops at a mistake, plays the correct word, and waits until you say it right — including a madd held too short.
* Marks appear under every word as you recite, showing what was confirmed and what needs another look.
* A session log gathers everything worth revisiting — tap to hear the word again.
* Start reciting anywhere in the Quran and the app works out where you are, then follows along.
* Recite a verse aloud to jump straight to its page — no page numbers, no scrolling.
* Continuous recitation carries you from one Surah into the next without a single tap.
# Memorization & Review
* Review mode hides the verses and reveals each word only as you recite it.
* Stuck on a word? A gentle whisper says it for you and hands the microphone straight back.
* Listen-and-repeat plays each verse in your chosen reciter's voice, then listens as you repeat it.
* Daily reading goal, streaks, and detailed statistics for time, verses, and sessions.
# Complete Reading Experience
* Three Mushaf display options: Madinah Mushaf, Book simulation, and Large Text Mushaf.
* Elegant "Al-Kitab" Mushaf cover gives a distinctive start to the app.
* One tap marks the last verse you read, so you resume exactly where you stopped.
* Page history lets you return to any page you visited.
* Tajweed colouring with a legend, and a gentle buzz at each new Surah.
* Landscape reading fills the screen; split-screen and free-form sizes on iPad.
# Advanced Tools for Understanding the Quran
* Long-press any verse to read its tafsir, choose a tafsir book, and move between verses.
* Eleven Arabic tafsir works — Al-Muyassar, Al-Muharrar, As-Sa'di, Ibn Kathir, At-Tabari and more — plus English translation and transliteration.
* Tap any word for its meaning, grammar, morphology, variant readings, and pronunciation.
* Word derivatives, linguistic information, and the verses they appear in, with charts.
# Khatma & Focus
* Set a full Quran reading plan with a target date, daily portions, and reminders.
* Follow your progress and finish with a shareable completion card.
* Stay Focused blocks distracting apps while you read, with a Live Activity countdown.
* Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your verse, streak, and Khatma progress.
# Advanced Audio Capabilities
* Listen with 40 reciters, with offline download support.
* Verses shown one by one while listening, or full-page in landscape.
* Word-by-word pronunciation for any word you tap.
# Sharing
* Share a verse — or a whole range — as a beautifully typeset image.
* Create a recitation video of any passage in your chosen reciter's voice.
# Smart & Precise Search
* Fast and comprehensive Quran search.
* Advanced search powered by the "Al-Fanoos" engine.
* Quran word bar for precise access to terms.
* AI-powered search that understands meaning, not just words.
* The Al-Kitab Assistant responds in your language — play a Surah, jump to a verse, or ask about a topic, by voice.
# Customization & Personal Experience
* Favorites list for quick access to selected Surahs.
* Your last read page and bookmarks sync across all your devices.
* Night mode or automatic mode according to device settings.
Everything you need for a deeper, easier, more personal Quran experience — in one carefully designed app.
* Privacy Policy: https://iphoneislam.com/privacy-policy
* Terms of Use: https://iphoneislam.com/terms
* Support: https://iphoneislam.com/contactus

bluejetty:00124319:ios.summary:

Turn your iPhone or iPad into a live flight tracker and see planes around the world move in real-time on a detailed map. Or point your device at a plane to find out
bluejetty:00124319:ios.description:
The world's best flight tracker app - #1 Travel app in over 150 countries.
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a live flight tracker and see planes around the world move in real-time on a detailed map. Or point your device at a plane to find out where it’s going and what kind of aircraft it is. Download for free today and discover why millions are already tracking flights and checking flight status with Flightradar24.
• Watch aircraft move around the world in real-time
• Identify flights overhead & see flight information—including a photo of the actual aircraft—by simply pointing your device at the sky 
• See what the pilot of an aircraft sees in 3D 
• Tap on a plane for flight details such as route, estimated time of arrival, actual time of departure, aircraft type, speed, altitude, high-resolution photos of the actual aircraft & more.
• See historical data & watch playback of past flights
• Tap on an airport icon for arrival & departure boards, flight status, aircraft on the ground, current delay stats, & detailed weather conditions
• Search and bookmark individual flights using flight number, airport, or airline
• Filter flights by airline, aircraft, altitude, speed, & more
• NEW - view aircraft in 3D with hundreds of new aircraft and airline liveries added.
Flightradar24 is a free app and includes all the above features. If you want even more great features from Flightradar24 there are two upgrade options—Silver & Gold—and each comes with a free trial.
SILVER
• 90 days of flight history
• More aircraft details, like serial number & age
• More flight details, like vertical speed & squawk
• Filters and alerts to find and track flights
• Current weather at 3,000+ airports overlaid on the map
GOLD
• All the features included in Flightradar24 Silver +
• 365 days of flight history
• Detailed live map weather layers for clouds & precipitation
• Aeronautical charts & oceanic tracks showing the pathways flights follow across the sky
• Air traffic control boundaries that show which controllers are responsible for a flight
• Extended Mode S data — even more information about altitude, speed, and wind & temperature conditions during flight
If you choose to upgrade to a Silver or Gold subscription, a payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the end of the free trial period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your account settings in the iTunes Store. Silver and Gold upgrade prices are listed in the app as they vary depending on your country and currency. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
HOW IT WORKS
Most aircraft today are equipped with ADS-B transponders that transmit positional data. Flightradar24 has a rapidly growing network of 50,000 ground stations to receive this data that then shows up as aircraft moving on a map in the app. In an expanding number of regions, with the help of multilateration (MLAT), we’re able to calculate the positions of aircraft that don’t have ADS-B transponders. Coverage is subject to change at any time.

We love getting feedback on FR24. Since we’re unable to respond directly to reviews, you can contact us directly and we’ll be happy to assist.

• X (@Flightradar24)
• Facebook (@Flightradar24)
• YouTube (@Flightradar24DotCom)

The use of this app is strictly limited to entertainment purposes. This specifically excludes activities that might endanger yourself or the lives of others. bluejetty:00176637:ios.description:
Gear up! Obtain secret items or master a skill - and join thousands of other players in this massive 2D adventure!
Etherion Online RPG is a modern-2D action MMORPG which takes place on a newly inhabited planet called Etherion which features scarce resources and a beautiful agrestic architecture. Purchase a weapon, level it up by using it on monsters or other players, and prestige it for rewards! 
Capture bases with a clan or create your own and attempt to take over the land of Etherion! If you're more of a lone-wolf player - venture off and defeat bosses for extremely rare items or become the solidified as the best duelist in the game at Eden Spar. All weapons in Etherion feature attachments, levels, and reward skins for prestiging - which makes every gun unique in its own way. Complete the unique battle pass which releases every 90 days with exclusive, themed, and limited content! Create your own personal character with our custom character creation system features customizable heads, eyebrows, mouths, eyes, beards, and more!
Create your Character
Etherion Online RPG features a FREE customization system which utilizes tons of different assets for hair, eyebrows, eyes, beards, mouths, and a variety of colors. There are currently over a million different combinations. If you want to create your own CUSTOM outfit then purchase an upload ticket from the store and find the outfit templates on our Discord!
Skills
Etherion currently features skills such as weaponry, health, mining, and smithing - but we are working on woodcutting, fishing, firemaking, cooking, bounty hunting, crafting, and much more! Skills also feature a secret pet for each skill - they are extremely rare!
Open-World PvP & PvM
On Etherion you can battle against entire clans, individual players in a spar match, or go defeat rare bosses for their super-rare items / weapons and trophies. You choose your own path!
Collecting 
In the world of Etherion, there are many different secret items, rewards, and collectibles. Sometimes you’ll have to find them, You can dig for them, or get lucky by defeating something and have them rewarded! From secret pets to weapons, to expensive items and trophies, there’s a lot in store for those who enjoy collecting novelty items.

bluejetty:00172606:ios.description:
Are you concerned about snoring at night?
Has someone mentioned that your snoring may be disrupting their sleep?
Many people are unaware of their snoring habits until someone else points them out. SnoreIQ helps you record snoring activity, monitor snore sounds, and review nighttime activity with automatic tracking, snoring detection, and easy-to-understand reports.
Whether you need a snoring tracker, snore recorder, or a simple way to record snore sounds, SnoreIQ helps you review your nights and discover trends over time.
Track your snoring. Review your snore sounds. Gain awareness of your nighttime habits.
SIMPLE & EASY TO USE
SnoreIQ is designed for anyone who wants greater awareness of their nighttime sound environment. Record overnight activity, review snoring sounds, analyze snore recordings, and monitor long-term trends. Whether you experience occasional snoring or frequent loud snoring, SnoreIQ helps you stay informed.
GET STARTED IN MINUTES
• Open SnoreIQ before bedtime
• Place your device nearby
• Start recording with one tap
• Let SnoreIQ monitor your night
• Review your snore report the next morning
No wearable required.
WHY TRACK SNORING?
Many people do not realize how often they snore or when snoring occurs throughout the night. SnoreIQ helps you record snoring automatically, track frequency, duration, and intensity, review nighttime sound activity, compare trends, and gain deeper awareness of your snoring habits.
KEY FEATURES
Smart Snore Recording
Use SnoreIQ as a snore recorder to capture nighttime audio during the night. Recordings are organized for convenient review and ongoing tracking.
Automatic Snoring Detection
Built-in snoring detection helps identify potential snoring events and highlights relevant moments from your overnight recordings.
Snore Statistics & Trend Tracking
Track how often snoring occurs, how long events last, and how intensity changes over time. Review daily, weekly, and monthly summaries, compare previous nights, and identify recurring snoring patterns.
Detailed Reports & PDF Export
Access reports that summarize snoring frequency, duration, intensity, and activity. Save or export PDF reports whenever you need them.
AI Snore Insights
Receive AI-generated snore insights based on recorded snore sounds and nighttime activity patterns. Review trends and gain additional awareness of your nighttime sound environment.
Snore Assessments
Complete the Remedy Quiz to explore potential factors that may contribute to snoring. Use the Sleep Apnea Awareness Test for additional awareness of nighttime habits and snoring-related patterns.
Snore Playback & Routine Tracking
Listen back to recorded snore sounds and review bedtime and wake-up schedules to better understand your nighttime routine.
Relaxing Night Sounds
Enjoy calming soundscapes, soothing audio, and white noise designed to support relaxation and nighttime comfort.
Snoring Articles & Resources
Explore articles covering snoring causes, nighttime habits, snoring awareness, nighttime sound patterns, and general snoring awareness topics.
PRIVACY FIRST
Your recordings and data remain under your control. Audio recordings are stored locally unless you choose to export or share them. Recordings are never shared without your permission.

bluejetty:00082772:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00082772:ios.description:
Unlock the Thrill of the Ultimate Heist with The Impossible Safe
Ever wondered what it feels like to be part of a high-stakes heist, the kind that keeps you on the edge of your seat in blockbuster movies like Mission Impossible or Ocean’s Eleven? The clock is ticking, your heart’s racing, and all that stands between you and untold riches is a vault that no one’s ever been able to crack… until now.
Welcome to The Impossible Safe — a game that turns your iPhone into the vault of your dreams and challenges you to crack it with nothing but your wits and a keen sense of touch. In this pulse-pounding race against time, every second counts, and every move brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate master of safes.
Feel the Lock Click: The Magic of Haptic Feedback
Forget about random guessing or mindless tapping — The Impossible Safe lets you feel the lock with your fingers. Using your iPhone’s advanced haptic feedback technology, this game transforms each spin of the dial into an immersive experience. You’ll sense the subtle vibrations as you get closer to the correct combination, just like a master safecracker using a stethoscope to hear that perfect “click” in the movies.
Spin the dial, listen with your fingers, and discover the thrill of finding the exact moment when the tumblers fall into place. It's tactile. It's realistic. And it's unlike any game you’ve played before.
A Race Against Time: Can You Handle the Pressure?
In the world of The Impossible Safe, time is your biggest enemy. You’ve got just 60 seconds to crack the code before the opportunity slips through your fingers. Do you trust your instincts? Can you keep your cool when every second brings you closer to success… or failure?
This isn't just a game; it's a test of nerves, skill, and focus. With every turn of the dial, the tension mounts. Your goal? Crack the safe before the timer hits zero. The question is — can you do it under pressure?
Challenge Friends and Rivals: Who’s the Ultimate Safe Cracker?
Cracking safes is a lot more fun when there’s competition. Think you’ve got the fastest fingers and the sharpest mind? Prove it! The Impossible Safe lets you challenge friends, family, and players from around the world to see who can crack the safe the quickest. You’ll climb the leaderboards to become the best of the best. But don’t get too comfortable — there’s always someone out there looking to knock you off the top spot.
Features That Keep You Hooked:
* Haptic Feedback Mastery: Feel your way to the right combination with iPhone’s haptic technology, making every game an immersive and tactile experience.
* Beat the Clock: You have only 60 seconds to crack the safe, creating a thrilling race against time that keeps your adrenaline pumping.

bluejetty:00131928:ios.description:
Introducing Glucobyte: The All-In-One Diabetes App That's Sweeter Than Sugar
Say hello to Glucobyte, your new partner in sugar-busting crime! This app helps you record, track, analyze, and share your blood glucose data with the grace of a figure skater on your mobile device. Glucobyte is compatible with Apple Health and designed for Pre-diabetics and Type 1 or 2 diabetics who are ready to take the plunge into the world of better health management.
With Glucobyte by your side, you'll be juggling blood glucose, A1C, insulin, medication, ketone levels, carbs, and weight like a pro. So, why wait? Get your hands on Glucobyte today and let's turn those sugar spikes into sugar dunks!
#diabetes #app #glucose #health #management #sugarbusters #A1C #insulin #medication #ketone #carbs #weight #AppleHealth #glucosemonitoring
Disclaimer:
- Glucobyte allows you to record, track, and analyze your blood glucose information, either manually or by syncing with Apple Health. A separate blood glucose meter is required to measure blood glucose levels that can be synced through Apple Health or measurements can be manually entered.
- Glucobyte is not a substitute for professional healthcare or advice. Consult healthcare professionals for medical guidance.
Visit our FAQ: https://www.glucobyte.app/frequently-asked-questions
Features:
- Record & Track: Easily log blood sugar, insulin, medication, ketones, carbs, and weight. Includes Estimated A1C and Glucose Ketone Index (GKI).
- Quick Notes & Tags: Add notes and tags (e.g., fasting, pre/post-meal) for efficient entries.
- Apple Health Integration: Sync with HealthKit and compatible glucose meters like Dexcom (CGM via Apple Health), Accu-Chek, One Drop, OneTouch, and Contour.
- Nightscout Integration: Sync your CGM data through Nightscout. Nightscout is an open-source project. Glucobyte is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Nightscout Foundation.
- Seamless Bluetooth Integration: Easily connect with popular blood glucose monitors for effortless data transfer.
- Search and log foods by barcode, camera, or text, track serving size and macros (calories, carbs, fat, protein), sync data via Apple Health, and automatically categorize meals as breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
- Nutrition Insights: Discover how foods affect your glucose levels with macro breakdowns (carbs, protein, fat, calories) and view your top carb sources.
- Share Reports: Export blood glucose reports in PDF format to share with doctors and family.
- Stats & Analysis: Monitor your progress with intuitive graphs and statistics, filtering data based on tags.
- Optional Cloud Backup: Securely store data across devices with Glucobyte Cloud.
- Bluetooth & WiFi Sync: Sync data between iPhone and iPad without cloud sharing.bluetooth.
- Security: Protect your data with TouchID, FaceID, or Pin keypad protection.
- Reminders: Set reminders and tasks to manage your blood sugar levels consistently.
- Color-Coded Data: Easily identify low, normal, and high readings with customizable color coding based on American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommendations or create custom categories. Consult with your doctor on which one is right for you.
- Multiple Profiles: Manage multiple user profiles from a single app/device.
- International Units: Supports both US and international height and weight units.
Take charge of your diabetes with Glucobyte, the comprehensive and user-friendly diabetes management app. Download now to access all the tools you need to monitor and improve your blood glucose right at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00045702:ios.description:
Use this Official City of Winnipeg app to find your residential street snow zone, as well as info about when your street will be plowed during a residential parking ban. 
A residential parking ban is called to facilitate the City’s snow clearing response to an extreme snowfall. All residential streets are assigned a snow zone; each snow zone is identified by a letter of the alphabet. Zones are plowed in 12-hour shifts, around-the-clock. Parking is only prohibited on residential streets during the 12-hour period when a zone is scheduled for clearing.
Features include:
- Search an address or use your current location
- Get the snow zone letter and parking ban information specific to an address
- During a residential parking ban, view the full snow clearing schedule
- View all streets designated as winter routes on a map
- View the current and upcoming plowing operations during a residential parking ban on a map 
- Parking ban descriptions
- Frequently Asked Questions

Dai
bluejetty:00152672:ios.description:
Tired of endless clutter on your phone? AI Photo Cleaner - Cleanup Kit is the smart solution to free up storage, keep your gallery organized, and cleanup your device with the help of intelligent tools and AI-powered tips.
Key Features
Daily Cleaning Plan
- Get personalized daily tasks to keep your phone organized step by step.
- Small cleaning actions each day prevent storage overload.
- Perfect for users who want a simple routine without spending much time.
Similar Photos Cleaner
- Detects groups of similar or burst photos in your gallery.
- Lets you review and delete duplicates while keeping only the best shots.
- Frees up space without losing your favorite memories.
Duplicate Videos Remover
- Finds and deletes repeated or unnecessary video files.
- Saves significant storage often taken up by heavy video duplicates.
- Helps your gallery stay lean and efficient.
Screenshots Organizer
- Quickly detects old and unused screenshots.
- Suggests removing them in bulk with one tap.
- Keeps only the ones you really need.
Screen Recordings Cleaner
- Identifies outdated or duplicate screen recordings.
- Allows quick review before deletion.
- Prevents large files from eating your storage.
Contact Manager
- Merge duplicate contacts with one click.
- Remove incomplete or empty contacts from your phonebook.
- Access a clean, well-structured list of all your contacts anytime.
Calendar Events Cleaner
- Easily review your calendar and remove old events.
- Prevents your schedule from being overloaded with outdated entries.
- Keeps only upcoming and important reminders.
Photo Metadata Cleaner
- Erase location tags from photos to protect your privacy.
- Share photos online without revealing personal geodata.
- Keep your gallery both safe and clean.
AI Chat Assistant
- Get instant help from an AI chat about cleaning your phone.
- Ask for personalized recommendations and tips.
- Discover smarter ways to manage files and storage.
AI Tips & Suggestions
- Receive smart tips on freeing up memory.
- Learn best practices for organizing files efficiently.
- Keep your device fresh and clutter-free with AI guidance.
Subscription Information
Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be disabled at any time in Account Settings:
1. Open the Settings app.
2. Tap your name.
3. Select Subscriptions.
4. Choose the subscription you want to manage.
Details:
1. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account once the purchase is confirmed.
2. Your plan renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
3. Renewal charges will be applied to your account within 24 hours before the current subscription period ends, showing the exact renewal cost.
4. Cancellation of the active subscription is not allowed until the subscription period is completed.
5. If a free trial is provided, any unused portion will be forfeited once a subscription is purchased.

bluejetty:00080796:ios.summary:

Birthday Invite: Video Maker helps parents, families, and party hosts create memorable digital invitations without complicated design tools. Start with a re
bluejetty:00080796:ios.description:
Create personalized birthday video invitations in minutes, right from your iPhone.
Birthday Invite: Video Maker helps parents, families, and party hosts create memorable digital invitations without complicated design tools. Start with a ready-made template, add photos and party details, customize the text, choose festive decorations and music, and share a video invitation your guests will remember.
TEMPLATES FOR EVERY BIRTHDAY
Explore a growing collection of colorful invitation templates for different ages, personalities, and party styles:
• First birthdays and milestone celebrations
• Family parties and themed events
• Princess-inspired, hero-inspired, unicorn, dinosaur, animal, balloon, cake, confetti, and classic party designs
• Colorful layouts for fun, magical, and memorable celebrations
PERSONALIZE EVERY PARTY DETAIL
Make every invitation truly personal. Add and edit the important information your guests need:
• Guest of honor’s name and age
• Party date and time
• Venue and address
• Welcome message and special instructions
• Personalized closing message
ADD YOUR FAVORITE PHOTOS
Turn any template into a one-of-a-kind photo invitation. Add pictures from your photo library, place them in the design, and create a personalized birthday video centered around the person being celebrated.
CUSTOMIZE TEXT AND DESIGN
Use simple editing tools to match the invitation to your celebration:
• Add, edit, move, and resize text
• Choose different fonts, colors, and text styles
• Arrange party details directly on the design
• Personalize decorative elements to create your own look
ADD STICKERS AND DECORATIONS
Make your design more festive with birthday-themed stickers and decorative elements. Add balloons, stars, hearts, confetti, cakes, and other details that complement your selected theme.
CREATE ANIMATED VIDEO INVITATIONS
Bring your invitation to life with movement and visual effects. Combine animated templates, photos, text, stickers, and decorations to create an engaging video invite that stands out from a traditional invitation.
ADD FESTIVE MUSIC
Choose cheerful background music that matches the mood of the celebration. Preview your invitation with music and animation before creating the final video.
SAVE AND CONTINUE EDITING
Save your invitation projects and return whenever you need to update a date, change a photo, correct party details, or try a different design. Keep your creations ready for previewing, editing, and sharing.
EASY TO CREATE
No design or video editing experience is required. Create your invitation in just a few steps:
Choose a birthday template
Add photos and party information
Customize text, colors, stickers, and music
Preview your animated invitation
Save and share your finished video
SHARE WITH FAMILY AND FRIENDS
Save your birthday video invitation and share it through text messages, email, social media, or compatible messaging apps. Send the party information wherever your guests are, directly from your iPhone.
Perfect for parents, families, and party hosts creating first birthday invitations, themed celebrations, milestone birthday invites, surprise parties, and memorable family events.
Make the celebration feel special before the party begins. Create and share your personalized birthday video invitation today.
Some templates and editing options are available through the Pro in-app purchase.

Spider Solitaire Zen — Calm Your Mind with Timeless Card Magic!

○ Custom Calm: Personalize card backs, backgrounds & tap sounds
○ Intuitive Play: Drag or tap cards, switch layouts (left/right hand friendly)

bluejetty:00040854:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone and iPad into a complete TV center. IPTV Player Pro plays your own M3U, M3U8 and Xtream Codes playlists — live channels, movies and series — with a full TV guide, Catch-Up TV, recording and Chromecast, all in one fast, beautiful player.
ADD YOUR PLAYLIST IN SECONDS
• M3U & M3U8 URL
• Xtream Codes (username, password, host)
• Local file import from the Files app
• Manage multiple playlists at once
LIVE TV + FULL EPG GUIDE
• Electronic Program Guide — see what's on now and next
• Browse by day and jump straight to any channel
• Smart categories, instant search and favorites
CATCH-UP TV & TIMESHIFT
• Missed a show? Replay programs from the past days
• Rewind live TV and jump back to the live edge anytime
• Start catch-up with one tap from the EPG
MOVIES & SERIES ON DEMAND
• Rich detail pages: poster, plot, cast, rating and trailer
• Episode tracking for series
• Resume right where you left off
WATCH OFFLINE
• Download movies and watch with no internet
• Perfect for flights, commutes and travel
RECORD LIVE TV
• Record any live channel straight to your device
• Save the match, the news or your favorite show
CAST TO THE BIG SCREEN
• Built-in Google Cast (Chromecast) and AirPlay
• Mini and full playback controls
POWERFUL PLAYER
• Built on the MobileVLC engine — plays virtually any format and codec
• Audio and subtitle track selection
• Skip forward/back, sleep timer and background audio
• Smooth playback on Wi-Fi or cellular
MADE FOR YOU
• iCloud sync — your playlists and favorites across all your devices
• Face ID / Touch ID lock to keep playlists private
• Dark mode plus a choice of accent colors
• 14 languages, optimized for iPhone and iPad
BRING YOUR OWN PLAYLIST
IPTV Player Pro is a media player only. It does NOT provide, host or include any channels, content or playlists. You add your own playlist from a provider or source you already have. No content is bundled with the app.
PREMIUM
IPTV Player Pro is free to download. An optional Premium subscription unlocks the full experience, including offline downloads and an ad-free interface.
• Options: Weekly, Monthly, Yearly and Lifetime
• Price and duration are shown in the app before you buy
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation
• Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the period
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription
• Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings
- Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OSqoxjSQ9uQyOzK2-PlKMnUzRmkiUjv_CHENn6x8o-I/edit?usp=sharing
- Privacy policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YfhV2XonZylc2bG7-olI5vstqxFmTAVFreIhRHwPrZk/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00135091:ios.summary:
Struggling to communicate with care recipients who speak another language? Care to Translate is a trusted medical translation app that helps care professionals communicate safely across 130+ languages.
No interpreter? No Wi-Fi? No problem.
bluejetty:00135091:ios.description:
Struggling to communicate with care recipients who speak another language? Care to Translate is a trusted medical translation app that helps care professionals communicate safely across 130+ languages.
No interpreter? No Wi-Fi? No problem.
Use the app to tear down language barriers, improve patient safety, and save valuable time – wherever care happens.
Why care professionals choose Care to Translate:
– Real-time voice translation
– No patient data stored
– Verified translations by medical experts
– Text, audio & image support
– Available 24/7 – even offline
– Custom & ready-made dialogue lists for quick access
– Works in all areas of care – from ER to home visits
Safe, reliable, verified
The phrase library contains medically reviewed phrases, designed to support safe, dignified communication – even when interpreters aren’t available. Unlike generic translation apps, Care to Translate does not store any patient data. Your communication stays private, always.
Translate in real-time
The real-time translation feature is the perfect complement to our trusted phrase library. Communicate freely without storing any data, ensuring patient safety. This AI feature empowers you to foster open and effective communication with care recipients from diverse backgrounds.
Customize your communication
Build your own phrase lists, organize by workflow, and search to quickly find exactly what you need to say. Whether it’s a single phrase or a full conversation – you’re covered.
Built for health care – trusted worldwide
Used by thousands of care workers in hospitals, clinics, ambulances, elderly care, social care, municipalities, and humanitarian organizations.
“The app helps us to provide safe and efficient communication to all our patients, no matter what language they speak.” Karolinska University Hospital, Sweden
“I think it’s probably the most advanced app for the medical field, I haven’t found a better one.” Sea-Eye, Germany
“Care to Translate enables effective communication at all hours of the day.” Molde Municipality, Norway
For organizations and nonprofits
From large hospitals to grassroots nonprofits, Care to Translate offers tailored solutions to fit your care setting. Contact us to find out more about our enterprise solution.
Try it for free! Download now and translate with confidence.
Subscription information
Get premium access with a monthly subscription. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24h before the term ends. Manage your subscription in your iTunes account settings.
Read our terms and conditions at https://caretotranslate.com/our-terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00166147:ios.description:
A free, easy-to-use Pedometer app! 
Perfect for walking and dieting!
"Pedometer" records the number of steps you have walked and displays them again along with the number of calories that you have burned, distance, walking time and speed per hour.
It is easy to use. Simply carry around your smartphone as you normally would.
Of course, it will continue to automatically record your steps even if you put it in your pocket or bag.
You can view a graph with the number of steps you have walked and all other information anytime.
Let's enjoy walking with this app!
How to use
- Touch on the number of steps, burned calories, distance, walking time, or speed to display the graph with that information.
- Touch the graph to highlight information data for a specific time or date.
- Swipe to the left to see the data recorded until the previous day.
- If you want to change the look of the app, change the theme.
- In order to display the correct number of burned calories, please enter your age, gender, weight and step length accurately.
- In order to display the correct distance and speed, please enter your step length accurately.
Pedometer recommended for the following people 
- If you want to check your step count.
- If you want to try using a pedometer.
- If you want to go on a diet.
- If you go on walks or strolls.
- If you go jogging.
- If you want to use a popular pedometer.
- If you want to post the pedometer screen to social media.
- If you walk a lot for your job.
- If you want an easy-to-use pedometer.
- If you want to walk more.
- If you want to form a habit of walking. 
- If you feel out of shape.
- If you want to use a pedometer with a theme that you like.
- If you want to use your smartphone instead of carrying around a handheld pedometer.

bluejetty:00022927:ios.description:
Swinda! is a FREE & high rated dating and social networking app for lesbian, bisexual and queer women around the world.
The concept is easy: Swipe right to “like” them and left to “pass”. Once users “like” each other, it's a MATCH and they can start chatting right away! 
Whether you’re looking for friends or the love of your life, you are in the right place. Find truly authentic LGBTQ+ women nearby and chat now!
Finding Your Match
• Quickly create a profile and browse amazing lesbian, bi and queer women around you. 
• Set your preferred age and distance range.
• Upload profile photos and private photos to your profile from your photo album, Facebook or Instagram. 
• If you match, you can start chatting with them immediately, it's absolutely FREE.
Security & Privacy
• Photo Verification – see who was verified by our photo verification system.
• Verification Request – ask your matches to verify their pictures.
• Messaging – only users who you match with are able to massage you.
• Private Mode – be visible only to the users you liked beforehand or match with.
• Snaps – send photos and videos that disappear after a couple of seconds.
• Private Photos – upload private photos only visible to users with your permission.
 Premium Membership
• We offer 1 month, 3 months and 12 months membership options.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Subscription can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Premium Account Features:
• Private Mode – be only visible to the users you liked beforehand.
• Who Likes Me – skip swiping and see women who liked you immediately and match with them right away.
• My History– search and edit your previous dislike decision about someone.
• Power Messages – send out up to 5 Power Messages a day so that your favorite picks will see your like and message before they swipe left or right on you!
• Rewind – Accidentally swiped left? Hit the rewind button anytime to change your decision. 
• Location Change – modify your location to discover cuties from different cities.
Terms of Use:
• Nudity is not appreciated. You must be at least 18 years old to sign up for Swinda!.
• Check our terms of use for more information: https://www.mbrandin.com/sw/terms
About Us: 
Swinda! is friendly, secure and interactive. All the LGBTQ+ women aged 18+ are welcome to join the community.
Our values are based on friendliness, joy, connection, being yourself, positive approach and inclusivity. 
Contact Us
• 24/7 Admin Support: We are here to help and we speak your language. Message our admin and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
• Feedback: Any recommendation or comment? We value your opinion, let’s make our platform a better place together.
Find us on WWW: 
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy, Help & More:
https://www.mbrandin.com/sw/privacy

bluejetty:00169545:ios.description:
Wanderu is the simplest way to book bus and train travel. 
Wanderu helps travelers find the best deals on bus and train tickets across the United States, Canada and Europe. With just a quick search on the Wanderu app, you can compare bus and train schedules and prices from hundreds of travel companies in one convenient place to find the bus or train that works best for you. 
Wanderu’s checkout process makes it easy to book your bus and train tickets on the go hassle-free. Our mission is simple — we offer you the lowest prices, directly from the carrier. 
Prefer to drive? Rent a car!
On Wanderu, you will also find hundreds of rental cars with free cancellations on most bookings. Just search for trips like you normally would and select the car rental card in the search results to see all available rental car options for your route.
WHY USE WANDERU?
No matter the purpose of your trip, you can always count on Wanderu to compare all your options and find the cheapest bus and train tickets available.
• Lowest Prices
We find the cheapest bus & train tickets, so you can wander for less.
• Best Travel Options
We partner with 500+ carriers to bring you the most bus & train options.
• Quick & Easy Booking
Book trips quickly with a simple, hassle-free checkout – online & on our app.
• Fast Customer Support
We don’t monkey around. We respond within minutes to help you out.
WANDERU FEATURES
• Search tickets – Quickly search for buses and trains in the United States, Canada and Europe.
• Compare deals – Sort, filter and compare bus and train trips from hundreds of carriers in one place.
• Book tickets on the go – Save your personal details, so you can book your tickets quickly and hassle-free.
• Apple Pay – Use Apple Pay during check out to book your tickets easily (only for specific carriers.)
• Trip details – Access your itinerary and get directions to and from the bus and train stations.
• Mobile boarding – Access your tickets and board the bus or train using the app with participating carriers.
• Offline tickets – Get access to your tickets even when you’re not connected to the internet.
• Travel history – Keep track of every bus and train trip you have taken.
• Earn points for free travel – Refer a friend and you will both earn points that you can exchange for free bus and train tickets.
• Rental cars – Search and compare hundreds of car rentals from rent-a-car dealers in your area.
WANDERU’S OFFICIAL PARTNERS

bluejetty:00017041:ios.description:
Turn your device into a real razor, hair clipper, hedge trimmer, stun gun, and chainsaw! Real Razor Prank is the top rated razor, trimmer, and hair clipper simulator game. Prank your friends and entertain your kids! Perfect for April Fools' Day pranks!
Real Razor, Trimmer, and Clipper Sound Effects
Real Razor Prank uses actual razor, trimmer, and hair clipper sound effects recorded for the most realistic hair cutting and shaving experience!
Proximity Sensor
Real Razor Prank uses your device's proximity sensor to detect when it's cutting hair!
Custom Hair Colors
Real Razor Prank simulates actual hair clippings! Select the perfect hair color to match your victims.
Buzzing Vibrations and Haptics
Real Razor Prank vibrates your device just like an actual hair clipper, in time with every razor's sound, for added realism!
April Fools' Day Countdown Widgets
Count down to April Fools' Day from your Home Screen and Lock Screen with live widgets in your own font and colors.
Share Your Pranks
Create a card with your razor and hair color and send it to friends or post it anywhere.
Make It Yours
Pick a new app icon, go light or dark, and set reminders to prank your friends.
How To Use:
#1 Tap your device's screen to turn on the trimmer.
#2 Use your device like an actual hair clipper by running it along your head, arm, leg, anywhere!
#3 Finished with your haircut? Tap your device's screen again to turn off the razor.
Use Real Razor Prank on your friends, family, pets, yourself, and everything in-between!
If you enjoy using Real Razor Prank, please take a moment to leave a review in the App Store. Thank you for the support!
Disclaimer: This application is designed to assist the modern day barber, prankster, and hair stylist perform the perfect haircut and/or shave. However, as advanced as this application is, it can neither cut, nor shave, actual hair. As a result, this application is provided for entertainment purposes only. Use responsibly.

bluejetty:00089645:ios.description:
Agemingle: Serious Senior Social Platform
Are you a 50+ individual seeking meaningful connections or genuine friendships? Agemingle is a dedicated serious social community for mature adults in their 50s, 60s, and beyond to build trust-based relationships—whether you’re pursuing companionship, intellectual partnerships, or enduring friendships. Beyond matchmaking, Agemingle fosters structured engagement through curated activities designed to deepen mutual understanding while maintaining cognitive vitality.
Serious Social Network for Seniors
Agemingle provides a dignified space where seniors can reconnect authentically. As a platform exclusively for individuals over 50, it prioritizes respectful interactions, enabling users to engage in purposeful conversations and form connections rooted in shared values and life experiences.
Find Like-Minded Individuals Nearby
Whether you seek intellectual peers or companionship, Agemingle transcends superficial barriers. Divorce or widowhood is acknowledged with sensitivity, creating an environment where seniors can cultivate enriching relationships locally or globally. Engage in substantive dialogue with those who respect your life journey.
Structured Conversation & Cognitive Engagement
Struggling to initiate meaningful dialogue? Participate in "Daily Topics"—curated discussions on culture, philosophy, or current affairs. These activities sharpen critical thinking while providing thoughtful icebreakers. Impress others through articulate expression and discover common ground in substantive exchanges.
Effortless Connection Finder
Eliminate trivial distractions and focus on building relationships with mature individuals aligned with your principles. Agemingle’s algorithm prioritizes compatibility based on values, interests, and communication styles to foster genuine connections.
Meet New People with Purpose
Agemingle is designed for seniors seeking intentionality in social interactions. The platform’s intuitive interface simplifies meaningful engagement, currently available in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, and other regions where mature socializing is valued.
Curated Connections Beyond Casual Chat
Agemingle is more than a chat app—it’s a hub for building lasting relationships. Whether pursuing companionship, friendship, or intellectual exchange, millions of seniors worldwide await meaningful connections.
Key Features of Agemingle Senior Social:
Senior-Centric Design: Clean, accessible interface with privacy-focused controls
Local Match Recommendations: Connect with vetted profiles near you
Value-Based Chat: Engage in discussions aligned with your principles
Intentional Swiping: "Like" profiles based on compatibility; "Pass" to refine matches
If you seek an online platform that prioritizes sincere connections for those over 50, your search ends here. Begin building relationships that honor your life experience.
Download Free Today!
Agemingle is free to download. For enhanced features, optional Premium subscriptions are available:
1-month: $22.99
3-months: $54.99
6-months: $89.99
Embrace a chapter of meaningful engagement—your journey toward authentic connection starts now.

- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings after purchase
- You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period

bluejetty:00016085:ios.name: Bonbon Cakery
bluejetty:00016085:ios.summary:
Have your cake and eat it too in this latest and greatest of cakery simulators, fresh from the Kairosoft oven!
Improve your prowess as a pâtissier by pioneering a bountiful catalogue of high-ranking recipes. For example, combine a sponge ca
bluejetty:00016085:ios.description:
Have your cake and eat it too in this latest and greatest of cakery simulators, fresh from the Kairosoft oven!
Improve your prowess as a pâtissier by pioneering a bountiful catalogue of high-ranking recipes. For example, combine a sponge cake with strawberries and cream--and presto! You'll have whipped together a supple shortcake! Even grace your creations with toppings for added effect. And once you think you're ready, test your confectionary capacity by pitting these pastries in grand competitions!
Pleasing the palates of your beloved customers will aid your culinary crusade by earning cash rewards and tasty ingredients. These delectables hail from specific regions--which you'd do well to take note of. Once you've pooled sufficient funds, invest to break ground in new markets!
Persevere in the path of the pâtissier to eventually unlock secret features like the "Hall of Fame Challenge," in which you'll need to fill a flurry of fast orders, and "Recipe Lab," allowing you to step up the quality of your sweets.
But wait, there's more! Cherries on top include an online feature allowing friends from across the country to visit your personal cakery, as well as a "Truck Sales" mode allowing the pastry peddling to continue in real time--even while you sleep!
With a pinch of time and a dash of TLC, you'll agree... success was never so sweet!
--
Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games, or visit us at http://kaipa.jp. Be sure to check out the wildly popular Game Dev Story for your mobile device or PC as well as our collection of FREE games!

bluejetty:00040763:ios.name: Programa Mulher Fitness
bluejetty:00040763:ios.summary: O Programa Mulher Fitness é uma plataforma de treinos online específico para mulheres. O programa foi feito para resolver os principais objetivos do corpo feminino, como: secar barriga, tornear coxas, aumentar o glúteo, definir costas e bra
bluejetty:00040763:ios.description:
O Programa Mulher Fitness é uma plataforma de treinos online específico para mulheres. O programa foi feito para resolver os principais objetivos do corpo feminino, como: secar barriga, tornear coxas, aumentar o glúteo, definir costas e braços. Ele foi desenvolvido por uma das maiores e mais conhecidas treinadoras de mulheres do Brasil, a treinadora Amanda Biuger.
O PMF é um programa completo para você que treina em academia e também para você que treina em casa. Para você que busca o ganho de massa muscular (hipertrofia) e para você que busca eliminar gordura (emagrecimento). Tudo isso através de uma metodologia comprovada e premiada, onde já nos primeiros 30 dias você vai ver resultados incríveis no seu corpo e vai ficar muito motivada a continuar e não desistir como a maioria dos outros programas.
Conte com uma equipe multidisciplinar para te ajudar no dia a dia a chegar no seu objetivo! Além dos treinos, você terá um direcionamento nutricional, direcionamento psicológico, orientação e indicação de suplementos nutricionais para ajudar a chegar mais rápido no seu objetivo, e muito mais.
O APP Programa Mulher Fitness é um Aplicativo indispensável para você que é mulher e treina. Você tem toda uma prescrição de treino feita por uma das maiores treinadoras do Brasil e de acordo com o seu nível (iniciante, intermediário ou avançado) e seu objetivo (ganho de massa ou emagrecimento). Para todas as idades, todos os tipos de corpos (biotipos) e para quem também não tem muito tempo para se dedicar aos treinos.
Treina em academia? Tenha acesso a Planilhas de treinos revolucionárias, simples e intuitivas (fáceis de mexer), com vídeos mostrando o que fazer, qual aparelho treinar e como fazer o exercício com apenas um toque na tela do seu telefone.
Treina em casa? A Amanda faz o treino todo do início ao fim com você, através de videoaulas gravadas, onde você pode treinar no conforto da sua casa com aparelhos caseiros ou somente com o peso do próprio corpo, sem aparelhos.

bluejetty:00159133:ios.summary: Hear live radio broadcasts from real people around the world. All broadcasts are created with professional hardware or software – so you’re hearing quality content that sounds great. This is user-generated, professional radio. From DJ sets
bluejetty:00159133:ios.description:
Hear live radio broadcasts from real people around the world. All broadcasts are created with professional hardware or software – so you’re hearing quality content that sounds great. This is user-generated, professional radio. From DJ sets and live music performances to comedians riffing, gurus teaching, producers producing, pundits talking, journalists reporting, and more. 
Download the app, create a profile, explore broadcasts with Radio Mode, and find your new favorite. Follow the broadcaster, send them Fan Mail (and get a shareable keepsake when they respond!), and spread the love by sharing broadcasts with friends and family. 
Want to join the club and start YOUR radio show? Visit BlastRadio.com to pick up a Blast Box (broadcasting hardware) or the Blast Radio Desktop App or DAW plugin (broadcasting software). 
For listeners: 
* Listen to a broadcast LIVE or for 24 hours afterwards, before it expires forever 
* Show your love to broadcasters by sending them Fan Mail (a tip with a personal note). When they respond, you get a keepsake to save forever + share with friends and family 
* Blast Radio is better with friends – if you’re loving a broadcast, share it with a friend
* Broadcasters love feedback – smash the VIBE button when you love what they’re doing 
For broadcasters: 
* Share what you love in a low pressure environment where everything disappears in 24 hours 
* Stop trying to compete with memes and models on visual platforms - be heard! 
* Skip the pressure and technical challenges of video and lean into the sweet sounds of audio 
* Podcasts are hard… start a live radio show in minutes 
We’re constantly updating the app with new features based on feedback from our users. Tell us what we can improve: support@blastradio.com

bluejetty:00087017:ios.description:
AIA + là ứng dụng ra đời với mục tiêu cung cấp thông tin và dịch vụ hàng đầu trong lĩnh vực bảo hiểm thuộc Tập đoàn bảo hiểm nhân thọ AIA. AIA+ mong muốn được sự đồng hành với tất cả các khách hàng quan tâm đến bảo hiểm trên con đường bảo vệ sự phồn thịnh và an toàn tài chính của người dân. Do đó, chúng tôi không ngừng nổ lực cho ra mắt ứng dụng AIA+ với các tiện ích sau:
Đối tượng người dùng đa dạng, kể cả khi bạn không phải là khách hàng của AIA cũng có thể trải nghiệm ứng dụng. 
Dễ dàng tìm kiếm thông tin sản phẩm, các gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe và các sự kiện mà AIA tổ chức.
Theo dõi trạng thái và các thông tin liên quan đến hợp đồng ở bất cứ đâu, bất cứ lúc nào.
Tiện lợi, nhanh chóng với chức năng hỗ trợ đóng phí, nhắc phí dành cho khách hàng có hợp đồng.
Chương trình AIA Vitality được phát triển dựa trên các nghiên cứu khoa học đã được kiểm nghiệm thực tế trong việc giúp Khách Hàng sống Khoẻ hơn, Lâu hơn, Hạnh phúc hơn. Nhờ vào việc thay đổi lối sống, phòng bệnh và kiểm soát bệnh tật, AIA Vitality giúp cho Thành Viên cải thiện sức khoẻ một cách toàn diện và triệt để. 
Thành Viên Vitality được khuyến khích sống khoẻ hơn thông qua việc cải thiện chế độ dinh dưỡng, kiểm tra sức khoẻ và khám sàng lọc thường xuyên, hỗ trợ cai thuốc lá và đặc biệt là tăng cường vận động, theo dõi sức khỏe thông qua việc tích hợp các thiết bị/ứng dụng theo dõi sức khỏe (Apple Health, Strava, Garmin, Fibit, Polar, Suunto,…) và đồng bộ các dữ liệu như bước chân, nhịp tim, quãng đường, tốc độ và giấc ngủ.
Thông qua việc tham gia nhiều hoạt động chăm sóc và cải thiện sức khoẻ toàn diện xuyên suốt chương trình, Thành Viên sẽ được ghi nhận điểm Vitality. Hạng Thành Viên sẽ được xác định đựa trên số điểm tích luỹ này. Hạng Thành Viên càng cao, quyền lợi và giá trị phần thưởng càng lớn. ** 
Tuyên bố từ chối trách nhiệm: Ứng dụng AIA + không dành cho mục đích y tế và không thể thay thế chẩn đoán lâm sàng từ chuyên gia chăm sóc sức khỏe. Ứng dụng AIA + nhắm đến mục tiêu cải thiện nhận thức của người dùng về sức khỏe nói chung. Ứng dụng AIA+ không chẩn đoán, điều trị, giảm thiểu hoặc ngăn ngừa bất kỳ bệnh, triệu chứng, chứng rối loạn hoặc trạng thái thể chất bất thường nào. Tham khảo ý kiến của chuyên gia chăm sóc sức khỏe hoặc dịch vụ cấp cứu nếu bạn tin rằng bạn có thể gặp vấn đề cần được chăm sóc y tế.

bluejetty:00071324:ios.name: Spider Solitaire – Card Games
bluejetty:00071324:ios.summary: Spider Solitaire combines the original rules of one of the most popular classic card games with a set of exciting features. Enjoy a whole new experience with your favorite solitaire card game. Challenge your mind by playing Spider Solitaire
bluejetty:00071324:ios.description:
Spider Solitaire combines the original rules of one of the most popular classic card games with a set of exciting features. Enjoy a whole new experience with your favorite solitaire card game. Challenge your mind by playing Spider Solitaire, reach higher stages with every consecutive win, and beat your high score!
Spider Solitaire highlights:
- Classic gameplay
Stack the cards of a suit in descending order (from King to Ace) to win the game. Adjust the difficulty level by playing with 1, 2 or 4 suits.
- Keep your mind active
Train your brain and practice to reach higher stages and earn as many points as you can.
- Relax and unwind
Flip the switch from the daily grind to a relaxing pastime. Play the card game during your breaks or after a long work day wherever you are on your mobile device.
Spider Solitaire features:
- Various difficulty levels
Choose the number of suits - 1, 2 or 4 - to adjust the game to your experience, and have as much fun as you want.
- Stages
Master your strategy to win Spider Solitaire games, move to higher stages and beat your best score! The higher the stage you reach, the more points you get!
- Seasonal Events
Reveal unique pictures while playing card games of several difficulty levels. Complete Seasonal Events and build your own collection of specially crafted postcards!
- Daily Challenges
Earn trophies every month by playing Spider Solitaire challenges every day.
- Customizable cards and backgrounds
Choose from a variety of themes to help you stay focused and enjoy the game more.
- Hints and undos
Made a wrong move or unsure what to do in a game? Smart hints and undos will have you covered!
- Simple tap or drag controls
Enjoy a smooth experience by simply tapping or dragging cards.
- Auto-save
Continue playing where you left off.
- Left-hand mode
A special interface for left-handed people
Train your brain and have limitless fun on the way to beating your high score in Spider Solitaire!

bluejetty:00120519:ios.description:
Join over 100 million happy users. Challenge your brain and play with friends. Enjoy the most addictive quiz game!
Play QuizzLand for free! Discover 50,000 trivia questions in multiple languages.
HIGHLIGHTS
• fun for the entire family
• absorbing learning process
• fast lives’ refilling
• unique multiplayer and solo modes
• detailed explanation for each question
• easy, normal and hard difficulty levels
• challenging mind games
QuizzLand makes learning easy and fun!
HOW TO PLAY
•••••••••••••••
Each level consists of 21 trivia questions that cover a wide range of topics. To complete a level, you have to find the exit in a trivia maze.
All questions have a difficulty level, indicated by a number on each question’s card.
To answer a question, tap the correct option from the four options available. You can use one of the helpful hints to give you a clue or even eliminate some of the incorrect answer options.
MINI-GAMES
•••••••••••••
QuizzLand features a variety of fun and challenging intellectual games to improve your IQ, memory, intuition, concentration, attention, logic, and math skills. 
These games are available to play at different levels within the trivia maze.
DUELS AND BATTLES
•••••••••••••••••••••••
Test your knowledge and compete against other players in Quizland's thrilling game modes: 
Duel: race against a single opponent to answer 10 questions correctly
Group Battle: 10 questions, 3 random players and you - let’s see who’ll win!
Friends Battle: invite your friends to join in on the fun! 
STICKERS
•••••••••••
Collect stickers and fill albums with interesting, funny, and unusual facts about different countries. Stickers are earned as you go through the levels of the single player mode. Cards containing a sticker are marked with a special icon.
Show off your knowledge and collect as many stickers as possible to fill your albums with the most amazing facts about the world!
COMPETITIONS
••••••••••••••••••
Compete against other players from your country, all over the world, or with friends. Check out the daily, weekly and overall leaderboards in the Competitions section to see how well you’re doing compared to other players.
DAILY TASKS
••••••••••••••••••
Complete daily tasks to earn hints, lives and boosters to help you progress through the levels.

bluejetty:00075211:ios.description:
Paper Delivery Boy: Bike Delivery Drive Game
Join the adventure on wheels with Paper Delivery Boy, where your bicycle takes you on thrilling rides through bustling neighborhoods! 
Get ready for a dangerous ride through various districts, where your goal is to deliver newspapers and even tackle special delivery requests. Your trusty bicycle is your best companion as you toss papers to customers and help as many people as you can. But beware, the road is filled with obstacles!
- Exciting Gameplay:
Become the hero of your neighborhood as the friendly yet daring Paper Delivery Boy.
Pedal through varied districts, each with its unique challenges.
Toss newspapers with precision, complete special delivery requests, and dodge unexpected obstacles.
- Key Features:
1. Paper-Tossing Excitement:
Master the art of paper tossing as you cycle past homes, aiming for perfect deliveries. Navigate safely and ensure each newspaper and package reaches its rightful owner.
2. Special Delivery Requests: 
Keep an eye out for urgent parcels and special deliveries. The more boxes you carry, the bigger rewards you will receive.
3. Obstacle Course Adventure: 
The streets are alive with challenges, from roaming cars to busy pedestrians. React quickly to keep your delivery streak going.
4. Dynamic Environments: 
Explore diverse settings from serene suburban streets to chaotic urban.
Each area offers unique obstacles, from overpasses crowded with traffic to tricky trails lined with bustling markets.
5. Customizable Characters & Bikes:

bluejetty:00163617:ios.name: Patient Access
bluejetty:00163617:ios.summary:
Patient Access connects you to healthcare services when you need them most. Book GP appointments, order repeat prescriptions and explore your local pharmacy services. 
NEW: You can now create a Patient Access account without linking to you
bluejetty:00163617:ios.description:
Patient Access connects you to healthcare services when you need them most. Book GP appointments, order repeat prescriptions and explore your local pharmacy services. 
NEW: You can now create a Patient Access account without linking to your UK GP practice and enjoy the following features: 
• If you’re feeling under the weather, search for symptoms and find patient information articles 
• Self-refer to NHS services such as talking therapies, sexual health, antenatal care and drug and alcohol addiction services 
• Choose from over 30 services provided by your local community pharmacy and book in the app 
• Access and read medical advice and healthy living tips from the experts 
• Sign in quickly, easily and securely with Touch or Face ID 
• Swiftly check if you can link to your GP 
If you are able to link your Patient Access account to your GP practice, you can also get access to the following features where they are made available by your practice: 
• Book face-to-face or remote online appointments with your GP, nurse or clinician at a time that suits you 
• Request repeat prescriptions online, with convenient delivery to your preferred pharmacy 
• View your medical record, including test results, immunisations and allergies 
• Securely share your medical record with healthcare professionals of your choosing, without the need to contact your practice 
• Look after your loved ones and act on their behalf to book appointments and repeat prescriptions 
• Message your GP directly from within Patient Access at home or on the move 
• Where your practice has enabled it, book a remote video consultation with your GP, nurse or clinician 
You must be a registered patient at a participating practice to use the GP-linked features in Patient Access.

TouchArcade - 4.5/5 "Game with depth well beyond what
bluejetty:00000550:ios.description:
Pick up a magic sword and fight atop the Pillar of Sacrifice.
Master timing and positioning to push enemies off the edge.
How long can you survive to become the only one left standing?
TouchArcade - 4.5/5 "Game with depth well beyond what you would expect"
PocketGamer - 9/10 "A brilliantly paced, sharp-edged brawler "
One of the best hack and slash games on mobile, Only One is an epic arena style sword fighting game where you battle and push waves of enemies off the pillar in the sky with your magical sword. You don't fight for glory, you fight to survive! 
Skill Based Melee Combat
- Physics based combat with parry and push mechanics
- Fight swordsmen, archers, slimes, skeletons, bats, berserkers, loot gnomes, wizards and more
- Defeat enemies for their loot or knock them off the pillar for instant kills and extra points
- Collect health to stay alive and shields to block attacks
- Absorb the power of fallen enemies to grow stronger 
- 6 active abilities: push, freeze, dart, whirlwind, bubble and inferno
- 8 passive abilities: last stand, might, magnet, cripple, reflektor, bloodlust, regen and backstab
Game Modes
- Quest: Fight through 100 levels with bosses every 10 stages
- Endless: Survive against endless waves as long as you can
- Trials: Take on intense challenges, earn stars, and unlock new trials 
Unlock the Full Experience
- The “Ultimate Power” in-app purchase unlocks the complete game
Purchase unique character classes like the barbarian, ninja, valkyrie, dwarf and only one with unique abilities and weaknesses 
Retro pixel art graphics and music 
GameCentre leaderboards and achievements
Customizable controls: floating or fixed joystick
Full offline support
Gamepad compatible

bluejetty:00016676:ios.description:
The app can change your voice in real time: speaking to the microphone of the iOS device, the sync output in the speaker is changed voice. You can use fake gender voice:male/female. You can act as tom cat, squirrel, Darth Vader, etc. There are 11 live voices you can use. And even you can tune the tone color with a special designed 12-band equalizer to make the voices more natural. It gives you a chance to easily confuse your friend with phone calls, voice chats of game or social apps and so on. What you need are the app, another phone and a set of soundboxes.
It is also the live microphone which has 15 reverb effects. With the effects, your voice can be polished more beautiful. Plug your iOS device into a stereo system and then, use the foldback function with one of the reverb effects, you can do vocal exercises, get everyone's attention, make announcements.
It's a perfessional voice recorder too. With the voice-changing function and reverb effect function, you can record very special audio files. And you can share the audio to your friends with social apps. Even you can send the playing sound to your friends with talkback function of social apps.
It support bluetooth and airplay output device. There are a lot of fun with the app.

bluejetty:00155450:ios.name: Marriage Point Calculator MGPC
bluejetty:00155450:ios.summary:
Stop arguing over the score. MGPC keeps the points for Marriage, Callbreak (also known as Lakdi or Lakadi in parts of India) and Kitti so your table can get back to playing.
No sign-up. No account. No internet required.
THREE GAMES, PROPE
bluejetty:00155450:ios.description:
Stop arguing over the score. MGPC keeps the points for Marriage, Callbreak (also known as Lakdi or Lakadi in parts of India) and Kitti so your table can get back to playing.
No sign-up. No account. No internet required.
THREE GAMES, PROPERLY SUPPORTED
Marriage (Center Point Collection) — seen and unseen points, Murder, Kidnap, Dublee, Foul, and your own point rate.
Callbreak / Lakdi / Lakadi — calls and points per round, bonus rounds, double-on-minus, custom min/max calls.
Kitti — 9, 13 and 17 Kitti variants, with full call and bonus settings.
WORKS WITH ZERO SIGNAL
Your scores are saved on your iPhone, not in the cloud. Play on a rooftop, in a village, on a bus, or anywhere the signal drops — MGPC keeps counting. There is no login, nothing to sync, and nothing to wait for.
LET THE WHOLE ROOM FOLLOW THE SCORE
Streaming is what makes MGPC different. Start a live game, share a code or QR, and everyone watches the score update in real time.
• Friends follow along on their own phones
• Anyone can watch in a web browser — laptop, tablet or TV, with no app install
• Lock a game with a PIN to keep it private
• Hand hosting to another phone mid-game if your battery is dying
SHARE THE RESULT IN ONE TAP
Send the final table to your group chat as a clean image — not a cropped screenshot. Share from any scoreboard or leaderboard.
EVERYTHING YOU'D EXPECT, AND MORE
• Leaderboard with a top-three podium and exact win/loss amounts
• Overall summary across every round
• Game history — reopen and continue any past game
• Edit a past round when someone miscounted
• Add a player to a game already in progress
• Drag to reorder players
• 117 currencies, picked automatically from your region
• Light, dark and system themes
LEARNING MARRIAGE? START HERE
A full in-app guide covers the decks, dealing, sequences, Dublee, jokers, the play, declaring, and how scoring actually works — step by step, with an interactive scoring section.
BUILT FOR HOW WE ACTUALLY PLAY
MGPC was built around the way Marriage, Callbreak (also known as Lakdi or Lakadi in parts of India) and Kitti are really played in Nepal, India and Bhutan — the house rules, the point rates, and the argument about who owes what at the end of the night.
Dashain, Tihar, a wedding, or just a long evening with family and friends — MGPC keeps the record so nobody has to.
Free to use. Found it useful? Share it with the people you play with.

bluejetty:00159711:ios.description:
Welcome to Cals, the calorie counter designed with simplicity and efficiency at its core. In a world filled with overly complex health and fitness apps, Cals stands out by providing exactly what you need to track your calories, monitor your progress, and reach your weight loss goals. All without the unnecessary clutter.
Why Cals?
- Minimalist Design: Experience a clutter-free interface that makes tracking your daily calorie intake effortless. Cals intuitive design lets you add foods quickly and easily, streamlining your meal planning and tracking process.
- Focused Functionality: We believe in doing one thing exceptionally well. Cals focuses solely on helping you manage your calorie intake and supporting your weight loss journey. No distractions, just results.
- Quick Add Feature: Time is precious. That's why Cals allows you to add foods to your diary in seconds. Whether it's a barcode scan or a quick search, adding your meals is fast and straightforward.
- Privacy-Conscious: Your data belongs to you. Cals respects your privacy and ensures your data is securely stored, never shared without your consent.
Features:
- Snap to track! AI food recognition. 
- Easy-to-use Food Database: Access a comprehensive database to log your meals and snacks quickly.
- Barcode Scanner: Instantly add food items by scanning their barcode.
- Customizable Goals: Set personalized calorie goals based on your lifestyle and weight loss objectives.
- No Ads, No Distractions: Enjoy an uninterrupted experience focused entirely on your progress.
Join the Cals Community:
Embark on your weight loss journey with Cals and join a community of individuals who value simplicity and focus. Whether you're looking to shed a few pounds or transform your eating habits, Cals is here to support you every step of the way.
Download Cals today and take the first step towards a healthier, happier you.
Cals offers a $9.99 monthly renewing and a $34.99 yearly renewing subscription to unlock Premium functionality.
The purchase will be charged from your iTunes account if you choose to buy the Cals Premium subscription. You can manage or cancel your subscription through the user settings in iTunes after the purchase.
