bluejetty:00062170:ios.description:
A simple game of working cars!
Let's run two maps of "Jack-in-the-Box" and "Casual Drive" freely!
"Jack-in-the-Box" contains many puzzles such as dice, switches and building blocks.
“Casual Drive” is a map with roads that never end.
Drive along the road and hit obstacles ... do whatever you want!
There are 11 models. Including police cars, fire engines, ambulances, and garbage trucks.
Drive your favorite car!
Two operation modes ("joystick mode" and "touch mode") can be selected!
Play with the person who feels comfortable!
=== How to play ===
Swipe the screen to rotate the car and move towards the touched location.
Press the button on the lower right to switch cars.
Adjust the car speed with the button on the lower left.
If you press the upper left button while playing “Casual Drive”, other cars will be shown / hidden.
Click the menu button in the upper right to display the audio settings menu.

minimee – AI Journaling & Mood Tracker
Your AI-powered journal for mental health, self care & emotional growth
Meet minimee – AI Journaling & Mood Tracker, your intelligent and always-available companion designed to support your mind and emotions. More than just a Digital Diary, minimee combines the science of psychology with the power of artificial intelligence to guide you toward lasting emotional growth. Whether you want a safe space to reflect, a Mood Tracker Journal to better understand your ups and downs, or a trusted Self Care Journal that fits seamlessly into your life, minimee has you covered.
Support Your Mental Health with AI-Powered Journaling
Daily journaling has long been one of the most effective tools for clarity and resilience. With minimee, this tradition evolves into Guided Journaling that feels effortless. Intelligent prompts, thoughtful reflections, and adaptive suggestions transform blank pages into meaningful self-discovery. As your AI Mood Tracker, minimee learns from your entries, encouraging better habits and nurturing your emotional wellbeing day after day.
Mood Tracking & Emotional Awareness
Every day, your emotions tell a story. With minimee’s Wellness Tracker features, you can quickly log moods, triggers, and thoughts, turning your feelings into patterns you can actually understand. Acting as a Feelings Tracker, the app shows what energizes you, what drains you, and how your emotional cycles change over time. This powerful Mental Health Tracker helps you see beyond the moment, making it easier to take charge of your wellbeing.
Your AI Self Care Companion
minimee isn’t just a Self Care Journal; it’s a supportive presence in your pocket. Think of it as a Wellness Tracker and emotional sidekick that checks in with you, listens without judgment, and provides a fresh perspective when you need it most. Whether you’re experiencing stress, excitement, or uncertainty, minimee uses Daily Journaling as a foundation for self-care, balance, and resilience.
Smart Prompts That Grow With You
Some days you may feel talkative, other days quiet. That’s why minimee adapts to you. The Guided Journaling system offers tailored prompts that evolve as your journey continues. Whether you’re anxious, inspired, or simply reflective, minimee acts as your Digital Diary and AI Mood Tracker, always ready to help you process thoughts and emotions in ways that foster emotional growth.
Private, Secure & Judgment-Free
Your privacy matters. Every entry is encrypted, ensuring your Mood Tracker Journal and Feelings Tracker remain completely safe. With minimee, you can express yourself freely, knowing your Self Care Journal is for your eyes only. No pressure, no judgment—just space to be yourself.
Your mind matters. Your feelings belong.
There’s no freemium version. Once the trial ends, a subscription is required to access all features.
Subscriptions are managed via your iCloud account and can be updated or canceled anytime.
Terms of Use: [https://minimee.app/terms-of-use]
Privacy Policy: [https://minimee.app/privacy-policy]

bluejetty:00017109:ios.description:
A famous dwarven explorer has turned to stone while searching for the ancient lost Merfolk Kingdom, and you’ve been called in to investigate hidden objects games that will lead to the answer. You quickly find a dangerous foe waiting just beneath the waves, and they want vengeance! Can you stop an evil tyrant princess and her immortal generals from taking over the Secret City before it’s too late? Play a lot of hide & seek adventures to learn the truth in this exhilarating game of mystery games!
· SEE IF YOU CAN STOP A MADMAN FROM DESTROYING THE KINGDOM IN THE BONUS GAME!
The Merfolk invited you to take part in their elections, but a peaceful process turned into a nightmare when a cruel and bloodthirsty heir appears! Will you be able to stop him in this game of domini games?
· THE EVIL PRINCESS IS ABOUT TO REVIVE HER IMMORTAL GENERALS AND SEIZE POWER IN THE SECRET CITY!
Tenebris, the daughter of a peaceful Merfolk ruler, betrays her father and tries to seize power in the entire Secret City. Together with her 13 loyal Immortal Generals, she’ll be unstoppable! Will you come through all the hidden pictures in the adventure games and prevent her from reviving the Generals?
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HOPS AND MINI-GAMES, AND EARN A VARIETY OF ACHIEVEMENTS!
Play and replay your favorite mini-games, puzzles and free point & click games in this Collector’s Edition!
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Always know your next move and find the hidden artifacts and play hidden object adventure games! Address to the helpful Strategy Guide to explore the Secret City and be sure what to do next!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com

bluejetty:00035057:ios.description:
Welcome to Bubble Pop Star, experience the joy and relaxation of bubble shooter games amidst colorful bubbles.
Bubble Pop Star is suitable for everyone. Whether you've had a busy day and want to unwind or you're looking to challenge yourself and train your brain, don't miss out on this addictive bubble shooter puzzle game.
Ride on a small boat and start an amazing pop journey with the ultimate bubble shooter game in the galaxy of dreams! 
Are you prepared to pop bubbles and take on the shooter challenge? 
- Aim and shoot to pop 3 or more bubbles of the same color in this addictive bubble shooter pop adventure. 
- Clear the board by strategically eliminating bubbles with as few shots as possible and earn stars and rewards.
Experience Bubble Pop Star, the bubble shooter puzzle game that's both relaxing and exciting! 
- With its astonishing design, you'll be captivated by thousands of unique levels that provide endless bubble shooter fun and collect stars entertainment. 
- Immerse yourself in the delightful visuals and soothing sounds that are sure to relax your mind while you pop bubbles and match bubble colors. 
- Use powerful power-ups and creative elements to enhance your shooter gameplay and keep the pop excitement flowing.
This bubble shooter game isn't just a time killer; it's a brain-training experience! Challenge yourself to strategically pop bubbles, improve your shooting skills, and conquer increasingly challenging levels. Bubble Pop Star is the perfect combination of relaxation and challenge, making it suitable for players of all ages.
And the best part? It's completely free to play, with no network or energy restrictions, allowing you to enjoy the bubble-blasting action anytime and anywhere. So, whether you're looking for a quick and fun way to unwind or a stimulating puzzle to engage your mind, Bubble Pop Star has got you covered.
Your thoughts and suggestions matter to us! If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us at leejun@flyyestec.com. We're dedicated to providing assistance and making your experience even better.
Stay in the loop about the latest game updates by following the Bubble Pop Star Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/BubblePopStars/
Get ready to pop, shoot, and blast your way through a world of bubbles!

bluejetty:00046063:ios.description:
O App de Mensagens para Vendedores. Concretize vendas do início ao fim sem sair do chat com o seu cliente, desde o primeiro contato ao pagamento, entrega e avaliação final do cliente. Mantenha o comprador engajado o tempo todo durante a venda, melhorando a conversão de pedidos e a satisfação do seu cliente.
"Transformar uma simples conversa por celular em um negócio. Poder conversar sobre um produto ou ideia em um chat com fotos, montar um orçamento e receber o pagamento de produtos num mesmo aplicativo e que esse sistema seja tão fácil quanto um app de mensagens. Esse é o Talk7.”- E-Commerce News.
Tecnologia já utilizada por 8 milhões de usuários no Elo7. Nós não só acreditamos que este é o futuro como já mudamos todo o Elo7 para vender via mensagens. No momento disponível apenas para vendedores do Elo7, essa inovação em breve também estará ao alcance de suas mãos, solicite o seu acesso antecipado para o Talk7 em http://www.talk7.com/
Uma experiência de compra inédita que gera melhores negócios pra você:
- Maior Engajamento
Seu cliente se mantém engajado na compra através de uma interface de chat fácil e familiar para negociar, realizar pagamentos com segurança, acompanhar e avaliar seu pedido.
- Novo Jeito de Comprar Online
Experiência de compra intuitiva como usar um app de mensagens, mas com a personalidade e toque humano de uma venda ao vivo com toda a tecnologia do Talk7 para agilizar as suas vendas em cada etapa do processo.
- Mais Vendas e Maior Satisfação
O resultado pra você é uma maior conversão de vendas, satisfação dos seus clientes e maior probabilidade de recompra.
Baixe agora mesmo o Talk7 e boas vendas!
==========
Confira as principais funcionalidades do Talk7:
- Novo Jeito de Vender pelo Chat
Concretize vendas do início ao fim sem sair do chat como seu cliente, desde o primeiro contato ao pagamento, entrega e avaliação final do cliente.
- Compartilhe Fotos na Conversa
Envie fotos de artes, troque referências com o cliente, mostre um trabalho em andamento, poste a foto de um produto finalizado.
- Fácil como um Aplicativo de Mensagens
Saiba quando suas mensagens forem lidas através do duplo tique verde e arquive conversas para focar apenas nas que forem mais importantes.
- Notificações Onde Você Estiver
Seja notificado não só sobre novas mensagens mas também sobre atualizações do status dos seus pedidos desde a fase de carrinho até o frete, pagamento e avaliação do cliente.
- Sugestão de Produtos para o Comprador
Sugira produtos para complementar o carrinho do seu cliente direto de forma prática sem sair da conversa com o comprador.
- Estimativa e Cálculo do Frete
Se antecipe e estime o frete do comprador antes dele efetuar o pedido ou aguarde e calcule o frete depois que ele tiver se decidido, tudo isso direto na conversa com o cliente.
- Cadastro e Edição de Produtos
Faça o cadastro de novos produtos no Elo7 e edite os produtos já disponíveis na sua loja através do aplicativo Talk7.
- Responda e Compartilhe as Avaliações do Cliente
Veja as avaliações do comprador, responda rapidamente aos seus clientes e compartilhe as avaliações mais bacanas nas redes sociais.
==========
Ufa! Finalmente! Mesmo tendo passado por todos esses benefícios há várias funcionalidades que não estão listadas aqui e que você só vai conhecer quando utilizar o aplicativo. 
Então se você ainda não instalou o Talk7, baixe agora mesmo e aproveite todos os benefícios de gerenciar seus pedidos, mensagens e produtos, a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar.

bluejetty:00169421:ios.summary:
Thomas & Friends: Let’s Roll invites kids to drive their favorite engines and build their own tracks, fueling big imaginations and tons of hands-on fun. Perfect for preschoolers ages 2-6 and thoughtfully made for all kids to enjoy! 
• Driv
bluejetty:00169421:ios.description:
Thomas & Friends: Let’s Roll invites kids to drive their favorite engines and build their own tracks, fueling big imaginations and tons of hands-on fun. Perfect for preschoolers ages 2-6 and thoughtfully made for all kids to enjoy! 
• Drive around the Island of Sodor to enjoy lots of exciting journeys! 
• You can pick a different engine for each journey, including Thomas, Bruno, Percy, and more. 
 Even very young children can enjoy a rewarding driving experience with our kid-friendly driving controls.
• The TRACK BUILDER feature lets you build a train track and drive a toy train on it! 
• You can enhance your track with lots of fun and interesting scenery options. 
• Watch your trains chug along the track and the landscape you created! 
• This app helps kids develop spatial awareness, fine motor skills, and self-expression. 
FUN FOR EVERYONE 
Designed for ALL kids, (especially little neurodivergent engineers) this app brings expert input from autistic writer Jody O'Neill to create a playful, inclusive experience. Kids set their own pace, are offered clear choices, and can safely explore alongside Bruno the Brake Car, a neurodivergent friend from Sodor. Designed for repeated play sessions, this app will offer joy and comfort to kids, over and over again! 
JOURNEYS 
The Old Mine, Whiff’s Recycling Plant, Norramby Beach, McColl’s Farm, and Winter Wonderland 
CHARACTERS 
Thomas, Bruno, Gordon, Percy, Nia, Diesel and Kana
FEATURES 
- Safe and age-appropriate
- Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age
- Play pre-downloaded content offline without Wi-Fi or internet
- Regular updates with new content
- Apple Family Sharing for easy subscription sharing with other family members
- No third-party advertising
- No in-app purchases for subscribers
SUPPORT
For any questions or assistance, please reach out to us at support@storytoys.com.
ABOUT STORYTOYS
Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.
PRIVACY & TERMS 
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy.
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms/
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS 
This app contains sample content that is free to play. However, LOTS MORE fun and entertaining games and activities are available if you purchase a monthly or yearly subscription. While you are subscribed you can play with EVERYTHING. We regularly add new stuff, so subscribed users will enjoy ever-expanding play opportunities.
• Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually according to the rate of the selected subscription plan.
• You can change your mind at any point. Cancelling can be done through your iTunes settings.
• Your subscription will auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package unless you cancel it 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscription fees are charged to your iTunes account.
• After purchase, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings.
• When you purchase a subscription, you forfeit any unused portion of a free trial period.
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with the same Apple ID that you subscribed from. 
© 2026 Gullane (Thomas) Limited. The Thomas name and character and the Thomas & Friends™ logo are trademarks of Gullane (Thomas) Limited and its affiliates and are registered in many jurisdictions throughout the world.

bluejetty:00157629:ios.description:
Discover the joy of creativity and puzzle-solving with "Animal Sticker Book: Cute Pet Puzzle," an engaging and colorful sticker puzzle app. This unique game blends the tranquil art of coloring with the excitement of puzzle-solving, creating a relaxing yet stimulating experience for players of all ages.
Unique Puzzle Gameplay: Dive into a world where each sticker is a piece of a larger picture. Arrange stickers of adorable animals like cats, dogs, and pandas in their designated spots to complete beautiful scenes. It’s not just about placing stickers; it’s about creating art.
Vibrant and Artistic: Each level is a canvas waiting to be filled with color and life. The game features beautifully illustrated animals and scenes, appealing to anyone with a love for art and design.
Stress-Relief Experience: Designed to provide a calming effect, the game is perfect for unwinding. The simple yet engaging task of sticker placement offers a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
Cognitive Skill Development: While relaxing, players also enhance important skills such as spatial awareness, attention to detail, and pattern recognition. It’s a fun and effective way to boost brain power.
Endless Levels: With a multitude of sticker puzzles to solve, players are guaranteed endless hours of enjoyment. Each completed puzzle is not just a win but a beautiful piece of sticker art.
Suitable for Everyone: The game is designed to be accessible and enjoyable for players of all ages. It’s an excellent choice for families seeking a shared activity or for individuals in search of a relaxing pastime.
Embark on a delightful journey of creativity and calm with "Animal Sticker Book: Cute Pet Puzzle." Download now and start your adventure in this charming world of sticker puzzles!

bluejetty:00014011:ios.description:
Deputy is the ultimate employee scheduling app, shift planner, staff timesheet app, & complete workforce management solution. Get started for free today!
Over 250,000 workplaces in 90+ countries trust Deputy for their employee scheduling software, leave management, time & attendance tracking, team task management, staff communication, demand forecasting and performance management.
HOW DEPUTY HELPS BUSINESSES
◆ Easily create balanced, cost-effective schedules in minutes from any device.
◆ Publish personalized shift information to your team via push notification, email, and SMS.
◆ Fill open shifts easily by pushing alerts to your team and letting them pick up available shifts.
◆ Approve leave from your mobile easily so you're never caught off guard.
◆ Quickly approve employee shift swaps and shift changes in seconds straight from a mobile device.
◆ Manage team communications easily in one place: broadcast announcements, assign tasks to specific individuals / shifts, and get confirmation that your team has seen it.
◆ Get greater insight and control of your business, and keep yourself compliant with inbuilt fair workweek compliance.
◆ Connect with your existing apps to give you end-to-end visibility. Deputy syncs with over 300+ of the world's most used solutions such as ADP, Square, QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, NetSuite, Revel, LightSpeed and many more!
HOW DEPUTY HELPS EMPLOYEES
◆ Get your work schedule on your device as soon as it’s published.
◆ View all your upcoming shifts in one place and receive alerts on days when you’re due to work.
◆ Manage your availability and time off easily, see what’s approved, and make it simple for your manager to know when you are and aren’t available.
◆ Clock in and out of work quickly from the app.
◆ See important company updates, manage your tasks and communicate with your team from your mobile device.
TRY DEPUTY TODAY
Setting up your business? Sign up for a free trial today.
No setup fee. Pick the plan to suit your business: monthly, annually or flexi.
Always know that you have the right people scheduled with our Shift Planner: Deputy makes it easy to create fully costed schedules in minutes, then notify staff when they’re working. Deputy will even automatically remind employees of their shifts on the morning that they are due to work.
Manage employees’ leave requests or unavailability from a central location, then integrate with your online schedules so there’s no risk of scheduling someone who is not available.
Need to be smart about staffing levels? Deputy integrates with your POS & payroll information to make sure you’re scheduling efficiently, and pulls in real-time weather information so you know if you need extra shifts or not!
Clocking in to work is made simple with our time clock software, including GPS validation, to quickly track time and attendance (or optionally from a tablet Kiosk, using our inbuilt facial detection technology).
Finalizing your timesheets and exporting to payroll can be done with one click from your mobile device.
Joining an existing team? It's free - just log in.
CUSTOMER TESTIMONIALS
“Straightaway, the time and attendance headache disappeared. There’s no need to manually enter data from one system to another. It’s all uploaded effortlessly. And on our tablets or phones, we can sign off timesheets with a swipe."
"Everyone gets alerted to their shifts, which they can check on their smartphones. Everyone knows where they should be, when they should be there and what they should be doing."
"Deputy has been a revelation for our business. We’re saving approximately $30,000 a year in admin costs alone. But even more importantly, we’re now able to optimize all shifts and staffing levels."
ABOUT DEPUTY APP
Our staff scheduling app is updated regularly to make sure we’re always providing the best and most flexible features to the businesses we work with.
Any feedback? Need help? Email experience+ios@deputy.com
Terms of Use: https://www.deputy.com/subscription-agreement

Find your adventurous spirit, get off the beaten path and discover unique places to experience near and far, all contributed by Atlas Obscura’s global community of explorers. 
---
EXPLORE THE MAP
We’ve plotted the entire Atlas Obscura database in a single map, allowing you to easily find unique places nearby or to help plan your next trip.
GET THE BACKSTORY
Learn what makes each place so unique. Each entry has detailed information, photos, and tips from the community.
PLAN & TRACK YOUR ADVENTURES
Create custom lists to organize your itinerary or bucket list. Also, use the “Been There” feature to track your progress exploring the wondrous world of Atlas Obscura.
BROWSE BY INTEREST
Explore Atlas Obscura by whatever fascinates you. From history and architecture to art and natural wonders, get lost in the never-ending collection of off-the-beaten-path places.
For bug reports or suggestions, email us at appfeedback@atlasobscura.com or click the "App Support" button below to open our contact form.
Stay curious,
Atlas Obscura

bluejetty:00149748:ios.description:
Get the freshest deals on groceries and the easiest shopping experience with the Schnucks Rewards app! Find Personalized Savings on your favorite items, easily locate items in store, order curbside pickup and more—all with one easy-to-use app. 
Earn and Redeem Rewards: Get 2% back on every purchase, track your Points balance and redeem Rewards to lower your grocery bill.†
Order Delivery and Curbside: Have groceries delivered right to your doorstep or schedule a curbside pickup when it makes sense for your schedule.†
View the Weekly Ad: Use our interactive ad to shop the hottest deals at your local Schnucks. Tap on items to view details, add to list or cart, find related deals and more. Updated weekly with new savings!
Just Ask Schnucks: Chat with the Schnucks helper, our AI assistant that can provide meal plans, savings suggestions, cooking tips, wine pairings, store support and more.
Shop Personalized Savings: Created just for you, this section is a one-stop shop for sales, bonus Points offers and coupons on the items you buy most.
Browse 100s of Digital Coupons: Find coupons by searching, scanning or sorting by category, then clip them with a single tap. Checkout with Rewards and we’ll apply them to your next purchase for you. 
Maximize Your Rewards With Boosts: These app-only offers boost your shopping trips so you can earn more Rewards by buying eligible items over time. 
Order Ahead Services: Order Deli meat and cheese cut to order, custom cakes and party platters. We’ll have your order ready for pickup whenever is best for you.†
Shop Floral Delivery: Browse our wide selection of beautiful bouquets and order floral delivery whenever it’s convenient for you.†
Search and My List: Easily find items by aisle, section and shelf with search. Scan items or use search to build your shopping list, organized by aisle to make shopping a breeze.
Recipes: Spice up your usual menu with recipe inspiration from our library! Sort recipes by category or search for specific dishes. When you find one you like, quickly add items to your list or cart.
† Restrictions apply. Availability of delivery, curbside and order ahead services varies by store.
By clicking INSTALL or GET, you consent to the installation of the Schnucks application and any updates or upgrades thereto and agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy found on http://schnucks.com

Dinosaur Bus: A Mesmerizing Adventure for Kids
Set your child's imagination free with the enchanting world of the Dinosaur Bus! Dive into a vibrant adventure designed specifically for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergarteners. With mesmerizing colors, shapes, and unique decorations, this game offers an environment that fosters learning and creativity, making it one of the standout bus games for kids.
Features:
Customizable Buses: Tailor your adventure by choosing bus styles, colors, and dazzling decorations, enriching kids' exposure to colors and shapes.
Dynamic Routes: Navigate through diverse terrains – from deep seas to sandy dunes, keeping your young ones engaged and intrigued.
Engaging Activities: Collect treasures, meet friendly passengers, and overcome delightful obstacles, instilling problem-solving and strategic thinking.
Child-Centric Design: Crafted for kids aged 2-5, ensuring a child-friendly interface without any third-party ads.
Offline Play: The game offers offline functionality, ensuring uninterrupted fun wherever you are.
Educational Element: While children navigate this bus game, they're also exposed to learning games that touch on Pre-K activities, making it more than just car or truck games.
About Yateland:
Yateland designs apps with a blend of fun and learning, emerging as a beacon in educational games. Ensuring an amalgamation of fun and learning, Yateland proudly stands by its motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Delve deeper into the world of Yateland at Yateland's website.
Privacy Policy:
At Yateland, your child's privacy is our utmost priority. We adhere to stringent measures to ensure a safe and secure gaming environment. For a comprehensive overview of our privacy practices, please visit Yateland's Privacy Policy.

bluejetty:00036242:ios.description:
Embark on an epic journey in the post-apocalyptic world, where survival is the ultimate goal. State of Survival: Front War offers a thrilling mix of strategy, survival, and intense shooting action. As the last hope for humanity, you must build a formidable defense line, fend off the relentless waves of the undead, and battle through the dark and unforgiving winter.
In this authentic sequel to State of Survival, you will face the chilling whiteout of a world engulfed in war. Gather your allies and join forces with players from around the globe to stand strong against the relentless onslaught of the undead hordes. The fate of humanity rests on your shoulders as you fight for survival in this brutal and unforgiving world.
Key Features:
Build and fortify your base, creating an impenetrable stronghold against the horrors of the undead.
Engage in strategic shootouts, utilizing your arsenal to fend off the relentless waves of enemies.
Form alliances with players worldwide, forging a united front against the darkness that threatens to consume the world.
Experience the harsh realities of survival in a world gripped by war and the unyielding cold of a never-ending winter.
Prepare for the ultimate test of strength and resilience in State of Survival: Front War. Will you emerge victorious, or will you succumb to the darkness that engulfs the world? The choice is yours.

Pick the balls along Join Balls to merge numbers.
Swipe Left and right and pick every ball to achieve the number 2048

bluejetty:00100327:ios.description:
Cleanly AI: AutoPhotoClean – Smart Photo & Contact Cleaner
Cleanly AI: AutoPhotoClean brings you a smarter, easier way to clean your device. Powered by advanced AI detection, it quickly finds similar or duplicate photos and unwanted content, helping you tidy up your gallery with one tap. It also manages your contacts by identifying duplicates or missing information for easy cleanup.
Main Features
Smart Photo & Video Cleanup
- Similar Photo Cleanup: AI identifies similar shots and burst photos, helping you keep the best ones.
- Duplicate Image Removal: Detects fully identical images to safely delete extras.
- Repeated Photo Cleanup: Deep scan to remove unnecessary repeated photos and free up space.
- Blurry Photo Cleanup: Automatically detects blurred or low-quality photos so you can clean them instantly.
- Similar Video Cleanup: Finds videos with similar scenes or repeated captures to help free up large storage space.
- AI Photo Categorization: Automatically sorts photos by content type to keep your gallery organized.
Contact Management
- Duplicate Contact Cleanup: Find and merge contacts with repeated information.
- Missing Contact Fix: Detects contacts missing names, numbers, or emails so you can complete them quickly.
Subscription Plans
Cleanly AI offers the following subscription options:
- $9.99/week — Weekly Subscription
- $34.99/year — Yearly Subscription 
Subscribing unlocks all premium features, including:
 - Full AI photo & video cleanup suite
 - Blurry photo detection
 - Similar video detection
 - Advanced contact repair tools
 - Unlimited usage
 - Priority feature updates
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period.
Policies & Agreements

Terms of Use：https://www.watchfacelab.com/CleanlyAI/terms
Subscription Terms：https://www.watchfacelab.com/CleanlyAI/subscription

bluejetty:00116685:ios.description:
No more going to bed disappointed in yourself.
Your custom 66-day plan says exactly what to do.
Feel better about yourself by tomorrow.
You already know what you need to do. Give us 66 days, and you'll be the type of person who follows through.
No more waiting to feel like it.
No more starting over.
By tomorrow, you'll have done what you said you'd do.
--------------------
CHAPTER 1 · YOUR CUSTOM PLAN
It shows you exactly what to do, one step at a time.
Plan tomorrow tonight. Do the hardest thing first.
Block what distracts you. Build habits that last.
It's what all the discipline books say, built right into your day.
--------------------
CHAPTER 2 · WHY 66 DAYS
It takes about 66 days for a new habit to stick.
Miss a day? Just pick up where you left off.
By day 66, discipline isn't something you force.
It's who you are.
--------------------
CHAPTER 3 · FROM MORNING TO NIGHT
Wake up to a day you planned last night.
When it's time to start, a real alarm rings. Not a notification you'll swipe away.
Do your most important task first, and Focus Mode hides the rest.
Start a timer and lock in until it runs out.
Block the apps wasting your life.
Stop watching strangers win. Start winning yourself.
Plans change? Reschedule in a tap.
Every night, we'll remind you to plan tomorrow.
Then go to bed proud of yourself.
--------------------
Join 34,000+ people who felt just like you and finally did something about it.
You're next.
--------------------
Full access to features is available with an active subscription.
Terms of Service
https://planup.today/terms
Privacy Policy
https://planup.today/policy

bluejetty:00106761:android.description:
FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Explore the story of the former student of Professor Child, who comes to her mentor's aid following his mysterious disappearance on a quest to uncover the secrets of the philosopher's stone.
Embark on a wonderful adventure which will lead you to an island inhabited by a mysterious order. Face a dangerous enemy trying to claim an unbelievably powerful ancient artifact and save your mentor!
TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
The heroine gets a request for assistance from Professor Child, her mentor and long-time friend. She soon discovers that he had been kidnapped and that his disappearance is connected to the search for a powerful ancient artifact – the philosopher's stone.
Her only clue is a magical medallion which leads her to the island of Cannon Rock, the seat of the ancient Order of the Rose. During her investigation she learns that the artifact is also sought by evil powers who will stop at nothing to claim it for themselves. 
In order to save her mentor and find the philosopher's stone, Professor Child's most talented pupil will have to prove her intellect and mettle while exploring the gloomy island and solving numerous puzzles.
Can she defeat the dark powers who also seek the artifact?

• Visit 37 dark, atmospheric locations!
• Complete 31 intriguing mini-games!
• Earn 24 challenging achievements!

bluejetty:00131428:ios.description:
Welcome to the GoOutdoors North Carolina app! This free application is designed to enhance your outdoor experience in North Carolina by providing useful tools and information at your fingertips. Here's what you can expect from our app:
Convenient License Management: Store your license products on your phone and easily sync recent purchases. Keep all your licenses organized in one place for quick and easy access.
Hunting and Fishing Resources: Access up-to-date hunting and fishing regulations, season and bag information, and comprehensive fishing details. Stay informed and plan your outdoor activities accordingly.
Timely Sunrise/Sunset and Moon Phases: Take advantage of our location-based Sunrise/Sunset timer and Moon Phases feature, ensuring you have accurate information for planning your outdoor adventures.
Prime Wildlife Feeding Times: Discover the best times for wildlife viewing and hunting with our prime wildlife feeding times feature. Maximize your chances of spotting wildlife during their active periods.
Online & Offline Hunter Reporting: Report your hunting activities conveniently through our online and offline app. Ensure compliance with reporting requirements and contribute to wildlife management efforts.
Please note that some application features require internet access to provide real-time information and updates. We continuously work to improve the app and add new features based on user feedback. We value your input, so please don't hesitate to share your ideas for improvements and future features.

bluejetty:00146824:ios.description:
It’s Christmas Eve in our hidden object games, and you’re a pretty doll that a little girl chose as her present. You can’t wait to get to your owner Frances, but one of Santa’s elves thinks you belong to the District of the Broken Toys! Unite with other toys in adventure games and escape from the factory! Start a long adventure of hide & seek games on your way to Frances. Be careful, as lots of obstacles and difficulties are lurking in the real world. However, friendship and your strong desire to make a girl happy will overcome everything. Will you manage to jump inside Frances’s present box before the clock strikes twelve? Play these gripping hidden objects game and find out!
· ENJOY THE FANCY CHRISTMAS ATMOSPHERE!
Our fun game is going to envelop you in a cozy and comforting atmosphere of an approaching holiday. Get yourself a cup of hot cocoa and dive into this Christmas adventure with hidden pictures!
· GATHER INTERESTING TREATS AND OTHER COLLECTIONS! 
Replay your favorite search & find games and mini-games, solve fun puzzles and gather collectibles, cleverly hidden throughout the game!
· COOL ACHIEVEMENTS, WALLPAPERS, CONCEPT ARTS, AND MORE!
These hidden object games for iPad & iPhone has plenty of extras for you to enjoy! Earn cool achievements, and download exclusive wallpapers, concept arts, music, and more!
· HELP YOUR TOY MASTER TO REMOVE HIS TIRING ENCHANTMENT IN THE BONUS CHAPTER! 
After you play through the main story of our hidden object games, you can embark on a new adventure in a bonus game! Can you manage to remove the enchantment and find hidden object adventure? You’ll need all your wits and courage!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00127838:ios.description:
Encamera is the ultimate privacy-focused camera and photo vault app designed to keep your personal photos and videos safe. Unlike other photo lockers and private photo apps, Encamera offers a sleek, minimalist interface paired with top-tier privacy features, ensuring your memories are secure.
Key Features:
• Encrypted Photo Vault: Encamera automatically locks photos by encrypting all media you add or capture from the camera, storing them securely on your device or your personal iCloud. No third-party servers, no data tracking—just pure privacy.
• Advanced Security: Protect your vault with Face ID, PIN protection, and robust encryption. You control where your data is stored and who can access it.
• Minimalist Design: Encamera is built for simplicity. Capture and organize your private photos and videos with ease, all within a beautifully designed interface.
Why Choose Encamera?
• Capture & Encrypt Instantly: Snap photos directly from the app or widget, bypassing your default gallery for true privacy.
• No Account Needed: Enjoy total privacy without needing to sign up or provide your email.
• Ad-Free & No Data Tracking: Encamera respects your privacy—no ads, no tracking, ever.
• Local & iCloud Storage Options: Store your photos locally or on your personal iCloud—your choice, album by album.
• Open Source & Transparent: Encamera’s code is open for review by anyone who wants to ensure our privacy-first promise.
Uses for Encamera:
• Hide Photos: Keep sensitive images out of your main gallery and away from prying eyes.
• Secure Document Storage: Encrypt and store personal documents safely.
• Everyday Media Protection: Safeguard all your media with ease.
Basic Features:
• Private Camera: Take photos and videos directly within Encamera without saving them to your photos app.
• Quick Capture Widget: Snap photos from your lockscreen for instant privacy.
• Organize Securely: Sort your encrypted images and videos into custom folders.
• Import & Encrypt: Bring photos from your gallery into your secure vault with ease.
• Live Photo Support: Capture and view Live Photos, fully protected.
Encamera Premium:
Unlock even more with Encamera Premium:
• Unlimited Photo Storage: Store as many encrypted photos as you need.
• Unlimited Albums: Organize your memories without limits.
• iCloud Storage: Backup and access your secure albums from anywhere.
Premium Subscription Options:
• Yearly Subscription: Billed annually with a 7-day free trial.
• Monthly Subscription: Flexible month-to-month access.
• Weekly Subscription: Flexible week-by-week access.

Lifetime Limited will allow you to access all current and future updates of the app for one year. bluejetty:00016847:ios.description:
I Have Never is a party game created for party animals, college students, college dropouts, bachelorettes, and all the other party people that want to start their night with a blast. It started millions of parties worldwide, and your party is next.
I Have Never will help you learn just how crazy your friends are. These questions are sexier, dirtier, and darker than what you are used to, so prepare for an awesome night of learning unexpected things about your friends. 
I Have Never can be played offline, without WIFI, and it consists of a bunch of cards you read to your friends.
This game was created so you and your boring friends don’t have to come up with the dirty, funny, and sick cards yourself.
-----! FEATURES !-----
- 1600+ Cards
- 12 Packs
- Hours of getting to know your friends
- For 2 players minimum
- Unlimited fun
- Hating or loving your friends in the end
- Some public embarrassment and disappointment
-----! HOW TO PLAY !-----
- Grab some friends and sit in a circle (or stand, or don't be in a circle, who cares).
- Read the sentences out loud.
- Everyone who did it, does a punishment (do pushups, eat broccoli or whatever the group decides).
If you're the only one who did it, tell the story behind the experience. 
"Now I know all of my friends are horrible human beings and I can't look them in the eye but it was fun so I guess it was worth it"
I Have Never offers a 3-day free trial, after which a weekly subscription is required to continue playing. The game cannot be played without an active subscription or free trial.

You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings. If you cancel during the trial period, you will not be charged. After canceling auto-renewal, you will retain access to the game’s features until the end of the current payment period.
Please note, there is no free version of I Have Never beyond the 3-day trial. A subscription is required to continue using the game after the trial expires.

bluejetty:00100092:ios.summary: ARtie Lab: AR Drawing & Sketch brings your creativity to life with the power of augmented reality. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced artist, this innovative drawing app helps you sketch, trace, and paint anything you imagine right
bluejetty:00100092:ios.description:
ARtie Lab: AR Drawing & Sketch brings your creativity to life with the power of augmented reality. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced artist, this innovative drawing app helps you sketch, trace, and paint anything you imagine right on real surfaces.
Using your phone’s camera, ARtie Lab projects virtual outlines onto any paper or object, guiding your hand as you draw. Just place your device above the surface, follow the lines, and create stunning sketches step by step.
Discover a New Way to Draw
Turn your surroundings into a creative workspace. With ARtie Lab, every flat surface becomes your personal canvas. Choose from a wide selection of themed categories like Animals, Cars, Nature, People, and more — or import your own photos to start tracing immediately.
Key Features
- AR Drawing Made Simple: Project images in augmented reality and follow their outlines with ease.
- Import Your Own Images: Upload photos from your gallery to transform them into traceable sketches.
- Learn to Draw: Practice your skills with guided outlines and improve your hand coordination naturally.
- Creative Categories: Explore a growing library of drawing templates across multiple styles and subjects.
- Adjust and Control: Move, resize, or rotate the projected image for the perfect fit.
- Flashlight Support: Draw anytime, anywhere — even in low-light conditions.
- Save & Share: Capture your finished masterpiece and share it with friends or on social media.
Unleash Your Inner Artist
ARtie Lab isn’t just another drawing app — it’s your creative companion. Whether you want to learn to draw, trace art, or simply express yourself through sketching, ARtie Lab turns your imagination into real artwork. The app combines technology and creativity, making ar drawing, ar paint, and sketching easier and more inspiring than ever.
Why You’ll Love It
- Perfect for improving your drawing technique or learning the basics.
- Works great for both kids and adults who love art and creativity.
- Simple interface and smooth AR projection for a natural experience.
- A fun and educational way to explore drawing in augmented reality.
Turn your ideas into art, your imagination into sketches, and your creativity into reality.
Start your artistic journey today with ARtie Lab: AR Drawing & Sketch — the future of drawing is here.

Terms of Use: https://www.tenetapps.com/terms-of-use-artie-app

bluejetty:00124100:ios.name: Outlanders
bluejetty:00124100:ios.summary: Outlanders is a charming town-builder simulation game that lets you play as the leader of a group of regular people building a town together. Some want to survive, while others want to build amazing things. It’s up to you to guide them towa
bluejetty:00124100:ios.description:
Outlanders is a charming town-builder simulation game that lets you play as the leader of a group of regular people building a town together. Some want to survive, while others want to build amazing things. It’s up to you to guide them towards their goal.
Take control of the will of a town leader and balance your resources carefully to lead the town to prosperity. Every choice you make directly affects the progress of your town and has an impact on the happiness of your followers.
Features:
- Play through a series of distinct levels, each with its own unique flavour and set of challenges to overcome, with many more to come soon.
- Engaging gameplay with no hand-holding! Carefully manage your resources and keep your followers happy or they might revolt!
- Crisp and clean audio-visual style with an atmospheric touch that lingers with you after you put the game down.
- Light but rich storytelling follows the tales of different town leaders in their search for a hassle-free natural lifestyle.
- A wide selection of buildings to choose from, with specific functions that are vital to the success of your community.
- Decree system lets you make the tough decisions, granting you a useful bonus in exchange for a small sacrifice.

• Tap and Swap into anyone: put your face into trending videos, movie stills, or character art — just pick a picture from our collection and go. 
• Turn photos into aı face swap videos with viral AI filters. 
• AI Singing — make your photo sing, animate faces with your favorite songs and lipsync.

• Hair color changer — preview natural shades, bold fashion colors, and grey tones.

• Men’s haircut collection — curated short and long styles.

AI PHOTO GENERATOR
• Tap once to transform — Viking, warrior, scream‑queen, or showstopper; dozens of AI filters to create hilarious, show‑stopping edits.

• Pet Filters Collection — see your pet scream down a rollercoaster or rock a full‑denim look with super‑realistic, funny face filters.

• Rehair Salon integration — swap into total new looks and styles.

• AI Avatars: Craft custom AI avatars in different styles.

• Baby Generator: Generate future baby photos.

bluejetty:00071508:ios.name: Journeyman Plumber Exam Prep
bluejetty:00071508:ios.summary:
An application to prepare and practice for the written exam conducted by states for journeyman plumber to be certified or licensed.
Do you want to become a certified or licensed journeyman plumber? You need to pass a written exam conducted
bluejetty:00071508:ios.description:
An application to prepare and practice for the written exam conducted by states for journeyman plumber to be certified or licensed.
Do you want to become a certified or licensed journeyman plumber? You need to pass a written exam conducted by designated department of a state.
Journeyman Plumber Exam Prep is an app that serves as a study guide to those who are preparing for the Master Plumber Examination or Journeyman Plumber written examination. The questions are designed from official Plumbing Codes material.
HOW TO BECOME A JOURNEYMAN PLUMBER?
A person is considered to be a journeyman plumber or journey worker once they have finished the minimum four or five years of apprenticeship training to work independently. These experts are employed in both residential and business settings, where they work with water and drainage systems. This involves the installation and maintenance of gas lines and sewage disposal systems, in addition to any fixtures or appliances in the kitchen, bathroom, or laundry room. 
The next step in the process of becoming a journeyman plumber is to demonstrate that you are capable of passing the exam. After you have finished all of your required schooling, you should be able to sit for the journeyman's plumbing exam offered by your state. Make some inquiries at the labour department in your state or at the local chapter of the labour union to find out when and where you may take the test. If you finished your plumbing apprenticeship through a private plumbing company, you will need to receive an affidavit that proves you have met the standards of the state and are eligible. This affidavit can be obtained by contacting the state's department of labour and industries. 
You will not be permitted to take the journeyman's exam if you have not finished all of the hours required for your apprenticeship, which includes both classroom and on-the-job training. 
The majority of the questions on the exam will be multiple choice, and they will include plumbing codes from the state, federal, and local levels, as well as questions pertaining to maintenance and repair, and will test your overall understanding of plumbing systems. There is also the possibility of a hands-on, practical component, in which you will be required to demonstrate your proficiency with various tools and plumbing equipment. Having completed your apprenticeship, you should, on the other hand, be very well prepared for the test once it comes around.
Features of Journeyman Plumber Exam Prep App : 
PRACTICE TESTS:
You can go through various categories and practice huge number of questions so that you are well prepared for your exam.
MOCK TEST:
Once you have done enough practice with the questions in different categories, you can Take a quick mock test to check your knowledge on the various subjects like Plumbing Terms, Blueprint Reading, Pipe Fitting, Plumbing System, Plumbing Code and other plumbing topics.
PROGRESS MONITOR:
Our app will keep the history of the practice questions you have attempted which will give you an indication whether you are well prepared for the exam or not.
BOOKMARK QUESTIONS:
You can bookmark the questions which you think are important or you want to refer them later.
READ ALL QUESTIONS
If you have just started preparation for the examination or you are a beginner you can first real all questions and then practice or take mock test.
Who should use this app?
Anyone who wants to prepare for journeyman plumber examination and wants to get certified or licensed in different states of USA, Australia and Canada. This app comes very handy when preparing for the journeyman plumber test.

bluejetty:00023357:ios.description:
DISCOVER THE MAGIC OF GABBY’S DOLLHOUSE 
Join Gabby and her friends in the a-meow-zing new Gabby’s Dollhouse app! Fully redesigned with 8 cat-tastic rooms full of fun and surprises, there’s so much to do in the new and improved dollhouse. Check the Meow Meow Mailbox for daily deliveries, snap some pics with the Kitty Cam, and play with Gabby, Pandy Paws, and the Gabby Cats from the hit DreamWorks show. It’s time to get tiny! 
**Gabby’s Dollhouse is part of Piknik – a bundle of the world’s best apps for kids in one subscription. Unlock fan-favorites from Sago Mini, Toca Boca, and Originator with an Unlimited Plan!** 
• KITCHEN: Cook, bake, and have a Sprinkle Party with Cakey Cat! Try out the ice cream machine and make tons of tasty treats. 
• MUSIC ROOM: Tinker with tons of instruments, make music, and boogie down with DJ Catnip! 
• BATHROOM: Create your own potions, color Gabby’s hair, and do some Spa Science with MerCat!
• BEDROOM: Pick out new outfits for Gabby, then cuddle up with Pillow Cat for a cozy cat nap.
• PLAYROOM: Hit the race track with Carlita, play games, build with blocks, or try out the zip line! 
• CRAFT ROOM: Tinker with tons of crafty-riffic supplies with Baby Box Cat and make your own robot cat!
• FAIRY TAIL GARDEN: Grow a garden with Kitty Fairy, have a picnic, and visit the treehouse in the cotton candy tree. 
• PARTY ROOM: Calling all party cats! Get ready to decorate, dance, and celebrate with Marty the Party Cat! 
FEATURES
• 8 unique rooms designed for endless hours of pretend play
• Kids play with their favorite Gabby’s Dollhouse characters, including Gabby, Pandy Paws, CatRat, MerCat, Cakey Cat, Kitty Fairy, and more
• Get special items delivered daily in the Meow Meow Mailbox
• Snap pics with the Kitty Cam and try out tons of Gabby-themed frames 
• Perfect for kids aged 2-6 
• Play offline & on the go without WiFi 
• Use one subscription across multiple devices for easy family sharing
• Members get early access to new games and releases
• COPPA and kidSAFE-certified
• No ads or in-app purchases for subscribers
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Try before you buy! Download to start your free trial, no strings attached. 
• When purchased, payment will be charged through your Apple ID account.
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Don’t want to auto-renew? Manage renewals in your user Account Settings.
• Use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID. Like all Apple subscriptions, Piknik can’t use family sharing to share subscriptions across different Apple IDs.
• Cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings with no cancellation fees.
• Need a hand? Give us a shout at support@playpiknik.com.
PRIVACY POLICY
We are committed to protecting your privacy and the privacy of your children. We adhere to the strict guidelines set forth by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) & kidSAFE, which ensure the protection of your child’s information online. 
Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://playpiknik.link/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00083361:ios.description:
Ellie always dreamed of more, but she lived in a provincial town with her parents and her faithful dog Max. Her days seemed monotonous, and she longed for exciting adventures.
Then, on her birthday, Ellie received an unexpected gift from her parents – a ticket to her dream journey! It was a ticket to travel the world, and she could take only one companion. Without hesitation, she chose her loyal friend, Max.
From that moment on, an incredible adventure began. Ellie and Max traveled through different countries, met interesting people, and explored new cultures. They strolled on the Himalayas, marveled at ancient castles in Europe, and savored exotic cuisine in Asia.
The journey turned into a real dream adventure for Ellie. She realized that the world is so diverse and wonderful that she wanted to learn even more. And while it was time to return home, she knew that her adventures had only just begun. With Max by her side and new friends in different corners of the world, Ellie knew that her life would never be dull and predictable again.

- Get to know intriguing characters and uncover their hidden mysteries!
- Immerse yourself in the top-notch merging game with a plethora of fascinating mechanics!
- Collect awesome rewards!
- Engage in thrilling activities!

bluejetty:00071326:ios.description:
Idle Island Inc is a new Idle Game in which players have fun making Islands with unique landscapes while becoming rich business owners.
WHAT IS THIS GAME ABOUT?
In Idle Island Inc, you will become the owner of amusement parks, roller coasters, racing tracks, pyramids, ancient Greek temples, and many more incredible places
They will all make you money and help you become the best Island maker out there.
NO ISLAND? NO PROBLEM! Your boats will extract sand from the bottom of the sea to let you create your very own island empire.
HOW TO PLAY THE GAME?
1. SIT BACK AND RELAX
Idle Island Inc feels like the summer holidays are all year long.
Relax while watching your boats smoothly extract & blast sand to create your Islands in the middle of the sea.
Enjoy the satisfaction to see your crew place small pieces one by one to make amazing islands around the world.
If you are lucky, maybe you will even receive some help from a friendly submarine or the crabs that live on your island!
2. CREATE A SUCCESSFUL BUSINESS
Start creating small holiday resorts until you have enough cash to make entire countries!
Manage your business and make the right choices to build your islands empire.
Use the boosters to build faster than the competition!
Invest your money wisely!
- Increase your earnings
- Increase your speed
- Improve your boats & purchase new ones
- Improve your cranes & purchase new ones
3. ENJOY A RICH CONTENT
With frequent content updates, we are happy that you enjoy our Islands and happy to work hard making new ones for you.
Already huge content available to keep you playing for days (Happy Islands, Amusement Park atoll, Mysterious Temples atoll...), and more to come.

bluejetty:00186722:ios.description:
YOUR AI POWERED GTO POKER TRAINER - THE EASIEST WAY TO STUDY MTT STRATEGY
Elite poker players often turn to game theory to enhance their decision-making at the table. By leveraging advanced computer simulations, they strive to align their play with the principles of 'game theory optimal' (GTO) poker.
DTO Poker translates this sophisticated GTO research, conducted by top-tier poker pros, into an accessible format on your mobile device.

LiveSportsOnTV.com – Where to Watch Live Sports
LiveSportsOnTV.com is your trusted guide to finding where to watch live sports on TV and streaming services across the United States.
Built for sports fans who value speed, clarity, and accuracy, the app takes the frustration out of searching across multiple platforms to find a game. Instead of switching between league websites, streaming apps, and TV guides, find game times and viewing options together in one place.
Whether you are planning your week around upcoming games or checking just before kickoff, LiveSportsOnTV.com helps you identify the right channel or streaming service and get ready for the action.
— FIND WHEN AND WHERE TO WATCH
Browse upcoming sports events and see where they are scheduled to air. With the app, you can:
• Browse upcoming games by sport and league
• Find game times and the TV channels or streaming services showing each event
• Check U.S. broadcast listings, including national and regional coverage
• Save your preferences for a more personal experience
From a last-minute channel check to planning a full weekend of sports, get the information you need without searching through multiple schedules.
— KEEP YOUR FAVORITES CLOSE
Following teams across different sports? Select your favorite teams and leagues to make their upcoming broadcasts easier to find.
Whether you follow football, basketball, baseball, or several sports at once, spend less time browsing the full schedule and get straight to the games that matter to you.
— IN-DEPTH “HOW TO WATCH” GUIDES
Need more than a start time and a channel name? Explore detailed viewing guides for major tournaments, leagues, and seasonal events.
These guides help you understand your options with:
• Step-by-step viewing instructions
• TV and streaming breakdowns
• Comparisons between available services
• Explanations of regional and national coverage
Whether you are following a new competition or working out which service carries an upcoming event, find practical information to help you choose how to watch.

Explore schedules for the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, college football, college basketball, and more.

Follow your favorite sport throughout the season, keep track of championship weekends, or discover something new to watch.
— FROM YOUR BROWSER TO YOUR POCKET
Already use LiveSportsOnTV.com on the web? Keep the guide close at hand with the app.
Check tonight’s schedule on your commute, find the channel before friends arrive, or plan a Sunday around your favorite teams. Quick access to upcoming games and saved preferences makes the app a convenient companion throughout your sports week.
— PREMIUM OPTION AVAILABLE

bluejetty:00179559:ios.description:
# What is B100X?
B100X is an "auto dungeon RPG" that you can easily enjoy during your free time.
This game was created with the concept of "making hack-and-slash accessible to everyone."
With "Full Auto Battle" and "Anything Synthesis System", both easy operation and complicated capture are compatible.
There is also an automatic lap function, so you can enjoy it even during matching of competitive games.
# Seal the Eternal Cave
In the world before the birth of mankind, the heavens were dominated by God and the earth was dominated by demons.
The player becomes a "witness" who assists the apostle "Holly" of God, and challenges the seal of the "Eternal Magic Cave", which is a terrifying monster's nest.
What is a demon? What is God's true purpose? What is the relationship between the Holly Apostles and humans?
# How to play
- Create play data.
- Choose a dungeon and a target floor and start your adventure!
- The battle is completely automatic.
- Use experience points, junk, and drop items to strengthen Holly!
- Aim for the deepest part of the "Eternal Cave".
# Link
There is also a PC/iOS version.
* Official site
https://b100x.nussygame.com/
* Change log
https://b100x-history.tumblr.com/
* User support
https://nussygame.zendesk.com/hc/

Astify – AI Photo Editor & Effects. Astify combines advanced AI effects with professional editing tools, so you can instantly upgrade your visuals or fine-tune every detail — all in one intuitive app. Whether you're creating content for social media or just want your photos to look their best, Astify is the smart, fast choice for AI-powered photo editing.
AI EFFECTS & CUSTOM AI EDITS
Astify lets you apply AI effects in two powerful ways.
- Describe the result you want in text — and the AI will edit your photo accordingly, adding the right effects, adjustments, and visual details to match your request. Just type what you want to change, and watch your image transform.
- Prefer instant inspiration? Explore a curated feed of ready-made AI effects designed for different moods, styles, and creative scenarios. Apply any effect in one tap, or use it as a starting point and refine the result further.
- From Party Look and Black Glam to Steampunk, Studio Headshots, Horse Editorials, Day to Night, Makeup, and many more — there's an effect for every mood, style, and creative vision.
HAIR & HAIRSTYLE EFFECTS
- Try a new look without the commitment. Astify's dedicated hair category lets you experiment with styles and colors directly on your photo:
- Try different hairstyles and haircuts on your own photo
- Change hair color — from naturals to bold, creative tones
- Realistic AI rendering that fits your face and lighting
AI BACKGROUND REPLACEMENT
Swap your photo background instantly using AI — no manual selection, no cutting out. The AI detects the subject automatically and replaces the scene behind it:
- Change summer to winter, day to sunset, city to nature
- Choose from a variety of background styles and environments
- Clean, natural-looking results with accurate subject separation
OBJECT REMOVAL
Remove unwanted elements from any photo cleanly and instantly:
- Erase people, objects, or distractions from the background
- AI fills the removed area naturally to match the surroundings
- No traces left — just a clean, distraction-free image
AI FILTERS
Creative filters that actually fit your content. Astify's AI studies the tones, atmosphere, and composition of your photo, then applies filters that elevate the image instead of masking it. Also available for video.
AI ENHANCE & UPSCALE
Instantly improve your photos with smart, personalized enhancements:
- Sharper quality and improved clarity with AI upscaling
- Balanced colors, better lighting, and natural retouching
- Artifact removal for cleaner, polished results
- Every photo analyzed individually — no generic corrections
CREATIVE EDITING TOOLS
Go beyond AI with a complete set of classic editing features:
- Adjust brightness, exposure, shadows, and highlights
- Fine-tune contrast, saturation, and color balance
- Quick fixes or full manual control — your choice
WHY YOU'LL LOVE ASTIFY
- AI that adapts individually to each photo
- Text-to-edit: describe changes and watch them happen
- Unique AI effects and filters you won't find elsewhere
- Hair, background, and object tools in one app
- Clean, simple interface for creators of all levels

Do you want to fully enjoy music whether at home or out and about?

bluejetty:00140116:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00140116:ios.description:
Hold your phone up to the Sky and Star Gazer tells you what you're looking at. That bright dot next to the Moon? Point at it and you'll have its name.
Star Gazer, by LeoStudio Global, is a stargazing app and live sky map for iPhone and iPad that identifies stars, planets and constellations. You don't need a telescope or any background in astronomy to use it. If you do have binoculars or a small scope, there's plenty here to point them at.
AR GUIDE
Turn on AR and your camera view fills with labels: planets, bright stars and constellation lines, lined up with the real sky. It's an easy way to tell Jupiter from a bright star, or to find Orion's Belt for the first time.
CONSTELLATION FINDER
Point at any patch of sky and the constellations there are drawn in and named.
• Tap one to see its brightest stars and the story behind its name
• Switch sky cultures to see how people elsewhere grouped the same stars
Give it a few nights and you'll start spotting them without the phone.
WHAT'S UP TONIGHT
What's on screen is what's over your head right now.
• The map follows your location, the time and the direction you're facing
• See when the Moon and planets rise and set
• Pinch to zoom in on faint stars you'll never see from the city
THE BIG NIGHTS
The sky calendar tells you when to look up:
• Meteor shower peaks, like the Geminids in December
• Solar and lunar eclipses, including the total solar eclipse 
• Full Moons and conjunctions, when planets and the Moon pass close together
During a total lunar eclipse, the Moon on the map even turns coppery red.
ALSO IN STAR GAZER
• Sky Tours: guided tours of the bright planets, the major constellations and Messier objects for binoculars and small scopes
• Time Machine: move the sky forward or back to see where Saturn will be at 10pm, or what was overhead the night you were born
• AI Astro: ask in your own words, like "Why is Venus so bright?" or "What's the red star in Orion?"
• 3D planets and Moon: spin and zoom detailed models of the Earth, Moon, Sun and planets
COMMON QUESTIONS
What's that bright "star" next to the Moon?
Often it's a planet, usually Venus or Jupiter. Hold Star Gazer up to it and the label will tell you.
Is that a planet or a star?
As a rule, planets shine steadily and stars twinkle, though anything low in the sky can twinkle. Star Gazer settles it in a second.
Which planets can I see tonight?
Star Gazer shows which planets are above your horizon right now, and when each one rises and sets where you are.
When is the next meteor shower?
Open the sky calendar. It lists each shower's peak night, so you can plan ahead.
Why are the labels in the wrong place?
Phone compasses get thrown off by magnets and nearby metal. Take the phone out of any magnetic case and wave it in a figure 8 to recalibrate.
TIPS FOR A BETTER NIGHT
• Turn your screen brightness down and give your eyes 20 minutes to adjust to the dark.
• Check the Moon phase first. A bright Moon hides faint stars and meteors.
Terms of Service: https://leostudio.global/policies
Privacy Policy: https://leostudio.global/policies
Questions or ideas? We read every message.
https://leostudio.global/

bluejetty:00159676:ios.description:
COCOONWEAVER - QUICK, CALMING, CREATIVE, PRIVATE - VOICE / AUDIO MEMO APP
CocoonWeaver is your private, offline space to capture fleeting thoughts, creative sparks, dreams, reflections, or any practical keepsakes. Whether you need a fast voice memo, a note to self, a distraction-free notepad, or a space to track insights as they happen, CocoonWeaver helps you record what matters: fast, hands-free, and secure.
INSTANT VOICE NOTES & OFFLINE TRANSCRIPTION
- Quickly capture ideas, thoughts, or keepsakes of any kind - ideal for ADHD minds or anyone who loves frictionless thought capture
- Use it as a journal, diary, or creative writing tool
- Track therapy reflections, parenting moments, or creative breakthroughs
- Transcribe offline - listen and edit with full control
100% OFFLINE & PRIVATE
- No cloud, no tracking, no account needed
- All data is stored locally and encrypted
- Perfect for emotional clarity, journaling, and mental health support
ORGANIZE YOUR 'COCOONS'
- Sort thoughts by voice or touch
- Designed for neurodivergent thinkers
- Supports multiple formats: text, audio, images
DESIGNED FOR SPEED & MENTAL CLARITY
- Offload thoughts before they disappear
- Reduce overwhelm and clear mental space
WHO IT’S FOR
- Anyone looking to capture the moment - effortlessly and safely
- Great for ADHD minds, creatives, journal lovers, and entrepreneurs
- Writers, dreamers, and deep thinkers on the go
- Therapists or people in therapy reflecting on their growth
- Self-development explorers, spiritual travelers, and personal insight seekers
FEATURES
- Voice and manual note-taking
- Share entries as audio or text
- Record with Apple Watch or Siri
- Full-text search and geotagged entries
- Unlimited recordings, categories, and transcription
- Supports 13 transcription languages
PRO FEATURES & PRICING
Choose what fits your flow - monthly, yearly, or one-time unlocks:
- Unlimited Notes
- Pro Features à la carte
- “I’m From The Future” - unlocks all current and future tools forever
Details: apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
SCIENCE-BACKED BENEFITS
Speaking thoughts aloud boosts clarity, enhances memory, reduces anxiety, and supports emotion regulation.
CocoonWeaver isn’t just a recorder. It's a mindfulness tool for capturing the stream of consciousness.
TRY COCOONWEAVER TODAY
Start with a few free entries and feel the difference. No sign-up, no cloud, no tracking.
Just you, your voice, and the moment.
Capture what matters, in sound.
Terms of Use:
Apple Standard EULA link:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://www.cocoonweaver-com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00180689:ios.description:
Get straight to the stories that matter with The Age app. Top Stories and push notifications keep you up to date with breaking headlines while our Podcast catalogue lets you tune into thought-provoking audio storytelling and discussions from our newsroom. My News lets you customise your feed, showing the topics you're interested in, in the order you want them.
The app is free to download. You can unlock unlimited access to all content with a Starter Digital subscription through the App Store. To unlock premium features such as Today's Paper and puzzles including Daily Crosswords and Daily Sudoku, you can subscribe to Premium Digital via in-app purchase.
Additional information about Apple subscriptions:
- Purchase of an auto-renewable, monthly subscription is required to access content on The Age app
- Starter Digital subscriptions are available for AU$25.99 per month (or local currency equivalent)
- Premium Digital subscriptions are available for AU$37.49 per month (or local currency equivalent)
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes App Store Account Settings after purchase
- Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
Terms of use and privacy policy apply when accessing content via The Age app
- Privacy policy: https://login.nine.com.au/privacy?client_id=theage
- Terms and conditions: https://login.nine.com.au/terms?client_id=theage

bluejetty:00175906:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of being a detective, uncovering hidden treasures and clues to solve mind-bending mysteries? 
Do you like "Where's wally?" and geocaching game?
Look no further than "Find Journey", the innovative game that will redefine your search for fun.
In this game, you take on the role of a prop hunter, seeking out treasure, stuff, and other elusive objects hidden across beautifully illustrated scenes. With over 200 levels to explore.
But simply locating the items is only half the challenge. Each scene contains brain-boosting tests for you to spot, providing an extra layer of mystery in every prop hunt. Sharpen your focus as you pick out the various items in the beautiful levels. It’s a challenging game of observation that will keep your mind engaged for hours.
This game transforms the classic prop hunt into a modern-day treasure hunt like mystery. Every new level is a chance to seek adventure, unravel new levels, and stimulate your stuff in new ways. With dream-like artwork and an intuitive interface, gameplay is smooth and intuitive.
Will you rise to the challenge and become the ultimate treasure hunter? The hunt awaits—download "Find Journey" today!
If you find this game interesting, share it on Youtube,Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, Tik Tok, Twitter, Whatsapp, VK, Tumblr, Flickr, Pinterest,google and more!
Please follow our Instagram account!
https://www.instagram.com/newstoryapps/
presented by New Story Inc.

bluejetty:00040461:ios.description:
Scanner App – Revolutionizing Document Management
Scanner App adapts to your workflow like a chameleon to its surroundings, delivering precision, clarity, and unmatched efficiency. Whether you're digitizing, organizing, or sharing, Scanner App empowers you to turn piles of paperwork into neatly organized digital assets, all with a few taps.
With Scanner App , your mobile device becomes a powerhouse for productivity, ready to scan, save, and transform your documents anytime, anywhere.
Key Features
• Advanced Scanning Capabilities: Enjoy high-quality document scans with precise border detection and unique dynamic filter technology that enhances clarity, brightness, and contrast.
• Transcribe Scans to Text: Go beyond simple scanning – listen to your document’s content or convert it into editable text for multitasking and accessibility.
• Create Organized Spaces: Effortlessly group documents for work, study, or personal projects, keeping everything perfectly categorized.
• PDF Converter: Save and share documents in various formats, including JPG, DOC, and PDF, for ultimate flexibility.
• Save in Custom Quality: Tailor document quality to your needs – choose high-resolution for detailed prints or optimized sizes for quick sharing.
• Quick Import and Sharing: Seamlessly import files and share them via email, messaging apps, or cloud storage platforms like Google Drive and Dropbox.
• E-signatures Made Simple: Digitally sign contracts and agreements right within the app, eliminating the need for printing and scanning.
• Editing and Management: Refine your scans with advanced filters, add watermarks, crop, merge, and manage your files with ease.
• Password Protection: Keep your sensitive files secure by locking them with passwords for extra peace of mind.
Whether you're a student navigating coursework, a professional managing critical business documents, or someone simply striving for better personal organization, Scanmeleon is your ultimate pocket companion.
Scan anything – from handwritten notes to official contracts – extract text with cutting-edge OCR, save your files in multiple formats and qualities, and organize them securely with ease.
Turn chaos into order and revolutionize the way you manage your documents.
Start scanning, transforming, and sharing with Scanner App – the future of document management is here!
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
You can manage or disable auto-renewal at any time in your Apple ID account settings.
Terms of use - http://tou.scanner2pdf.com/
Privacy Notice - http://pp.scanner2pdf.com/

bluejetty:00180090:ios.summary:

With the power to record an almost unlimited number of audio, MIDI, and drum tracks, mix them with real-t
bluejetty:00180090:ios.description:
n-Track Studio is the ultimate music-making app for iOS that transforms your device into a powerful recording studio and beat maker. 
With the power to record an almost unlimited number of audio, MIDI, and drum tracks, mix them with real-time effects like Guitar Amps, VocalTune & Reverb, n-Track Studio has everything you need to create professional-quality music on the go. You can then share and find new collaborations with other artists in our Songtree community.
With n-Track Studio, the possibilities are endless. Record tracks using the built-in mic or an external audio interface, edit songs using the Loop Browser and royalty-free sample packs, and create beats using the Step Sequencer Beat Maker. You can even use the internal keyboard with built-in virtual instruments, or connect an external keyboard for even more flexibility. 
Other features include:
• Stereo and mono audio tracks
• MIDI tracks with built-in synths
• Piano Roll MIDI editor
• On-screen MIDI keyboard
• EQ with 2D and 3D spectrum analyzer and chromatic tuner VocalTune, Guitar and Bass Amp plugins
• Wide range of effects like Reverb, Noise Reduction, Pitch Shift, Limiter, Echo, Chorus, Flanger, Tremolo, Phaser, Tube Amp, and Compressor. 
n-Track Studio also comes with a built-in metronome, the ability to import existing tracks, and the option to automate track volumes and pan using volume & pan envelopes. With the integrated Songtree online music making community, you can collaborate with other musicians to create music like never before.
Ready to take your music-making skills to the next level? n-Track Studio has you covered with a variety of versions. 
The free edition includes up to 8 tracks and up to 2 effects per track/channel, while the standard subscription ($1.49/month) unlocks unlimited audio and MIDI tracks, all available effects, and the ability to export to WAV or MP3. For even more advanced features, you may want to consider the extended subscription ($2.99/month), which includes a 64-bit audio engine, multichannel USB class-compliant audio interfaces, and the ability to export in 24, 32, and 64-bit uncompressed (WAV) format. And for the ultimate music-making experience, check out the Suite subscription ($5.99/month), which includes 10GB+ of premium royalty-free WAV loops and one-shots, exclusive release-ready beats, and over 400 sample instruments. 
Not sure where to start? Check out n-Track Studio Tutorials for iOS at https://ntrack.com/video-tutorials/ios and get up to speed in no time! And if you like what you see, you can subscribe to unlock a variety of standard and advanced features. 
Languages included: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian.
So what are you waiting for? Download n-Track Studio today and start making music like a pro!
TERMS OF USE
https://ntrack.com/terms.php
