bluejetty:00141602:ios.description:
Add 15 levels in "Winter" !!!Really Cool,Really Fun!
With more than 130 million downloads in just a hundred days, the game has topped the charts across more than 70 countries, ranking in the top 10 games of all time, the top 5 games in the Asia Pacific and the top 25 games of the 43 countries in Europe and North America. With 101 countries globally giving it top billing, you do yourself no favours if you don't try it!! 
This is a beautifully packaged, adorable TDgame~~!!!
Easy to pick up for all ages and hard to put down!
Your mission is to protect the adorable carrot from monsters who want to eat it~~
The tutorial takes you from novice to expert in 5 seconds!! 
Game Highlights: 
*105 levels in 5 beautiful theme packs set in the sky, the jungle, the desert and the deep sea and the Extreme!
*35 Extreme Modes and hidden levels for you to discover!
*16 unique Boss Mode levels take you into time-limited minigames!
*18 unique towers like the Fishbone, Sunflower, Poopoo and Anchor Bomb towers for you to discover!
*Monsters babies drops and collection added to this adorable TD game - collect monsters and babies while defending the little carrot. There are 20 to collect!
*Newly added monster-raising system: Hatch and raise monster babies to unlock hidden levels!
*Obstacles on the map hide treasures and secret surprises. Destroy them to find treasure!
*Over 70 types of hilarious monsters like the Woowala, Pinky Ninja and Twisty Fork.
*Over 100 sound effects - each monster makes a unique noise when hit! 
*Each level has just 15-25 monster waves. Beat the time and have fun!
*Supports Game Centre. Tons of achievements to be unlocked!!

bluejetty:00065580:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00065580:ios.description:
New Feature: AI Voice Search!
Add meals even more conveniently! Just say what you're eating, and artificial intelligence will search for all the listed products, estimate portions, and prepare a meal suggestion with calories and macros. You can add only selected products, edit the weight, and change ingredients if needed.
Fitatu is a calorie counter powered by AI that allows easy calorie estimation through text, photos, and voice, saving users time and helping in situations where it's difficult to estimate the calories of a meal. No guessing, more precision for calories, weight, and macros. Don’t let other apps fool you – choose full control with Fitatu.
Fitatu features that help you reach your goal:
- Personalized calorie needs & macro targets (protein, fat, carbs) with a goal-achievement forecast
- Detailed nutrition tracking: calories, protein, fat, carbs + 39 vitamins and nutrients, including omega-3, fiber, sodium, cholesterol, and caffeine
- The largest database of products and dishes moderated by dietitians, including products from store chains (e.g. Tesco, Asda, Morrisons, Sainsbury, Lidl) and dishes from restaurant chains (e.g., McDonald’s, KFC, Subway, Pizza Hut).
- Fitatu AI 2.0 ACAI - the most accurate AI calorie scanner from photos, with refinement options and full transparency
- Fitatu Voice AI - Voice search and meal estimation
- Barcode scanner for fast food logging
- Active Days - collect rewards for daily activity to stay motivated
- Thousands of recipes and food inspirations with step-by-step photos
- Meal plans - 7 ready-made menus: Balanced, Keto, Vegetarian, Low Sugar, Gluten-Free, Lactose-Free, and High-Protein
- Intermittent fasting – animated fasting timer to help you follow your eating window smoothly (16:8, 8:16, 14:10, 20:4)
- Smart Fridge - enter the ingredients you have and get recipe ideas instantly
- Complete Daily Goal - Fill in the remaining calories and macros for the day with smart suggestions
- Shopping list - automatically generated from your planned meals
- Water intake tracking with reminders
- Health & mood notes with 52 custom icons
- Habits - choose from 22 habits and track them over 90 days to build consistency
- Daily, weekly, or custom nutrition summaries, including tracking of any selected nutrient
- Weight & body measurements tracking with charts and goal projections
- Carbohydrate exchanges – making diabetic meal planning much easier
- Copy day - speed up meal planning for repeat days
- Delete entire day – remove all meals from a selected day at once
- Different goals for training days
- Meal time scheduling and notifications
- Integration with Google Fit, Garmin Connect, Fitbit, Samsung Health, Huawei Health, and Strava
- Import activity data from Adidas Running (Runtastic) and Zepp Life via Google Fit
- Data export to XLS / CSV files
- Additional backup & export options, including sending nutrition and weight data to Google Fit
- Web access at www.fitatu.com
Download Fitatu and see how simple calorie tracking can be.
Terms & Conditions:
 https://www.fitatu.com/app/regulations
Privacy Policy:
 https://www.fitatu.com/app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00162587:ios.summary:
Transforme sua rotina de treinos com o Smart Fit App, seu parceiro completo dentro e fora da academia. Baixe agora e experimente uma revolução na sua jornada fitness! 
Novidade: Explore as novas funcionalidades na aba Social. Participe de
bluejetty:00162587:ios.description:
Transforme sua rotina de treinos com o Smart Fit App, seu parceiro completo dentro e fora da academia. Baixe agora e experimente uma revolução na sua jornada fitness! 
Novidade: Explore as novas funcionalidades na aba Social. Participe de grupos com pessoas que compartilham os mesmos objetivos que você. Participe também de competições saudáveis criando desafios com seus amigos. Veja quem treina mais e assuma o topo no ranking. Mantenha a motivação em alta e comemore cada conquista!
Treinos personalizados para resultados incríveis:
Seu treino é criado através de informações oferecidas por você em um questionário detalhado, conhecido como anamnese. Com o treino sob medida na palma da sua mão, você vai acompanhar a sua evolução com dados de carga, repetições e orientações valiosas para melhorar seu condicionamento físico.
Vídeos explicativos para a execução perfeita:
Tenha acesso a vídeos explicativos de todos os exercícios das suas séries de musculação. Treine com segurança, encontrando facilmente os equipamentos necessários para cada movimento. Basta seguir as instruções no app!
Acompanhamento do progresso e evolução corporal:
Acompanhe de perto seu progresso e evolução corporal. Anote suas cargas, faça comentários e deixe tudo registrado. Assim, você consegue atualizar melhor os seus treinos na hora certa, entender seu progresso e chega mais rápido nos seus resultados. E ainda dá para se manter motivado com gráficos e estatísticas que mostram a sua progressão. Incrível, né?
Ocupação das unidades:
Quer saber se é um horário mais tranquilo ou movimentado para treinar? Com o nosso gráfico de ocupação das unidades, você planeja os treinos conforme o movimento da academia.
Soluções completas para resultados potencializados:
O Smart Fit App centraliza as principais informações de todos os nossos serviços para oferecer uma solução completa para quem quer potencializar os resultados. Nele, você pode consultar os treinos criados pelo seu professor no Smart Fit Coach, os resultados da sua bioimpedância feita com o Smart Fit Body e muito mais. Tudo pensado para você ir além e alcançar os seus objetivos com as informações essenciais em um lugar só.
Parcerias incríveis para a sua rotina (e para o seu bolso):
No nosso app você encontra o Smart Fit Mais: uma área cheia de vantagens para os nossos alunos. Lá, nossos parceiros disponibilizam vantagens especiais, descontos e muito mais.
Tudo o que você precisa está aqui!:
No nosso app, você consegue fazer a sua matrícula e até encontrar a solução perfeita para aumentar a sua performance, como nutricionistas, suplementos, bebidas esportivas, coach de treino e muito mais!
Não é só pra aluno!
Mesmo se você ainda não for um aluno Smart Fit, dá pra baixar o app e aproveitar! Nosso app conta com vídeos gratuitos para você se exercita e também permite a compra dos nossos planos e do passe diário.
Baixe agora o Smart Fit App e tenha o melhor aliado para seus treinos. Sua jornada para uma vida ativa e saudável começa aqui!

bluejetty:00090964:ios.description:
Named a TIME Best Invention and trusted by 1.5 million shoppers. As seen in Fortune, Forbes, The New York Times, and Vogue.
Phia is the AI shopping agent that finds you the best price, earns you rewards, and helps you build a wardrobe you love, automatically.
——
HOW PHIA WORKS
1) Browse anything you love — Phia instantly compares prices across 350 million items and 220,000+ sites, new and secondhand.
2) Phia auto-applies the best coupons at checkout — including exclusive codes only available to Phia users — or set a price drop alert and we'll watch it for you.
3) Earn Phia Rewards points on eligible purchases at participating retailers and redeem them for gift cards to top brands.
Shop, save, and get rewarded, automatically.
——
FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
Should I Buy This? 
Tap it on any item while browsing Safari and Phia's AI instantly tells you if the price is fair, finds cheaper alternatives across retail and resale, and surfaces visually similar styles, all in seconds.
Never Overpay Again
Phia compares prices across 220,000+ sites in real time. If there's a better deal anywhere on the internet, Phia finds it before you check out.
Coupons, Done For You
Phia automatically applies the best coupon at checkout. No searching, no expired codes. Some discounts are exclusive to Phia users only.
Catch Every Price Drop
Save any item and we'll notify you the moment the price falls to your target. You set the threshold. We do the watching.
Phia Rewards
Earn points when you shop at participating retailers. Redeem them for gift cards to your favorite brands. Shopping doesn't just save you money — it pays you.
Your Cart, Automatically
Not ready to check out? Save anything to your cart and we'll alert you when a fresh coupon lands, the price drops, or a better deal pops up.
Styled For You
Phia's proprietary AI learns your taste and suggests what to buy next across multiple brands and retailers, right on your home feed. A stylist that actually knows your wardrobe.
Shop Your Screenshots
See something you love on social media? Phia Lens finds it across 220,000+ sites instantly.
——
NOT ANOTHER COUPON APP
Phia is built for people who care about what they wear.
Unlike Rakuten, Coupert, Honey, or Capital One Shopping, Phia doesn’t just hunt for coupons — it compares prices across retail and resale, finds better options instantly, applies savings automatically, and helps you track everything you love in one place.
——
CELEBRITY BACKED
Khloe Kardashian, Alix Earle, Karlie Kloss, Olivia Culpo, Winnie Harlow, Eileen Gu, Halsey, Paris Hilton, Lori Harvey, and Ice Spice, and more invested in Phia’s $35.5M Series A.
——
Download Phia and start shopping smarter.

bluejetty:00086964:ios.name: Splice: Make music now
bluejetty:00086964:ios.summary: Splice is a royalty-free sample library, trusted and used by your favorite music creators. With Splice Mobile, you now have the power to browse the entire Splice catalog, organize your favorite sounds, discover hidden gems, record your own
bluejetty:00086964:ios.description:
Splice is a royalty-free sample library, trusted and used by your favorite music creators. With Splice Mobile, you now have the power to browse the entire Splice catalog, organize your favorite sounds, discover hidden gems, record your own audio, and start countless new ideas with Create mode—right from your phone. Splice Mobile keeps inspiration within reach wherever you are.
DISCOVER NEW SPLICE SOUNDS ON THE GO
Inspiration isn’t limited to the studio, and now, neither is your creativity. With our mobile app, you can browse the entire Splice catalog all from your phone. Dive deep into packs and genres and discover hidden gems. Search by keyword and filter by tags to find the perfect sound for your project. Quickly audition loops, tap the heart icon to save your favorite sounds, and organize them into Collections. 
VOICE TO VERSE—ANYWHERE 
The latest mobile feature, Splice Mic, redefines mobile music creation for songwriters who know inspiration doesn’t wait. More than just a recording app, it lets you hear every topline, verse, or riff in full musical context over Splice sounds—right from your phone. Instantly test ideas, explore genres, and unlock new creative possibilities.
Humming a melody? Strumming a riff? Working out lyrics? Splice Mic turns spontaneous moments into real musical opportunities. Every take is a step toward your next track. When you're ready, export to your DAW and turn those mobile ideas into full songs.
INSTANT INSPIRATION WITH CREATE MODE
Generating new musical ideas and starting beats on the go has never been easier. Simply tap on the Create icon, select your desired genre, and immediately drop into a Stack of loops from the Splice library. You may find the generated Stack fits what you’re looking for perfectly, but if not, that’s great too. Developing a musical idea is often about trying combinations of sounds and figuring out what feels good to you—Create Mode is a great companion for that process. 
Create Mode leaves creative control in your hands—shuffle to create a whole new Stack or add new layers of compatible sounds and your own recordings. If you want to replace a single loop with a new option of the same type of sound, swipe right. If you want to delete the layer altogether, swipe left. You can also solo a layer by holding down, or tap the layer to mute. Once you’ve chosen your Stack layers, you can fine-tune your loop with volume adjustments and BPM control. When your idea hits the spot, save it with a click. You can also click the Stack icon to hear any individual loop in the Splice library in musical context with Create mode. 
SAVE IT. SEND IT. SHARE IT.
Creating and saving your Stack is just the beginning. Not only is the Stack accessible from anywhere you can access your Splice account, but you can also share it directly with a unique link, AirDrop it to friends, or upload to Dropbox, Drive, or another cloud service right from your device for seamless collaboration. If you work in Ableton Live or Studio One, you can export your Stack as a DAW file and open it up with key and tempo information synced when you’re back in the studio. You can also save as a bounced stereo mix to hear the full idea rendered.
START WITH SPLICE
Subscribe to use Splice's expansive library of royalty-free samples, presets, MIDI, and creative tools in your music. Use Splice samples to create anything—they’re cleared for commercial use in new works. Cancel your subscription anytime and keep everything you've downloaded. 
Privacy Policy: https://splice.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://splice.com/terms

Uncover exciting new experiences, make plans with friends, and create unforgettable memories with the AI-powered LetsGo app. Whether you're in the mood for a cozy dinner, craft cocktails, or something sweet, LetsGo app makes exploration effortless.
Find the best experiences for all occasions, such as exploring a new city, date night, happy hour, nights out on the town, birthdays or friendly get-togethers.
Discover new experiences across the biggest cities nationwide like, New York City, Los Angeles, Chicago, Boston, Houston, Austin, Dallas, Nashville, Las Vegas, Minneapolis and more!
Key Features:
- AI-Powered Recommendations: Harness the power of our intelligent AI Planner to effortlessly discover new experiences tailored just for you and your friends.
- Interactive Maps: Navigate with ease using our interactive maps to find nearby hotspots and plan your next experience.
- Reviews & Ratings: Make informed decisions with user reviews and ratings to ensure you're always at the best spots.
- Save Favorites: Keep track of your favorite establishments for future reference.
- Share with Friends: Easily share your discoveries with friends and family, message and coordinate outings directly within the app.
Why LetsGo?
- Discover Hidden Gems: Unearth hidden experiences and uncover new favorites with the help of our AI-driven recommendations.
- Effortless Planning: Say goodbye to decision fatigue and let LetsGo handle the planning with our AI Planner, so you can focus on enjoying unforgettable moments with friends and loved ones.
- Community-Driven: Connect with friends and family in the app, and share your recommendations and experiences.
Premium Users
Premium users can access premium features such as unlimited AI Planner requests, exclusive promotions (coming soon) and all new premium features launched in the future.

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. All in app purchases and subscription sales are final at point of sale and no refunds will be given to canceled purchases or subscriptions.
For more information, see our:

bluejetty:00120271:ios.description:
Drops makes language learning an effortless fun. Practical vocabulary is bound to your memories through beautiful graphics and quick mini-games.
The crazy part? You have only 5 mins per day to learn German. Might sound insane but works like a charm! :)
These are the ingredients of the secret sauce:
100% illustrated: Pictures directly carry the meaning - you don’t have to use your native language at all! No intermediary. Faster, more effective and of course more fun for German learning process! :)
5 min sessions: limiting practice time sounds crazy but it it makes it incredibly addictive - which is cool thing for learning. The barrier of entry is close to zero so you can’t have any excuses: you’ll have 5 minutes even on the busiest day!
Effortless play: We know why games are fun and addictive and distilled the essence into Drops. The result is a truly immersive experience but it’s not waste of your time while you play because you build a valuable knowledge.
Quick: Keyboard typing is painfully slow. Welcome rapid swipes and taps! Especially for German vowels, and consonants. Trust us, you’ll need those extra seconds during the quick learning session ;)
Vocabulary only: Zero grammar, just handpicked practical words. That’s our focus and we do it extremely well. The app teaches the German alphabet as well.
Forge a habit: Drops wants to make you language learning addict. Effectiveness is nothing without a well established habit. We help you build one!
We are extremely proud of our lovely word pronunciations by seasoned voice talents!
Drops is free for casual learners: more than 2700 words in 150+ topics are all available for everyone. Hardcore language learners can subscribe for premium to progress faster with unlimited German language learning time.
Our goal is to empower people of the world via language knowledge by providing a special tool that utilizes the universal language we all speak: pictures.
-----------------
Keep tuned as even more languages are in the works!

1 month - $13
1 quarter - $30
1 year - $90

- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period

bluejetty:00018740:ios.name: OxiPur: Purine Diary & Tracker
bluejetty:00018740:ios.summary: Dietary advice for gout or kidney stones is often conflicting, inaccurate or even completely outdated. Our app OxiPur contains only the most recent information available on these topics. We analyzed hundreds of scientific studies and summar
bluejetty:00018740:ios.description:
Dietary advice for gout or kidney stones is often conflicting, inaccurate or even completely outdated. Our app OxiPur contains only the most recent information available on these topics. We analyzed hundreds of scientific studies and summarized the results in helpful notes.
Additionally, you can use the app to create and evaluate your own recipes or track your daily intake with the food diary. You won't find any other resource that offers such a wealth of information in one place. Our app is the perfect tool to improve your eating habits and get your health back! You can also export your diary as a clear, easy-to-read PDF and share it – ideal for discussing it with your doctor or nutritionist, for example.
OxiPur covers the following topics:
■ Diet and Gout
Even today, the main treatment of gout still focuses too much on avoiding purines, although they are only part of the problem. Our app uses a wider approach and includes additional important factors like alcohol, fructose, and sodium. You can also combine different dietary profiles (e.g. low glycemic index) as needed.
■ Low Oxalate Diet
Without proper instruction a low oxalate diet is very complicated to follow. Our app knows the oxalate content of about a thousand foods and helps you plan your meals. It also considers the bioavailability of oxalates as well as other factors that play a role in renal problems like the formation of kidney stones.
You can use the app for free with a limited functionality. It doesn't require a registration and is free of ads. If you want more details, there are two separate one-time in-app purchases that upgrade each topic with additional features and information.
► Free Version
• Profiles for a low purine diet and a low oxalate diet
• Access to food database with more than 1,300 entries
• Values for calories, carbohydrates, protein and fat
• Daily requirements based on age, weight and activity level
• Create five entries in the food diary
• Create five recipes
• List of favorites
• Shopping list
• Barcode scanner
• Access to detailed articles and our blog*
• Direct link to Wikipedia articles
• No internet connection required
• Dark Mode
► Pro Version
• Unlock all information and features
• Nutrition table with purine, uric acid and oxalic acid content
• Recipe calculator: Create your own recipes and see their nutritional composition
• Unlimited number of entries in the food diary
• Week-based diet analysis with detailed charts and PDF export
• Access 46 nutritional values incl. vitamins, minerals and glycemic index
• Sort by nutritional values
• Set up advanced filter criteria
• Personalize the app with additional dietary profiles: Strong oxalate reduction, Low-salt diet for high blood pressure, Healthy fats, Low glycemic load, Low carb diet, Natural foods
• Useful extra functions for vegetarian and vegan diet
■ About Us
At Baliza, we have been developing nutritional apps that provide tailored nutritional recommendations to people with special dietary needs since 2011. Our award-winning apps are helpful guides that combine carefully researched information from scientific sources with all the capabilities offered by modern smartphones. You get all of our apps as a fair one-time purchase without a subscription.
*https://www.baliza.de/en/blog/files/category-oxipur.html

bluejetty:00180438:ios.description:
Your Swiss Post. Simple, fast and anywhere.
With the Post-App, you’ll always have our most important services at hand. You can track, manage or frank letters and parcels in just a few clicks, use the pick@home or My Post 24 services with ease and keep an overview of your postal transactions at all times – whether at home, in the office or on the go.
Functions in detail:
• My consignments: Never miss a delivery. You receive information about upcoming consignments via push notifications and can manage deliveries conveniently.
• Code scanner: Scan or manually enter barcodes and QR codes.
• ePost: Handle your mail digitally: receive letters, pay invoices, sign and return contracts, file and retrieve documents. All in one workflow, anytime and anywhere.
• Track Postbuses live: Track timetable data and live positions of all PostBus vehicles in real time
• Location and opening hours: Find branches, letter boxes and other services, including collection times and opening hours.
• pick@home: Have parcels collected conveniently from your home or an address of your choice.
• DigitalStamp: Frank letters and parcels easily and conveniently with your smartphone, anytime and anywhere, and calculate letter size using artificial intelligence.
• My Post 24: Send or collect parcels and registered letters 24/7 at terminals (without a display).
• Collection note: Missed a delivery? Scan QR code, extend collection period or plan second attempted delivery.
• Support chat: Our chatbot and our customer service specialists will support you with your query directly in the app.
• Languages: The app is available in German, French, Italian and English.
• Feedback: Share your opinion and help to develop the app.

bluejetty:00120605:ios.name: StaffWars Live
bluejetty:00120605:ios.summary: Built on the success of the original 'StaffWars', StaffWars Live offers game play designed to aid students in instrumental practice. Choose your instrument, key signature, scale and note range, then play the notes that appear on the staff w
bluejetty:00120605:ios.description:
Built on the success of the original 'StaffWars', StaffWars Live offers game play designed to aid students in instrumental practice. Choose your instrument, key signature, scale and note range, then play the notes that appear on the staff with your instrument to destroy them before they damage you clef. Notes get faster with every ten correct and you get three lives. 
 Press the "Settings" button to change your instrument, scale, key signature and adjustable note range. All notes are in the instruments' written pitch (i.e. Clarinet in C major would be concert Bb Major)
 All your scores are saved when exiting the game, so you can track your improvement. Scales include Major, Major Blues, Minor Blues, Chromatic
 Need to practice transposition? StaffWars Live has got you covered. All notes are in the instruments’ written pitch, so you can be a french horn player and select ‘Trumpet' to practice transposing to Bb.
 Connect any MIDI device to trigger the game with MIDI.
Note range = from 4 Spaces Below to 4 Spaces Above Clef
Start speed adjustable.
***NOTE*** - Make sure your instrument is in tune prior to playing StaffWars Live. Always play with good attacks and good tone. Game sounds may trigger the pitch detection so it is a good idea to turn your iPhone\iPad volume down while playing with the sound turn on.

Faça parte do maior ecossistema pet do Brasil! No app da Petlove, você confere as melhores promoções, serviços e todos os produtos que o seu peludo precisa na palma da mão e com entrega rápida! Como não amar?
Tenha acesso a 15 mil produtos, plano de saúde pet, hospedagem, creche, pet sitter, atendimento veterinário, clube de descontos e conteúdos exclusivos na tela do seu celular e no conforto da sua casa.
Milhares de produtos para o seu pet
Em poucos cliques você encontra tudo que seu pet precisa. São diversas categorias com as melhores marcas de produtos de higiene, saúde, ração para cachorro, ração para gato, antipulgas, acessórios e brinquedos.
Acesse seu plano de saúde pet
Faça parte do maior plano de saúde pet do Brasil! Acesse direto pelo aplicativo e confira a rede credenciada para consultas, exames, procedimentos e muito mais.
Pelo app você também consegue acessar diversas outras informações sobre seu Petlove Saúde, como o histórico de consultas e procedimentos realizados, além dos valores de coparticipação, coberturas, serviços extras e limites. Tudo de maneira fácil e prática!
Alerta de promoções, frete grátis e Clube de descontos 
Receba todos os dias alertas sobre promoções incríveis para você não perder nenhuma oportunidade de economia na loja da Petlove.
E não para por aí! Confira no app o nosso clube de descontos, um pacote de benefícios de até 20% off para você economizar em todas as categorias. Além disso, você garante frete grátis* em todas as suas compras, sem valor mínimo!
Acesse serviços para cuidar do seu pet
Vai passar o dia ou as férias fora e não quer deixar o pet sozinho em casa? Deixa que a gente cuida dele pra você! Agende diretamente pelo app serviços de hospedagem, creche e pet sitter para o seu filho de quatro patas.

bluejetty:00160677:ios.description:
Accomplish More. Stress Less. Intuitive breathing exercises to shift your state in record time. 
State creates custom exercises based on your stress response and continues to evolve dynamically with use. 
When you change your breath, you can alter not just your state of mind, but your physical and emotional health as well. 
FEATURES
Six exercises designed to create specific, desired physiological states:
Feel calm, Feel alert, Be present, Wake up, Recover quickly, Fall asleep.
- Breathing exercises supported by visuals and sound to let you focus/defocus efficiently
- “Fingerprinting” that primes the exercises to your physical and emotional needs from the first time you use the app
- The State algorithm keeps adapting and evolving the exercises the more you use the app
- Track progress with key metrics
- Helpful reminders to keep you in the state you want
- Method based on the latest neuroscientific findings
- Created by world-renowned strength and conditioning coach Brian Mackenzie
SUBSCRIPTION AND PRICING
State offers a subscription with a two weeks free trial. After the two weeks free trial this subscription automatically renews for $3.99 monthly or $34.99 yearly unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period. These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged at subscription automatic renewal. Your subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00128537:ios.summary:
Sober Time helps you track your addictions, stay motivated, and interact with others in recovery.
Here's what you can do with Sober Time:
- Track as many addictions as you want
- Built-in Goals with the option to add your own
- Daily motiv
bluejetty:00128537:ios.description:
Sober Time helps you track your addictions, stay motivated, and interact with others in recovery.
Here's what you can do with Sober Time:
- Track as many addictions as you want
- Built-in Goals with the option to add your own
- Daily motivational messages
- Vibrant sober community forum
- Personalize your addictions with beautiful backgrounds and icons
- Tons of timer options
- Track your relapses and add notes to them
- See how much money you've saved
- Share your progress
- Style your app with 15+ color themes
Accurate and precise Sobriety Tracker
Track the time you've been clean down to the second. The tracker updates in real time and you can see the seconds, minutes, hours and days tick by. With over 10 unique display modes - from total days to breaths - pick one that shows what's important to you.
Staying motivated and inspired
Sober Time helps you stay motivated and inspired by showing daily inspirational messages and setting realistic, achievable goals for you. You can further customize your goals by editing them or even creating your own. Each goal will be tracked in the app and you'll receive a notification when you've reached them.
Our community
Sober Time has a dedicated community forum where you can read or discuss anything related to sobriety. Users discuss their daily struggle with addiction, motivation, milestones, and more. You can stay anonymous and browse the forum without registering an account. Soak up the knowledge until you're ready to share your story.
Personalized experience
Each addiction that you track with Sober Time can be individually personalized. Choose from one of the scenic nature backgrounds or upload your own. Set up your own heading and change the counter to show the way you like it. Varied display modes, like heartbeats or total seconds, give you complete freedom of expression.
This app is subject to Apple's standard end user license agreement:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00153077:ios.description:
Step into "Hidden Portals: Eternal Balance", where hidden object games collide with gripping adventure games. As time collapses, Alice Lofton must find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and confront fate in a realm of magic and danger. This search and find game challenges players to uncover ancient secrets and restore balance before reality unravels. With breathtaking visuals and a deep story, it’s a must-play for fans of unsolved mysteries games and those who love to find items.
Time is no longer a straight path – it’s collapsing, folding in on itself, and erasing entire moments from existence. Alice Lofton, a young manuscript restorer, discovers her father’s reckless plan to use the powerful Clock of Harmony to bring back his deceased wife. To stop him, Alice must enter the mystical realm of Luminaria, where the very fabric of reality is tearing apart. With the help of a reluctant ally and a resistance leader, Alice must race against time to restore balance. Will Alice save her father from his destructive obsession, or will the world fall to pieces in the process?
· Epic Adventure!
As Alice journeys through Luminaria, you’ll solve puzzles that shape the fate of the world, discover hidden object games scenes packed with detail, and face emotional choices that test the limits of time!
· Search and Find Gameplay!
Traverse luminous cities, shattered timelines, and mythical temples as you find hidden objects vital to your mission. Designed for fans of search and find games and adventure games alike, each scene challenges you to explore every corner while uncovering the story behind the Clock of Harmony!
· Challenging Mini-Games and Puzzles!
Solve puzzles of increasing complexity that tie directly into the narrative. With every puzzle solved, another layer of mystery is peeled away. Perfect for those who love hidden object games and seek search and find games with depth, logic, and meaning!
· Collectibles & Achievements!
Unlock fantasy-themed extras, track hidden collectibles, and earn achievements as you find hidden objects across multiple dimensions. Our hidden object games offer endless replayability and excitement for players who love to solve puzzles and lose themselves in story-driven adventure games!
The world is collapsing in on itself, and only you can fix time in the free trial of "Hidden Portals: Mystery Object"!

bluejetty:00024106:ios.description:
Cobalt Edge
With the exploration of New Eden's border regions progresses, an increasing number of people are directing their attention to Cobalt Edge. Capsuleers refer to it as the Far Sub-galaxy because it is one of the eight far regions awaiting exploration.
Unstable Wormhole 
The recently discovered wormholes are distributed in Cobalt Edge and the low-sec space of New Eden, which let capsuleers can steer their ships through wormholes to jump, much like a stargate.
New Enemy Forces--Wasteseeker 
Appear in the far borders of New Eden and is the collective term for the drone faction. These drones, ranging in size from frigates and battleships to even supercarriers, constantly patrol, scavenge, and salvage ship wrecks in space to build their own bodies. They are called 'Wasteseeker'.
New Game Content
In order to better cope with distant warfare, researchers have introduced more flexible combat capabilities of the Navy Issue Frigates. At the same time, the Concord opened the territory to expand new corporation tech, and developed an integrated technology suitable for drones! 
Pilots, get ready for battle!

Join Domestika, one of the fastest growing creative communities, where the best experts and creatives share their knowledge and skills through professionally produced courses. Join 8 million creatives to get started or specialize in your creative discipline or favorite hobby.
Explore all the different creative categories and find the perfect course. Watch videos online or download them to watch them whenever and wherever you want, even if you aren’t connected to the internet. Choose the language of the audio and subtitles (they’re available in Portuguese, English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Polish, and Dutch). Participate in the course community and look at other students’ projects. Create lists to save courses for later.
Buy a Domestika Plus subscription, use credits to unlock courses directly in the app, see how many credits you have and when they expire, or manage your subscription.
What it’s like to learn on Domestika:
- Learn and share at your own pace: join online courses and enjoy them whenever and wherever you want. Download and watch them even when you’re not connected to the internet.
- The best professionals: learn techniques, methods and tips explained step by step, by expert teachers who will give you a professional perspective in each lesson.
- Professionally produced courses: a professional team produces the courses to give you the best learning experience. Videos are high-quality and you have unlimited access to watch them as many times as you want.
- Creative community: join more than 8 million creatives from around the world. Ask questions, get feedback, and offer solutions. Share your learning experience with other students who are passionate about creativity.
Find the best online courses about:
- Illustration: learn with online courses about watercolor techniques, chinese ink, Adobe Photoshop, Procreate, Illustrator, vector illustration, portraits, botanical illustration, and children’s illustration.
- Photography & Video: explore courses about editing, post-production, retouching, studio photography, product and fashion photography, Lightroom, Premiere, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.
- Design: develop your skills with courses about logo design, branding, editorial design, art direction, InDesign and more.

bluejetty:00166443:android.description:
Musicians, shine!
Make music with the world and start earning from your passion!
Indaband is your music social network for creation, collaboration, community, and real monetization. Join a global stage of aspiring and pro musicians, easily record multi-track sessions on the fly, earn Beats (virtual tips), and convert them into real cash. Discover new friends, start themed events, and grow a fanbase that actually sees your content—no hidden algorithms here.
Key Features & Highlights
► Music Maker & Song Creator
Don’t just listen—create! Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned pro, Indaband’s user-friendly interface lets you record, edit, and publish right from your phone. No fancy gear or musical background required—just your passion for music.
► Music Collaboration
Every session on Indaband is open for you to create a version and make it your own. Work with friends or anyone worldwide—jamming has no borders. You can even invite bandmates or fans to co-create tracks, building music together in real time or asynchronously.
► Community: Circles & Events
Build your own music community with Circles—public or private (Inner Circles). Host or attend themed events, invite friends, fans, or students, and keep everyone engaged. Indaband is truly social media for music lovers, where you discover musicians from around the globe and connect without losing reach to algorithms.
► Monetize with Beats
Turn your passion into profit. Earn Beats as tips or gifts from fans, then convert them into real money. Indaband is forging a self-sustaining music economy, so you can focus on creativity while getting paid.
► AI Track Separator & Automatic Video Editor
Remove vocals or isolate instruments at the tap of a button for an instant karaoke or remix—completely free!
Don’t waste time with video editing—Indaband’s one-click tech handles everything, whether your session has 2 or 100 active tracks. It’s like magic!
► Multi-Track Recorder & Studio
Layer vocals or instrument tracks using your phone’s recording booth, or import audio/video files already recorded in your own setup. Our integrated metronome keeps you on tempo, while streamlined editing tools replace complex DAWs. It’s powerful music production, simplified.
► Curated Playlists & Jams
Explore daily picks from rock to EDM—jam along, learn new styles, and expand your musical horizons. Indaband’s curated collections help you discover new talent and experiment with your sound.
Our Vision: “Musicians, Shine!”
Indaband is crafted by passionate people redefining Social + Meaningful Music Collaboration.
“We want to live in a world where being a musician pays off.”
“There’s no distance between creators and fans.”
“Music is better together—so we say, Musicians, Shine!”
Ready to join the party? Download Indaband now—start creating, collaborating, and earning in one vibrant music community.

bluejetty:00023501:ios.description:
Transform your photos into professional comic art, technical sketches, and pop-art masterpieces.
Toonita is not just another cartoon filter app. It is a powerful, high-resolution photo editing suite built on a professional 5-stage processing pipeline. Whether you are a fan of classic comic books, technical blueprints, or retro ASCII art, Toonita gives you the precision tools to turn any image into a work of art.
WHY TOONITA? Most apps give you one-tap filters. Toonita gives you a creative studio. From automatic background replacement to AI-powered object removal, you have total control over every detail of your transformation.
THE FIVE-STAGE ARTISTIC PIPELINE:
1. PREPARE: Professional Retouching Before you stylize, get the perfect base. Use advanced tools including:
 • AI Vanish & Clone: Seamlessly remove unwanted objects.
 • Background Replace: Automatic person segmentation and background swap.
 • Face Tune: Adjust eyes, nose, and mouth size for perfect portraits.
 • Deform Tool: Professional liquify (push, bloat, shrink) to reshape elements.
 • Classic Edit: Precise control over brightness, contrast, sharpen, and noise.
2. STYLIZE: 36+ Unique Artistic Styles Go beyond basic filters. Explore a massive collection of styles:
 • Comic & Pop Art: Sin City, Lichtenstein, Magazine, Hope, Pop Art.
 • Technical & Retro: Blueprint, ASCII Art, Dither, Halftone, Matrix, Graphite.
 • Artistic: Sketch, Watercolor, Pastel, Painting, Charcoal.
 • Unique Textures: Money, Newspaper, Grunge, Color Splash.
3. ADJUST: Fine-Tune the Edges Total control over the stylization. Fine-tune outlines, edge width, smoothness, and detail. Adjust color levels and softness to achieve that perfect hand-drawn look.
4. STICKERS: Visual Storytelling Bring your comics to life with fully customizable speech bubbles, text overlays, and professional sticker collections (Comic, Pop Art, Kawaii, and more).
5. FILTERS: Final Color Mastery Apply professional color maps and filters (Warm, Cold, Sepia, B&W, Threshold, Glowing Edges) to set the mood of your masterpiece.
PRO-GRADE FEATURES:
 • High-Resolution Export: Save your art in 3MP, 6MP, or ultra-clear 12MP.
 • Multi-Stage Editing: Use your result as an input for a new cycle of transformations.
 • Opacity Control: Every style and filter can be blended for subtle or bold effects.
 • Non-Linear Workflow: Go back and forth between stages to perfect your vision.
Cartoon yourself. Sketch your world. Create with Toonita.
CREDITS are listed on http://toonita.app.
Terms of Use: http://toonita.app/terms-of-use-ios.html

bluejetty:00080828:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
This time, you're the bombshell! Crash the retreat and start drama among paired-up singles in this season of "Too Hot to Handle," the beloved dating game based on the series. More customization! Fewer inhibitions! Will you find love and romance or go for casual hookups in this dating game?
Flirt with glittering singles, get tangled up in love triangles and make fateful decisions that could have lasting consequences for your dating life. Can you abstain from getting frisky and build a true romance? Or will you succumb to infatuation? The story is in your hands. Based on the hit Netflix reality series "Too Hot to Handle."
EVEN MORE WAYS TO CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER
• Choose your character's look and personality as well as their age, facial hair, astrological sign, occupation and more. 
• Find yourself attracted to someone, but hate their haircut? Now you can also customize the clothes and hairstyles of your love interests. Make the updates permanent or change them whenever your heart desires. Bring on those fixer uppers!
BE YOUR AUTHENTIC SELF TO FIND LOVE AND ROMANCE
• Choose your pronouns, hobbies and more. Love interests will respond based on your choices and how you engage in conversations. Not into a suitor's vibes? Life is short — let 'em know! 
SHARE YOUR "TOO HOT TO HANDLE" CHARACTER
• Download and share your customized character with the community. Change the background, include vital information like pronouns and occupation, and even add your character's significant other! Show off your dating choices.
CHLOE VEITCH RETURNS
• Netflix reality star Chloe Veitch makes a triumphant return to the resort to help contestants (including you) with workshops designed to encourage growth in dating and romance. But in true "Too Hot to Handle" fashion, they can often lead to more drama.
SERIOUS CONSEQUENCES
• Disrespect too many "Too Hot to Handle" rules, and there will be a steep price to pay. Still not getting the message? Better cool it, because you could be eliminated early. Oh, the shame!
COMING SOON: GET OUT OF THE FRIEND ZONE, TURN UP THE ROMANCE
• Are you starting to have feelings for a so-called friend? Use your looks, wits and charm to convince them to see you as more than just a ridiculously good-looking buddy. Don't miss your chance at love and romance! 
LOTS OF NEW SURPRISES AND JUICY TWISTS 
• No spoilers here, but it's safe to say some of the plot twists coming in this dating game's new season will have your mouth on the floor. OMG, did that really just happen?
- Created by Nanobit.

bluejetty:00017301:ios.name: Touchgrind BMX 2
bluejetty:00017301:ios.summary:
TOUCHGRIND BMX 2 is a physics-driven BMX stunt game with unique two-finger controls.
EXPERIENCE INCREDIBLE ENVIRONMENTS riding through dazzling locations around the globe. Drop off fifty meter rooftops surrounded by skyscrapers in Vertigo,
bluejetty:00017301:ios.description:
TOUCHGRIND BMX 2 is a physics-driven BMX stunt game with unique two-finger controls.
EXPERIENCE INCREDIBLE ENVIRONMENTS riding through dazzling locations around the globe. Drop off fifty meter rooftops surrounded by skyscrapers in Vertigo, launch off mini ramps and rush downhill on the shady slopes of Montaña Alta, shred the trails on Grizzly Trail or take your chances descending Viper Valley’s narrow ledges literally flying over lethal gaps.
DESIGN and ASSEMBLE your fully customizable BMX. Choose between different frames, handle bars, wheels and seats and spray paint it for that final personal touch. Crack open crates to unlock additional bike parts, SPECIAL bikes and much much more.
CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS or any other Touchgrind BMX 2 players and compete man-to-man in DUELS.
COMPLETE CHALLENGES and RANK UP, earn shiny trophies for exceptional performance and compare your best scores with other players around the globe or in your own country. Learn how to master barspins, tailwhips, bikeflips, backflips, 360’s and many other tricks, pump your adrenaline levels to the max and kill impossible trick combos that will rocket your scores sky high.
SHARE YOUR SKILLS with the world and let them enjoy your extreme runs for real. Decide on real time or slow-mo speed, choose between replay- or bike cameras and generate amazing videos to impress your friends.
STUNNING GRAPHICS AND REALISTIC AUDIO make Touchgrind BMX 2 a truly wonderful gaming experience and once you launch your bike off that ramp, only your imagination will decide what kind of BMX rider you will be... It begins NOW!
FEATURES
- Same revolutionary two finger controls as seen in Touchgrind BMX
- Fully customizable bikes and special bikes
- Many unlockable items
- Complete challenges and earn trophies on every location
- Substantial ranking system for each location – world, country, among friends
- Personal profile
- Generate replay videos and share with the world
- Multiplayer duels
- Amazing graphics and audio
- ‘How to’ section that visually demonstrates how to ride and perform tricks
- Sync progress between device
** This game is free to play but offers in-app-purchases. You may disable in-app-purchasing using your device's settings **

bluejetty:00032527:ios.description:
Shift Calendar is a simple and efficient way to manage your work shifts. Organize your schedule with rotations, days off, swaps, and absences, track your earnings, create payout reports, and keep a clear overview of your professional routine, without relying on spreadsheets or manual tracking. Designed for professionals who work in shifts.
Why choose Shift Calendar?
• Organized schedule: manage your shifts, personal events, swaps, and days off in one place, with full visibility of your work schedule.
• Financial clarity: know how much you will earn and when you will get paid, with the option to generate PDF reports for payouts, sharing, or printing.
• Time-off planning: avoid surprises and enjoy your rest periods with more peace of mind.
• Simple, practical, and intuitive: built to support your daily routine.
Main features:
• Automatic shift schedules and recurring patterns
• Personal events registration
• Calendar synchronization
• Earnings tracking with amounts, payment dates, and custom payment rules
• Custom colors to differentiate shifts
• Mark unworked shifts as swaps, days off, or absences
• Home screen widgets
• Export shift reports to PDF, with filters and multiple formats
• Schedule conflict alerts
• Secure cloud backup
Perfect for professionals like:
• Nurses, doctors, EMTs, and caregivers
• Firefighters, police, and security guards
• Bartenders, restaurant and hotel staff
• Drivers, cleaners, and rotating shift workers
The app can be used for free. The Pro version offers additional features, with a free trial available before subscribing.

bluejetty:00097244:ios.description:
Grazzee “The Easy way to TIP”
Grazzee app has simplified the whole tipping process. Grazzee started out servicing doorman buildings linking tenants to the building staff for gratuities. Now we have expanded to camps, hotels, beach clubs and moving companies. So now when someone wants to tip a staff member, Grazzee provides a place where you can find the person with ease. Grazzee provides contactless and streamlined method for tipping. No more going to buy cards, getting cash and finding the right person to give it to. everyone to tip or leave a handful of cards with money in them and hand them to. The entity will populate all the staff members and you can decide how much to give them. Now you can tip using your credit cards, Bank transfers, debit cards to make it as easy as possible. Also you can leave a message instead of filling out cards and save trees.  For the person receiving the tips, they can get their tips sent to them via bank transfer and other favorable  options.

bluejetty:00090629:ios.description:
A Lello Digital trouxe para você um novo jeito de cuidar do seu condomínio!
Agora, você não precisa mais estar sentado na frente do computador para acompanhar as principais informações e tomar as melhores decisões para sua gestão. Conheça o App Lello para síndico!
Olha que legal:
Você baixa o aplicativo, faz o seu cadastro e pronto! Já pode começar a usar de onde estiver, a hora que precisar.
Logo na home do App, você já confere o saldo do dia atualizado do seu condomínio. 
Quer saber as principais novidades? A gente conta tudo para você: Se você confessar uma resposta de uma solicitação, teve alguma dúvida respondida, ou ainda algum pagamento cadastrado. Fica tudo aqui, disponível para você!
Tá precisando de alguma informação sobre os moradores ou sua equipe? Tá na mão! Aqui no App Lello para Síndicos você confere as principais informações sobre os moradores e colaboradores do prédio.
E enviar o boleto para um condômino? Com alguns cliques, você seleciona uma unidade, gera o código e envia como quiser. Simples, fácil e rápido!
Pretende reservar uma churrasqueira? Dá também! Basta clicar, escolher uma unidade e pronto! O churrasco está garantido para o fim de semana 
Além de tudo isso, você pode também acessar os principais serviços da Lello aí, direto do seu celular ou tablet!

Precisa enviar aquele pagamento com urgência? De onde você estiver, você pode cadastrar, consultar ou ainda aprovar os pagamentos pendentes de forma totalmente segura e transparente.

bluejetty:00119559:ios.name: Secret Santa app - draw names
bluejetty:00119559:ios.summary:
Secret Santa is a random name generator for your Secret Santa events. Also known as Kris Kringle, draw names for your holiday Christmas parties at the office or among friends.
It is now easy to organize your gift exchange, create your group
bluejetty:00119559:ios.description:
Secret Santa is a random name generator for your Secret Santa events. Also known as Kris Kringle, draw names for your holiday Christmas parties at the office or among friends.
It is now easy to organize your gift exchange, create your group and wishlist.
Instead of scribbling down names and popping them out of a hat, use this very advanced technology to send emails or display a live draw.
It is very easy to create a new Secret Santa group with this app.
FEATURES:
◆ Online Secret Santa
Set up your Secret Santa gift exchange by creating a group, set a budget and date, add the names of friends, family and set exclusions. This app allows unlimited participants.
Secret Santa will then draw names and let you send invitations by email, text message, WhatsApp or any other messaging service.
◆ Exclude pairs
Easily set exclusions, selected participants will not be paired together.
This feature ensures that partners will not gift each other. You can also prevent draws from the previous year.
◆ Without registration
This Secret Santa app requires no registration. Only one device is necessary to organize the draw.
◆ Offline Secret Santa
The offline mode will set up your gift exchange on the spot, directly on the screen.
This feature comes in handy when all attendees have already brought a gift to the event.
◆ Wishlist
Each group member can add gift suggestions on their personal wish list.
Creating a wishlist is totally anonymous with no registration.
Be sure to offer a gift that pleases by drawing from the guests' wish list.
◆ Privacy first
None of the data you share with the app is shared with anyone else except the people involved. We do not store emails nor phone numbers, Santa hates SPAM anyway.
Happy Holidays,
Team SecretSanta

[ AI Video Editor & AI Features ]
Image to Video
- Type in your creative ideas, then let AI magically bring life to your photos with advanced photo to video ai technology.
VideoGen
- This video-to-video feature lets you seamlessly swap or add elements to your videos.
AI Auto Cut
- Seamlessly stitching highlight moments into cinematic tales!
AI Remover
- Effortlessly erasing unwanted elements from videos. 
Dynamic Captions
- Auto speech to text into dynamic word-by-word captions.
Text to Video
- Generate videos with AI copywriting and subtitles, while maintaining visual quality and adherence to your prompt.
Text to Speech
- Transform text into professional voiceovers for your videos.
AI Music & Sound Effects
- Generate professional music and soundscapes for your videos!
AI Smart Cutout
- Customized Cutout: Swipe your finger, then intelligently identify the target area and cut anything out as you want!
- Cutout Plus: You can set strokes, overlay effects, and replace backgrounds for your keyed objects.
[ User-friendly video editing for beginners ]
- Trim, split, duplicate, or merge video clips without losing quality.
- Add text, emoji, and exclusive stickers.
- Add music, sound effects & voice-overs.
- Extract music from the video and split audio to remove unwanted parts
- Rotate or crop: Adjust the orientation or size
- Adjust video ratios for Instagram/TikTok/Youtube posts.
- Adjust speed for fast or slow motion. Speed control with customizable & pre-set curves for various themes.
- Stunning templates help create videos in one click with built-in ai video effects.
[ Full-featured video editing for professionals ]
- All-in-one Keyframe: More adjustment items support keyframes, combined with color grading and special effects for videos, you can create more cool animations.
- Chromakey: Easily edit green screen video.
- PIP (Picture in Picture): add multiple layers of video, images, stickers, special effects, text, etc.
- Masking: Cover and mix video clips, get different video effects.
- Smart tracking: Support stickers, text, and picture-in-picture intelligent tracking targets, whether you need to track faces, objects, or anything else.

bluejetty:00019504:ios.description:
Over 20 million players could not be wrong - featured as one of the best games since 2014 and still eagerly played in 2022! 
Especially with a new update that adds dozens of new characters, new environments and an expandable village! And as always tons of fun & lot of trees to cut.
Timberman is an oldschool arcade style casual game. Become a Timberman, chop wood and avoid the branches. Sounds like an easy task? It's easy to play but hard to master. Dozen of variable environments and 104 lumberjacks to unlock. Master your skills for the top records on the leaderboards.
Take your axe as every lumberjack does and chop the tree as fast as you can!
Cut down trees, trade wood for gold, buy plots of land and discover new islands.
Generate passive income, buy new axes and randomize super fantastic packs of epic characters!
Many characters, trees, tons of cutting fun & wood around!
Timberman is an original old school arcade style casual free game. 
Become a Timberman! Chop, cut and slice wood while avoiding branches. Improve your skill to reach the top of the leaderboards in this easy to learn, hard to master game.
- Dozens of characters to choose from
- Countless high scores to beat
- Global leaderboards
- Cutting edge chopping action
Cut your way to the top of the leaderboards and beat others’ high scores. Chop with speed, precision and focus to become a master lumberjack. 
Unlock tons of different lumberjack characters, including: ninja, ghost, fireman, devil, angel, santa, monster slayer and more. 
Play in various environments, including: forest, wild west, circus and even hell.
As a lumberjack you will race against the clock to chop down as much as you can of an endless tree. Quick thinking will be necessary to avoid branches - your biggest enemy. Cut left or chop right? You only have milliseconds to answer this question. Get it right and you’ll beat the competition and become the best Timberman ever! 
Along the way on this free chopping action adventure you will unlock many different characters and trees. Each one requires you to complete a unique quest!
Are you up for the challenge? If so, then we at Digital Melody invite you to pick up an axe, yell timber and start chopping to test your skills and become the best Timberman ever!

bluejetty:00140648:ios.name: HTTPS Guard: Bypass SNI
bluejetty:00140648:ios.summary: Bypass site censorship, you can enjoy a free Internet, complete anonymity, and access any site without slowdowns, satisfying your needs quickly and simply. You can access all sites without any obstruction and protect your personal informati
bluejetty:00140648:ios.description:
Bypass site censorship, you can enjoy a free Internet, complete anonymity, and access any site without slowdowns, satisfying your needs quickly and simply. You can access all sites without any obstruction and protect your personal information. Additionally, you can block intrusive advertisements such as banner advertisements, full-page advertisements, reward advertisements, and kidnapping advertisements based on DNS.
HTTPS Guard was created by Redev and allows you to bypass censorship without slowing down, protect your personal information, access all sites, and block intrusive ads.
Representative functions
1. Maintain a secure connection with encrypted data transmission via HTTPS connection
2. HTTPS SNI field information protection
3. HTTP/HTTPS all field information protection
4. Change DNS (system default, 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, Custom DNS)
5. Protect data transmission packets in all app webs
6. Block advertisements in Safari
Bypass censorship without slowdowns?
Yes. Common VPN bypass apps are created to target users from all countries and actually place VPN servers in other countries to protect your data. HTTPS Guard is designed to bypass censorship in certain countries, so it processes your data with a local VPN. In other words, unlike an external VPN, a local VPN does not require a long-distance connection to an external server, so there is no slowdown in speed.
Can block ads?
Yes. Blocks ads based on Safari content blocker.
Enjoy 100% strong SNI protection-based HTTP/HTTPS bypass service and ad blocking service at HTTPS Guard!

bluejetty:00123905:ios.description:

• Barnyard Blaster is a unique shooter with plenty of weapons, animals, and environments
• Rocket Golf gives golf a new twist with its unique 2D side scrolling gameplay
• Liquid Defense, Hydrothermal, and Escape are our three classic puzzle/simulator games
• Fractal 3D and ASCII Art are our first non-game apps

bluejetty:00137268:ios.summary:
Simple Scan is the quick, easy way to scan paper documents to optimized, searchable PDF documents (or images) and send them almost anywhere. 
## FEATURES ## 
* Same great scanning functionality as Notes, but no need to clutter your note
bluejetty:00137268:ios.description:
Simple Scan is the quick, easy way to scan paper documents to optimized, searchable PDF documents (or images) and send them almost anywhere. 
## FEATURES ## 
* Same great scanning functionality as Notes, but no need to clutter your notes data with one-off scans
* Create high-resolution multi-page PDFs from your paper documents
* PDFs are searchable thanks to automatic Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
* Built for simplicity. Just scan and send – no document library
* Send scans via email or messages. Save to a file, or "Share" use to send to other apps via the system share sheet
* Set up message destinations with pre-filled recipients for easy "Email to Myself" and other common uses
* Custom file destinations save scans directly to a pre-selected folder without extra taps
* File naming suggestions, such as names, dates, pulled from the scanned document (requires Apple Intelligence)
* Save scans directly to Photos
* Option to output as images (JPEG) instead of PDF
* Quality option to control file size
* Never any ads. Ever.
* Private and on-device. All scan processing is done locally on your device.
## SIMPLE SCAN PRO ##
Simple Scan is free to download and try! To continue using Simple Scan, unlock Simple Scan Pro--available as a low-cost, annual subscription or a one-time lifetime unlock purchase. 
## SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS ##
* Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase
* Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
* Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were initially charged for the subscription
* Subscriptions can be managed or canceled by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase 
Have questions? Email support@agiletortoise.com.
Terms: https://agiletortoise.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://agiletortoise.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00161479:ios.description:
Welcome to Chef Adventure: Cooking Games, a fast-paced and thrilling cooking game that will take you on an amazing culinary adventure. Get ready to don your chef hat, sharpen your knives, cook delicious food and drinks. Hungry customers are waiting for you to serve some tasty meals in your restaurant game. 
↬ Your journey begins with basic recipes and simple dishes such as traditional apple pie, hotdog, pizza, hamburger, orange juice, coffee, etc., which are very popular in the USA; sashimi, sushi, ramen noodles, beefsteak, taiyaki, takoyaki, and many other yummy foods come from Japan. But as you advance cooking techniques, gain experience, and the trust of your customers, you will unlock new restaurants with more diverse meals for diners to eat, like croissants, escargot, steak, grilled pork, sweet cake, etc., that are signatures in French; lobster, king crab, chicken rice, dumplings, ice cream, and a variety of tasty cuisines in the Singapore restaurant. In this cuisine game, your passion for cooking will be put to the ultimate test as you strive to become a culinary legend.
▶ The aim of this culinary adventure is to serve up the right dishes for each beloved diner who comes to your restaurants. You will need to follow the mouth-watering cooking instructions carefully and cook each step to perfection. As you progress through the levels, the recipes will get more complex and challenging. Don’t forget to upgrade food and kitchenware items to cook more delicious dishes and improve your chef skills, making the game more challenging. All the diners from all over the world will come to visit your lovely kitchen area. It's time to cook it up!
◆ EXCITING FEATURES OF THIS FUN CHEF GAME:
⌲ Travel to a huge variety of new worlds & discover many different restaurants and delicious dishes to eat.
⌲ Wide choice of yummy meals from countries all over the world
⌲ Thousands of levels for you to conquer! 
⌲ Explore all the possible kitchen appliance and interior upgrade options.
⌲ Tournaments, challenges, and numerous events in which to complete.
⌲ Simple and smooth UI, easy gameplay for all players.
⌲ Amazing time management game is totally free to play.
⇨ Are you ready to set the kitchen on fire and become the star chef? Strap on your apron, grab your spatula, and let the journey begin!

bluejetty:00178649:ios.description:
Audio Editor is the quick way to fix, trim and polish any sound on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Open a recording, a song or a video, make your edits in a few taps, and save the result in whatever format you need.
It's simple enough for a first-time user and deep enough for people who edit audio every day.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Get audio in from anywhere
 • Import from Files, Photos or any other app with a share sheet
 • Pull the soundtrack out of a video
 • Grab audio from a link
 • Record from the microphone, or record straight into the middle of a file you're already editing
Edit with precision
 • Trim, cut out the middle, or mute a part without changing the timing
 • Join files by adding audio to the beginning or end
 • Pinch to zoom on the waveform and type exact start and end times
 • Apply any effect to just the selected part
 • Remove all the silent gaps in one go
 • Full undo history, so nothing is ever lost
Make it sound better
 • Remove background noise and keep the voice
 • 8-band equalizer for real control over the sound
 • Smart Bass Boost that goes deep without distorting
 • Echo and reverb, from a small room to a cathedral
 • Change speed or pitch, reverse, Lo-Fi, distortion and more
 • Split a song into vocals, drums, bass and chords
 • Tuner and a loudness meter to check your track before you share it
Create from scratch
 • Generate tones and white, pink or brown noise for test signals, beeps and sleep sounds
 • Repeat a selection to build loops
 • Insert silence exactly where you need a pause
Save it your way
 • Export to mp3, wav, m4a, aac, flac, ogg, opus, aiff, caf and more
 • Save any audio as a ringtone
 • Keep your own export presets for one-tap exports
Stay organized
 • A library with folders for your projects, clients and episodes
 • Batch rename, sorting and search
 • Pick your own accent and waveform colors
A subscription unlocks exporting with all effects, plus unlimited folders, batch rename, custom export presets and no ads.
Every update starts with a message from someone like you. If there's a feature or effect you're missing, tell us: drumpads24help+audioeditorios@gmail.com

Welcome to a world of electric rides!
Viggo is your electric alternative to taxi - and the first Scandinavian ride-hailing service running 100% on electric cars.
We are offering you an alternative to a fossil fuel-based taxi without the need to compromise on efficiency or price. Take a Viggo as your next taxi, when you need to get around in Copenhagen.

1. Download the app & register
2. Enter destination & current location
3. Approve the fixed price
4. See your Viggo driver approaching

More Service. Less CO2.
Whether you’re going to work, to the airport, heading out with friends or going home, a Viggo cab will get you fast and smoothly to your destination. No taximeter pricing and only friendly, service-minded drivers. Compared to taking a fossil fuel-based taxi, you’ll save approximately half the amount of CO2.
Viggo cars are all comfortable, electric cars at no extra cost to you.
Features:
- Fixed pricing - see the price before you order
- In-app payment
- Only authorized drivers
- Rating of drivers
- See ETA before booking
- 100% electric cars
See you in a Viggo?

bluejetty:00127528:ios.name: Raindrops: Rain Sounds BGM
bluejetty:00127528:ios.summary: Raindrops is a minimalistic player designed to immerse you in the soothing sound of rain, accompanied by calming visual effects of falling raindrops. Gain a sense of control over the rain: it falls or stops as you play or pause the player.
bluejetty:00127528:ios.description:
Raindrops is a minimalistic player designed to immerse you in the soothing sound of rain, accompanied by calming visual effects of falling raindrops. Gain a sense of control over the rain: it falls or stops as you play or pause the player. Use Raindrops to unwind, concentrate on tasks, or drift into a restful sleep. A built-in sleep timer ensures the rain stops when you're off to dreamland.
--- Ideal Uses ---
- Focusing during exam preparation
- Soothing yourself to sleep
- Shifting your mood to spark creativity
----- Features -----
- Sound Control: Simply tap the play-pause button to toggle the rain sound.
- Visual Effects: The rain visuals change depending on whether the player is in play or pause mode. The sky's brightness also shifts gradually as you continue using the app.
- Rain Type: Tap the droplet icon to choose from "Heavy," "Light," or "Hood" rain types.
- Sleep Timer: Rotate the dial and press "SET" to initiate the sleep timer. The rain sound will stop after the set time. To cancel, rotate the dial to zero and press "CANCEL."
- Screen Display: Tap anywhere on the screen outside the buttons to enjoy an uncluttered rain view.
- Background Play: Raindrops will keep playing even when the app is in the background, allowing you to multitask (as long as the other app doesn't require sound).
--- Paid version ---
Unlock more features with the paid version:
- Pricing: $4.99 (price may vary based on country, region, and time of year)
- Ad-free Experience
- Extended Timer: Set a timer for up to 12 hours. (Note: Pausing functionality may be limited when the device is locked)
--- Notes on paid version---
- Billing occurs through your Apple ID account.
- No cancellations or refunds are permitted.

bluejetty:00064447:ios.description:
That zombie apocalypse you’ve always wanted to bring about is finally a thing!
Graft and stitch together different mutant zombies and create an undead horde to call yours! 
Each and every one of them will be a unique shambling corpse with hopes and dreams and a healthy appetite for human brains!
And they’re very low-maintenance, too, what with their favorite dish being so abundant and all.

• Drag and drop similar zombies to create new mysterious creatures
• Use zombie eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money

bluejetty:00037403:ios.description:
Free to use and with no ads, FitHero lets you plan & track your workouts, measure progress, learn new exercises, and reach your fitness goals.
Simple and intuitive to use, FitHero is perfect for expert weightlifters & bodybuilders, as well as amateurs just starting out. Choose from a variety of pre-made routines, or create your own from scratch with over 400 exercises.
Every exercise includes a video demo, so you can see exactly how it’s done. You can also add custom exercises and modify your routines however you see fit.
Use FitHero to get stronger and build a healthy lifestyle. Focus on your workouts and let the app take care of the rest.
Give FitHero a try for free!
FITHERO - FEATURES & BENEFITS
----------------------------------------------
• No ads
• Start logging workouts right away with just a few clicks
• Log workout, exercises, sets & reps
• Supersets, tri-sets and giant sets
• Add notes to your workouts
• 400+ exercises with video instructions for each of them

• Access pre-made plans & routines like StrongLifts, 5/3/1, Push Pull Legs, and more popular and proven programs for every fitness level
• Create your own routines & add custom exercises to your workouts
• Weekly plans
• See progress statistics for every exercise
• Get estimates for your 1-rep maximum (1RM) and the number of repetitions you can perform at various weights
• Customizable rest timer for in-between sets 
• Sync with Apple Health to track your weight & body fat percentage
• Streak system to see your best and current streaks
• Copy and duplicate your previous workouts
• See all previous workouts on the calendar
• Use kg or lb, km or miles
• Mark sets as warm-up, drop sets or failure for advance tracking
• Dark mode
• Backup and restore your data

-----------------------------------------------------------------
• Supersets, tri-sets and giant sets
• Chart tracking for all exercises
• Unlimited routines
• Unlimited video views

• Unlimited workout generation
• Sync body measurements with Apple Health

• All new premium features

• Quarterly auto-renew subscription ($12.99 / quarter)

bluejetty:00063308:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a powerful EMF detector and magnetic field scanner.
Detect electromagnetic fields (EMF) around you instantly using the built-in sensor already inside your device — no expensive equipment required. Whether you want to monitor electromagnetic radiation in your home, locate hidden magnetic sources, or even explore paranormal activity, this app gives you a simple and exciting way to measure the invisible world around you.
Use the app to scan bedrooms, walls, electrical appliances, Wi-Fi zones, sockets, microwaves, wireless devices, and more. Discover areas with unusually high magnetic activity and receive an instant warning beep when strong EMF levels are detected. Many users also enjoy using the app during ghost hunts and paranormal investigations, as sudden magnetic fluctuations are often associated with supernatural activity.
NEW: Experience EMF detection in Augmented Reality.
Visualize electromagnetic fields in Augmented Reality to better understand how EMFs spread throughout your home, office, or workspace. The app allows you to see a figurative representation of magnetic activity around you, helping you identify high-radiation zones and understand how far electromagnetic fields may reach in real-world environments.
Explore EMFs in a more immersive and intuitive way by combining real-time detection with AR visualization technology.
Transform your iPhone into a digital EMF Meter, Teslameter, or electromagnetic field tester using the internal compass hardware. View live magnetic field readings in real time and monitor changes on all three axes (X, Y, Z).
Scientists, engineers, students, teachers, paranormal investigators, and curious explorers use EMF detectors to measure magnetic activity in everyday environments.
Why use this app?
• Detect high electromagnetic field zones around you
• Monitor EMF levels near beds, appliances, or workspaces
• Receive warning alerts when strong magnetic radiation is detected
• Track and store measurements with time and date stamps
• Investigate unusual magnetic fluctuations during ghost hunting sessions 
• Find metallic objects, pipes, or hidden sources behind walls
• Explore the invisible electromagnetic world around you
Features:
• Real-time EMF and magnetic field detection
• Warning beep near strong radiation sources
• Measures magnetic force on X, Y, and Z axes
• Magnetic readings displayed in microteslas (µT)
• Save up to 100 EMF records
• Record events with exact date & time
• Export and send measurements by email
• Easy-to-use digital display interface
Electromagnetic radiation may come from electrical wiring, appliances, wireless devices, cordless phones, Wi-Fi equipment, sockets, and other electronic sources in your environment.
Tips:
For best accuracy, calibrate your iPhone by moving it in a figure-8 motion before use.
Important:
This app requires an iPhone with compass hardware and will not work on iPod Touch devices.
Disclaimer:
This app is intended for entertainment and informational purposes only. It uses the iPhone magnetometer sensor to detect magnetic field variations near ferromagnetic objects and electromagnetic sources.
Download now and start discovering the hidden electromagnetic activity around you.
