bluejetty:00163004:ios.name: Legentibus: Learn Latin
bluejetty:00163004:ios.summary:
Read and listen to Latin anytime and anywhere with Legentibus, from beginner to advanced level.
LEARN BY READING & LISTENING
Legentibus is a language learning app and a library carefully curated for anyone interested in the Latin language
bluejetty:00163004:ios.description:
Read and listen to Latin anytime and anywhere with Legentibus, from beginner to advanced level.
LEARN BY READING & LISTENING
Legentibus is a language learning app and a library carefully curated for anyone interested in the Latin language. The unique combination of Latin texts with synchronized audio and integrated dictionaries gives you an unsurpassed learning experience. Dive into our ever-growing collection, from beginner stories to works by classical authors such as Cicero or Tacitus.
STEP-BY-STEP IMMERSION COURSE
Read adventure stories from the start
Start reading Latin from day one with exclusive beginner-friendly stories and chapters from Familia Romana. Enhance your understanding and enjoyment using the Legentibus Reading Method.
Understand every text with ease
No more confusion! With interlinear English translations and glossaries included in every text, you’ll feel fully supported. Need less help? Simply hide them as you progress.
Natural processing with audio + text
You can listen and read at the same time, helping your mind learn to understand Latin linearly without “decoding” it.
Master grammar gradually
Avoid overwhelm with simplified grammar explanations you can reference anytime. Internalize the rules naturally as you learn—no pressure to memorize!
EXPLORE BEGINNER STORIES, TEXTBOOKS, LITERATURE
Legentibus contains plenty of materials for learning, studying, or simply enjoying Latin:
· Stories for beginners
· Textbooks and readers such as Familia Romana and Ritchie’s Fabulae Faciles
· Roman myths and history
· Latin literature by authors such as Caesar, Cicero, Sallust, and Erasmus
· And more!
IMMERSION COURSE AND READING PLANS
Navigate your Latin journey with ease. The Legentibus Immersion course and reading plans take the guesswork out of choosing, leading you from beginner tales to intricate literature.
CREATE A SOLID STUDY HABIT
Set a daily study goal and track your progress to create a good study habit – a foundation for language learning.
DISCOVER FEATURES THAT WILL IMPROVE YOUR LEARNING
All books come not just with Latin audio but also with additional help. Depending on the book, different features are available, such as:
· English translations or interlinear translations
· Built-in dictionaries with English definitions
· Grammatical notes
· Commentaries
· Macrons for all texts
LEARN WITH STORIES: EXCLUSIVE LEGENTIBUS-ORIGINALS
Our illustrated Beginner Stories are written with a unique vocabulary count of 100 to 200 words with additional features:
· Audio
· Translation
· Commentary
They are grounded in history or literature – in classical myths, fables, medieval stories, or historical events, e.g.:
· The Knight and the Magician (medieval)
· Phrixus and Helle (classical)
· Orpheus and Eurydice (classical)
· The Strange Death of Milo (classical)
· The Statue and the Treasure (medieval)
That way, you will learn more than the language itself. We go to great lengths to ensure that the vocabulary and syntax are attested in Roman literature.
We believe that stories are vital for learning Latin efficiently while simultaneously having a good time, which enhances your learning.
WHO IS THIS LANGUAGE APP FOR?
Legentibus was created for:
· Complete beginners to advanced Latin learners
· Autodidacts and enthusiasts
· Students and researchers
· Latin speakers who want to improve their skills
· Schools
With an easy-to-use interface, learning is natural and stress-free. In addition, a curated library with a reading plan facilitates long-term success.
WHY IS LEGENTIBUS DIFFERENT?
It is essential to experience Latin as a language: a medium for communicating something, be it philosophy, history, or a simple story. The only way to achieve true reading fluency in Latin is to listen and read as much Latin as possible from the start.

bluejetty:00034611:ios.description:
Car Dealer Idle 3D - Your Ultimate Car Dealership Experience!
Step into the exciting world of automotive commerce with Car Dealer Idle 3D! In this immersive simulation game, you get to manage your very own car dealer shop, running a bustling business that spans from handling used cars to showcasing luxurious sports vehicles, including iconic brands like Tesla. With intricate gameplay and engaging mechanics, Car Dealer Idle 3D is the ultimate car dealership experience for all aspiring tycoons and car enthusiasts!
Key Features:
►Manage Your Car Dealer Shop◀
Take charge of your car dealer shop and grow your business. Buy, sell, and upgrade cars to maximize profits and attract a loyal customer base. Whether it’s a used car or a high-end sports car, your expertise will turn every deal into a success.
►Sell and Upgrade Cars◀
Unlock a variety of vehicles, from vintage classics to the latest supercars. Upgrade and customize your inventory to increase their value and appeal. Your ability to enhance cars will be pivotal in becoming the top car dealer in the market.
►Repair and Test Drive◀
Ensure every vehicle in your shop is in top condition by repairing and maintaining them. Perform test drives to check performance and impress potential buyers.
►Hire and Manage Staff◀
Recruit staff to help run your business smoothly. From salespeople to mechanics, each role is crucial. Manage your team effectively to enhance productivity and customer satisfaction.
►Realistic Car Simulation◀
Experience realistic car simulation that brings every aspect of the car dealership business to life. The detailed 3D models and lifelike driving mechanics provide an immersive experience that’s both fun and educational.
►Meet a Wide Range of Cars◀
From classic favorites to luxurious sports cars, your dealership will offer a wide range of vehicles, including EV, Trucks, Tesla. The more you upgrade your cars and dealership, the better cars you can sell and the more profit you can make.
►Run a Thriving Business◀
Use your business skills to handle the challenges of the car dealership industry. Sell competitive cars, expand your dealership, and make it thrive. Your goal is to become the top car dealership tycoon!
Whether you’re a car enthusiast, a business tycoon in the making, or simply looking for a fun and engaging simulation game, Car Dealer Idle 3D has something for everyone. The game combines the thrill of car trading with the satisfaction of running a successful business. You’ll love the challenge of turning a modest dealership into a thriving automotive empire.
Download Car Dealer Idle 3D now and start your journey to becoming the ultimate car dealership tycoon!

bluejetty:00063755:ios.description:
Have you always wanted to be an airport manager and work in an airport? Then this app will take you on the perfect adventure! Get inside the airport and prepare to fly in a top-notch airplane. Explore every corner of the airport and get ready to travel for your vacation! Show off your creativity through storytelling and role-play.
Here's what you get in this app 
* Duty Free Shopping Area
Shop to your heart's content in this Duty free shopping area in the aiport. Play dress up airport games or pretend to be cabin crew in these airline games. Buy stuff from the vending machine and eat yummy food too! It's the perfect start to your vacation.
* Immigration and Security Area
Make sure that the airport is safe by scanning every passenger. Ensure that no harmful objects are being taken on board. Complete the entire check-in process including luggage and boarding passes. It's exactly like how a real airport works!
* Airplane
When the whole check-in process is done, then it's time to get on the airplane! Experience the life of frequent flyers by traveling in business as well as economy classes of the airplane. Be the best cabin crew and provide awesome service to the passengers.
* Helicopter & Airplane Garage
Oh no! The airplane is damaged. Take the plane to the garage to give it a quick fix & design it the way you like. Select the best-advanced tools and materials used for airplane construction.
* Baggage Area
Check every passenger's baggage & load all the boxes & luggage carefully in the airplane. Use your excellent management skills and become the no. 1 airport manager.
Key Features:
- New characters including cabin crew members, airport manager and passengers.
- Lots and lots of objects to play. It's fun to create your own story in this app!
- Touch, drag, and explore every object and see what happens!
- This airplane and airport are completely safe and ad-free!
- Made for kids ages 6-8, but everyone will enjoy playing this app.
Are you ready to begin your holiday adventure? Get started now by downloading this app! Happy journey!!

bluejetty:00139446:ios.description:
Neo Mambí – Noticias, Comunidad y Servicios para los Cubanos
Neo Mambí es la aplicación todo-en-uno para la comunidad cubana dentro y fuera de Cuba. Infórmate, participa en causas colectivas, gestiona tus trámites migratorios y mantente conectado con tu tierra, estés donde estés.
Noticias de Cuba en Tiempo Real
Accede a noticias cubanas actualizadas desde medios confiables como CiberCuba, ADN Cuba, OnCuba News, Cubanet, Diario de Cuba y otros portales reconocidos.
Consulta videos, artículos y análisis sobre política, sociedad, economía y cultura.
Comenta, reacciona y comparte lo que te importa sobre Cuba y su actualidad.
Demandas Colectivas y Causas Ciudadanas
Participa en la nueva función de Demandas Colectivas, que te permite apoyar o iniciar campañas para causas sociales y legales relacionadas con Cuba y la diáspora cubana.
Recoge firmas digitales y únete a movimientos que buscan generar impacto real en la comunidad.
Comunidad de Blogs en NeoMambi.com
Forma parte de la comunidad de blogging cubano en neomambi.com
.
Publica tus artículos, historias personales, recetas o experiencias migratorias, y conecta con otros autores cubanos que comparten tu visión y tus ideas.
Servicios Migratorios
Consulta el estado de tus casos en USCIS y en la corte de inmigración.
Accede a directorios de cortes, enlaces a audiencias virtuales, simuladores de ciudadanía y herramientas útiles para migrantes cubanos.
Solicita FOIA o revisa tu situación bajo la Ley de Memoria Democrática.
Asistentes Inteligentes
Neo Mambí integra una red de asistentes virtuales especializados en migración, Ley Dignidad, cocina cubana, aduana y ciudadanía estadounidense.
Cada asistente ofrece respuestas rápidas, guías prácticas y enlaces actualizados.
Economía y Sociedad
Consulta el cambio de divisa en tiempo real (MLC, USD, EUR) con gráficas de tendencia.
Accede a los resultados de loterías de Cuba y Florida, tanto de mediodía como de noche.
Sigue eventos sociales y económicos relevantes que afectan a la comunidad cubana.
Servicios Profesionales
Solicita o da seguimiento a servicios de seguro médico subsidiado, declaración de impuestos, gestión de documentos legales y asesoría migratoria certificada.
Cultura y Cocina Cubana
Descubre recetas auténticas de la cocina cubana con explicaciones paso a paso y asistentes virtuales personalizados que te guían durante la preparación.
Servicios Empresariales
Crea tu página web profesional directamente desde Neo Mambí.
Genera códigos QR con estadísticas de seguimiento, ideales para negocios y promociones (disponible para usuarios Pro).
Por qué elegir Neo Mambí
Porque no es solo una aplicación: es tu conexión viva con Cuba.
Reúne todo lo que necesitas para mantenerte informado, participar en tu comunidad y resolver tus gestiones de manera rápida y segura.
Descarga Neo Mambí y forma parte de una comunidad cubana unida, informada y empoderada, sin importar dónde te encuentres.
Términos y Condiciones
Términos de uso (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Política de Privacidad: https://web.neomambi.com/privacy_es
Condiciones de uso: https://web.neomambi.com/terms_es

bluejetty:00143504:android.description:
Citi Mobile® allows you to manage finances, wherever you are, whenever you want. 
Your transactions are safe thanks to mobile authorization with Citi Mobile Token Pin and push notifications which inform you about every operation on your account or card.
You can log in to the app by entering Citibank Online username and password or using the fingerprint. Users who have not previously used our online banking can register directly in Citi Mobile.
Selected functionalities:
Personal account:
- possibility to activate new card
- possibility to view account numbers 
- ability to set or change PIN
- possibility to pay with BLIK
- Citi Kantor - currency exchange platform
- information about account balance, access to transaction history
- possibility to order any transfers
- the Citi Global Wallet service thanks to which the debit card will select the transaction currency by itself when paying online or abroad
- possibility to open foreign currency accounts in 13 currencies
- term deposit management
Credit card:
- possibility to activate a new card
- possibility to view account number
- possibility to activate and use electronic credit card before the physical version arrives (for new customers only)
- ability to set or change PIN
- possibility to pay with BLIK
- information on available credit and balance
- access to transaction history
- access to PDF statements for the last 12 months
- cash transfers to defined and new domestic payees
- card debt repayment
The use of this Citi Mobile application is for the consumer banking customers of Bank Handlowy w Warszawie S.A. only. Content provided via application is not specifically created for any territory other than where Bank Handlowy w Warszawie S.A operates/is licensed to operate.
The material does not constitute an offer within the meaning of Art. 66 of the Civil Code.

bluejetty:00033799:ios.summary: This is an easy-to-use music score making software designed for music lovers and professional musicians. Simple keyboard input method, you can generate music scores by tapping the required notes. You can also quickly generate intelligent mu
bluejetty:00033799:ios.description:
This is an easy-to-use music score making software designed for music lovers and professional musicians. Simple keyboard input method, you can generate music scores by tapping the required notes. You can also quickly generate intelligent music scores through AI camera recognition function, and support the conversion of five-line music scores to simplified music scores.
[Strong music score editing ability]
You can create and edit music scores for piano, guitar, guzheng, violin, ukulele, vocal music, etc., support multi-part custom music score editing, five-line music score/simplified music score/six-line music score/singing music score/four-line music score input.
Supports the input of elements such as lyrics, fingering, bars, lines, ornaments, playing methods, dynamics, and notations, so that you can easily create wonderful music works.
[Smart photo recognition]
If you have paper music scores, you don’t need to write them yourself. Just open "Laiyin Music Score" and choose to take a photo and upload it to generate AI digital music scores, which is more convenient for daily use and carrying.
[Music score can be played]
Supports the music score playback function. After editing the music score, you can directly play and listen to your work, which will help you better preview and modify your work and greatly improve your creation efficiency.
[Easy and efficient operation]
The self-developed scientific and efficient keyboard input method has a concise and clear layout of various notes and symbols. It is easy to operate and easy to get started, making it easier for you to create music scores and doubling your efficiency.
[Exportable for sharing]
Supports export to PDF, MusicXML, Laiyin music scores, pictures and other formats, allowing you to save and share your works to Laiyin apps or other music software at any time.

bluejetty:00182450:ios.name: Polarsteps
bluejetty:00182450:ios.summary: Join 23M+ travelers using Polarsteps as their all-in-one travel app. Build unique itineraries with the travel planner, let the travel tracker record your route, share the journey with friends and family, and turn it into a photo book to rel
bluejetty:00182450:ios.description:
Join 23M+ travelers using Polarsteps as their all-in-one travel app. Build unique itineraries with the travel planner, let the travel tracker record your route, share the journey with friends and family, and turn it into a photo book to relive later. Whether it's a six-month trip or a weekend canoeing close to home, Polarsteps is here to capture and share your journey as it unfolds.
Awards
■ Top 26 Apps — Apple App Store (2026)
■ Top 3 Travel Apps — Apple App Store (2026)
■ App of the Day — Apple App Store (2025)
PLAN
■ AI itinerary planner: Create a personalized adventure based on past trips or current goals.
■ Destination snapshots: Get a quick overview of each place, why it fits your travel style, and which friends have already been there.
■ Trip details: Add notes, accommodation details, and must-see spots and activities.
■ Transport planner: Choose how you'll get from A to B for every leg of the trip.
■ Inspiration: Follow other explorers, see where they went, and get ideas for your own trips.
TRACK
■ Automatic route tracking: Accurately track the route you took on a beautiful digital world map.
■ Travel Buddies: Invite friends to track trips together.
■ Capture the adventure: Add photos, videos, and stories to each step to bring your journey to life.
■ Travel stats: See how much of the world you’ve traveled, with your total of countries visited, distances covered, and more.
■ Top spots: Add your favorite places and activities so they’re part of your story.
■ Transport mode: Select how you got from place to place, whether by plane, train, or even tuk tuk.
SHARE
■ Trip updates: Share your journey so friends and family can follow along from anywhere, seeing where you are and what you’ve been up to.
■ Traveler tips: Leave suggestions for other travelers on what to see and do.
■ Privacy controls: Decide who sees your adventures: everyone, followers only, or you only.
RELIVE
■ Digital memories: Scroll through the places, photos, stories, and stats you’ve captured across all your trips.
■ Trip Reels: With the press of a button, transform your trip into a memorable video (also perfect to share on socials).
■ Travel Books: Turn your trip into a beautifully printed Travel Book that showcases your route and memories.
WHAT OUR USERS SAY:
“Love this app! It tracks me on my vacation and provides real-time notifications to friends and family of my trip. At the end, I ordered a Travel Book of my photos which is very high quality.”
“The Polarsteps app is great. I am totally addicted. It is so nice to keep up with all your travels. And friends and family can follow you wherever you go. The Travel Book, which you can order afterwards, is of very good quality.”
“I’ve been using this app for years now. It’s always been good and it keeps getting better.”
WHAT THE PRESS ARE SAYING ABOUT POLARSTEPS
“The Polarsteps app replaces your travel journal, making it easier and more beautiful.” - National Geographic
“Polarsteps helps you track and share your journeys in an easy and visually appealing way” - The Next Web
“Polarsteps’ resulting travel log is impressive, and is the source of a severe case of itchy feet in your correspondent.” - TechCrunch

bluejetty:00071256:ios.description:

bluejetty:00062045:ios.summary:
The Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants and Children (WIC) is a federally-funded health and nutrition program.
WIC provides families with:
- Information about nutrition and a healthy lifestyle to support you and your
bluejetty:00062045:ios.description:
The Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants and Children (WIC) is a federally-funded health and nutrition program.
WIC provides families with:
- Information about nutrition and a healthy lifestyle to support you and your family
- Support and information about breastfeeding your baby
- Help in finding health care and other valuable community services
- Healthy foods from WIC approved grocery stores such as fruits and vegetables, whole grains, milk, eggs, bread, cereal, juice, peanut butter, soy milk, tofu and much more.
Participants must meet income guidelines and be:
- A pregnant woman
- A woman breastfeeding a baby under 1 year of age
- A woman who had a baby in the past 6 months
- Have an infant(s) up to their first birthday
- Have a child(ren) up to their fifth birthday 
In California, 83 WIC agencies provide services locally to about 1.16 million participants each month at over 600 sites throughout the state. In accordance with Federal law and U.S. Department of Agriculture policy, WIC is prohibited from discriminating on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability.
The California WIC App will give WIC participants the opportunity to view upcoming appointments, view food benefits that have been issued to them in the clinic, scan UPCs while shopping at the store to see if the UPC is a WIC Approved item or not, and provide information on locations of WIC Stores and WIC Clinics across the State of California. The goal of the California WIC App is to give participants all the information they need at their fingertips to make their shopping experience fun and easy.

Get clear, in-depth definitions of tens of thousands of idioms used in the US and throughout English-speaking world. You say them every day, but do you know where they come from? Get the history behind the phrase.
FEATURES
* Search by keyword or full phrase and always find what you're looking for. 
* View multiple example sentences to see how an idiom is used in everyday speech.
* Get the history behind the phrase. Find out when and where an idiom originated. 
* Use native voice search to look up a word or phrase just by saying it. (With supported devices)
* Play 13,000+ audio pronunciations of keywords for both American and British speakers in online mode.
* Learning English? To sound like a native speaker, you need to know idioms! Master conversational English with this free resource.

* This is NOT a preview or a trial version, and there is no "locked" content. Open the app and immediately access all content, no subscriptions required!
* User-friendly, comprehensive, and authoritative: the perfect free Idioms and Slang Dictionary for new English speakers or anyone curious about the English language!
Here's a sneak-peak of what you'll find inside:
let the cat out of the bag
Give away a secret, as in "Mom let the cat out of the bag and told us Karen was engaged." This expression alludes to the dishonest practice of a merchant substituting a worthless cat for a valuable pig, which is discovered only when the buyer gets home and opens the bag. [Mid-1700s]
silver lining
An element of hope or a redeeming quality in an otherwise bad situation, as in "The rally had a disappointing turnout, but the silver lining was that those who came pledged a great deal of money." This metaphoric term is a shortening of "Every cloud has a silver lining," in turn derived from John Milton's Comus (1634): "A sable cloud turns forth its silver lining on the night." 
a picture is worth a thousand words
A graphic illustration conveys a stronger message than words, as in "The book jacket is a big selling point—one picture is worth a thousand words." This saying was invented by an advertising executive, Fred R. Barnard. To promote his agency's ads he took out an ad in Printer's Ink in 1921 with the headline "One Look Is Worth a Thousand Words" and attributed it to an ancient Japanese philosopher. Six years later he changed it to "Chinese Proverb: One Picture Is Worth Ten Thousand Words," illustrated with some Chinese characters. The attribution in both was invented; Barnard simply believed an Asian origin would give it more credibility.

TheFreeDictionary.com - Farlex apps have been downloaded tens of millions times across multiple platforms, with top ratings after hundreds of thousands of reviews. We work with the best publishers to bring together trusted content in the most comprehensive, authoritative dictionary apps on the market. bluejetty:00188126:ios.description:
Your first case as a detective is forcing you to open your eyes to a world bigger than you thought. But maybe it's better to keep them closed. Knowing too much doesn’t help anyone sleep at night! Seems the supernatural didn’t get the memo that nothing exciting ever happens in the little town of Wayhaven.
"The Wayhaven Chronicles: Book One" is a thrilling 440,000 word interactive fantasy novel by Mishka Jenkins, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Experience the big and small moments with a host of characters throughout this exciting twist on the usual supernatural tale—a story which will take you through heart-pounding romance, smile-filled friendships, and shiver-inducing drama.

bluejetty:00200177:ios.summary:
BUILT SPECIFICALLY FOR IPHONE DUO
Small screen. Big screen. More web.
Widezilla is a native browser designed around iPhone Duo: quick browsing on the outer display, room to read on the inner display, and compact controls that give your web
bluejetty:00200177:ios.description:
BUILT SPECIFICALLY FOR IPHONE DUO
Small screen. Big screen. More web.
Widezilla is a native browser designed around iPhone Duo: quick browsing on the outer display, room to read on the inner display, and compact controls that give your websites space to shine.
GO WIDE
Browse full-width pages with a floating glass address bar. Keep it at the top beside the system indicators, or move it to the bottom. Fold or unfold without replacing your open page, with reading-position preservation across display changes.
MAKE EACH DISPLAY YOURS
Choose whether to show the system status bar independently on the outer display, inner display and in 50/50 Split View. Pick an app icon and show or hide Widezilla's wide-grin Home character. Set up your layout in the welcome flow or change it later in Settings.
YOUR WEBSITES, ONE TAP AWAY
Save favourites with recognisable site icons and your own names. Hold a favourite to edit it. Switch websites with visual tab cards, open links in a new tab, and return Home without losing your open pages. Optionally close all tabs on a daily or weekly schedule.
FIND IT FASTER
Get instant address suggestions from favourites, open tabs, recent visits and a built-in catalogue of popular websites. Choose Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Ecosia or Kagi, or add a custom search service using its search URL. Kagi requires an account with that service.
LESS CLUTTER, MORE PAGE
Built-in native content blocking uses EasyList and EasyPrivacy to block many ads and trackers. Tap the shield to allow an individual website, manage allowed sites in Settings, and refresh your filter lists. Effectiveness varies by website.
OPTIONAL ON-DEVICE INTELLIGENCE
On supported devices with Apple Intelligence available, get search ideas and help finding saved pages using on-device processing. Local website suggestions work without Apple Intelligence. Typing does not send suggestion queries to a search provider; selecting a search sends it to your chosen service.
THE EVERYDAY DETAILS
Refresh from the toolbar or pull to refresh. Share website links and PDF documents with the native iOS Share sheet, save documents to Files, and use standard website image actions to save images to Photos.
Made for iPhone Duo. Requires iOS 27.1 or later. Favourites and preferences are saved on your device; open tabs last for the current app session.

Combination locks can be tricky—especially when they're attached to lockers at your school. Practice beforehand so you know exactly how to open yours.
REALISTIC UNLOCKING
The lock behaves exactly like a real one. Spin the dial to enter your combination, then tap or swipe up on the shackle to open. If you want to start over, just keep spinning and enter the combination again.

WALKTHROUGH MODE
If you get stuck, don't worry. Enable Walkthrough Mode to get step-by-step instructions as you open the lock.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR LOCK
Choose from six different dial colors: red, yellow, green, blue, purple, or black.
GENERATE A RANDOM COMBINATION, OR CHOOSE YOUR OWN
If you want to test yourself, generate a combination randomly. Or, choose your own in one of two number ranges: 0-39 or 0-49.

bluejetty:00179753:ios.description:
Explore With Margin, an iOS, iPadOS, and macOS app to help calculate the return on investment of flips.
The recent rise of garage sale resellers and thrift store flippers empowers everyone to give items a second chance at life while exploring one's entrepreneurial drive. From collectible film cameras to '80s vintage shirts to a set of tools, flippers keep products from ending up in landfills while finding them new, loving homes.
With Margin is a straightforward yet effective profit and loss estimator providing anyone on the go quick access to determine a find as a possible hit or miss. Utilizing fixed or percentage-based costs, quickly enter your reasonably educated guess for the amount it could sell. Next, subtract shipping, item cost, marketplace fees, and payment processing fees (if applicable). If profitable based on your industry knowledge, you can quickly act upon it.
Tip: While using the Custom calculator, tap the percent (%) icon to turn the line item value into a percentage rather than a fixed cost; this is useful for percentage-based fees.
Thank you for downloading With Margin, a small hobby project turned app!

bluejetty:00038622:ios.name: Qariah
bluejetty:00038622:ios.summary: “Qariah” translates to a woman Quran reciter. While there are many public Qariahs around the globe in countries like Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Morocco, Algeria, Nigeria and Yemen, it is not a well known term in many Muslim communities
bluejetty:00038622:ios.description:
“Qariah” translates to a woman Quran reciter. While there are many public Qariahs around the globe in countries like Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Morocco, Algeria, Nigeria and Yemen, it is not a well known term in many Muslim communities in the west. Thus, the Qariah app aims to mainstream the term Qariah for women and ease accessing recitations of Qariahs…so that when little girls ask their mothers or aunts or sisters or homegirls, “Why are there no women Quran reciters?” The answer will be a resounding, “There are an uncountable number of them- and God willing, you and I can be them too!”
→Global
We feature over 60 women representing cultures all around the world: from Tanzania to Indonesia, Australia to Spain, Morocco to Somalia, Canada to Pakistan, Algeria to Guinea, the Philippines to The Gambia, Singapore to Palestine, Nigeria to Malaysia, the United States to Egypt, Yemen to Mauritania and more. 
→Qualified
Each Qariah has memorized the Quran or holds an ijaza (license to teach), or is a national or international Quran competition winner or a qualified Quran teacher. The app showcases women’s scholarship with Quran and aims to inspire women across the globe to pursue Quranic understanding, memorization, and contemplative recitation. 
→Expansive
Listen to the Quran in multiple qira’aat (methods of recitation) including Hafs ‘an ‘Asim, Shu'bah 'an 'Aasim, Warsh ‘an Nafi, Al-Doori 'an Abi 'Amr, Khalaf 'an Hamza, Qaloon ‘an Nafi, and Qaloon Biqasr Almunfasil wa Iskaan Meem AlJam.
